jobs.description:
General

The Artificial Intelligence in Molecular Medicine (AIMM) Lab, led by Prof. Charlotte Bunne at EPFL, sits at the interface of computer science, artificial intelligence, and biomedical applications. The lab is affiliated with both the School of Computer and Communication Sciences and the School of Life Sciences, as well as the EPFL AI Center.

We are recruiting a postdoctoral researcher with strong expertise in modern AI, in particular the development of generative AI technologies such as diffusion models, flow matching, generative transformers, or related architectures. The position is highly methodological and focuses on developing new generative modeling approaches, scalable training algorithms, and foundation model technologies.

The role is suited for candidates with a strong machine learning background who are excited to advance the state of the art in generative AI. Prior experience with biological or biomedical data is not required. The position comes with dedicated access to the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre and the Swiss AI Initiative, and offers opportunities for collaboration across AI, science, and industry.

Research directions include

• Generative AI: development of diffusion models, flow matching, autoregressive models, normalizing flows, or related generative architectures.

• Foundation model development: novel pretraining objectives, scalable architectures, tokenization, and model adaptation strategies.

• Scalable AI training: distributed training, efficient fine-tuning, evaluation, and deployment on large-scale compute.

• Multimodal learning: representation learning and generative modeling across heterogeneous data modalities.

• AI for scientific discovery: methodological advances with potential applications across biomedical and scientific domains.

We are looking for candidates with

• A PhD in machine learning, computer science, applied mathematics, statistics, physics, engineering, or a closely related field, completed or near completion.

• Demonstrated expertise in generative AI, such as diffusion models, flow matching, normalizing flows, VAEs, generative transformers, or related methods.

• Strong programming skills and experience with modern deep learning frameworks.

• Experience with large-scale model training, distributed training, or substantial compute.

• A strong publication record at top-tier machine learning conferences and/or relevant scientific journals.

• Excellent communication skills and enthusiasm for ambitious, interdisciplinary AI research.

We offer

• Competitive EPFL postdoc salary and full social benefits.

• Dedicated compute allocation on CSCS and the Swiss AI Initiative.

• A methodologically ambitious research environment at the interface of generative AI, foundation models, and scientific AI.

• Opportunities for collaboration with academic and industry partners.

• Mentorship toward an independent academic or industry research career.

• An international, collaborative environment at one of Europe's leading technical universities

Activity rate : 100%.

Start date : ideally Fall 2026, with later start dates possible by arrangement.

To apply, please send a CV, a brief statement of research interests (1 page), and the names of two references. More information via aimm.epfl.ch . Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

Über das Amm Lab Das Amm Lab (Amm) unter der Leitung von Prof. Charlotte Bunne von der EPFL, befindet sich an der Schnittstelle von Informatik, Künstlicher Intelligenz und biomedizinischen Anwendungen. Das Labor ist sowohl mit der School of Computer and Communication Sciences als auch mit der School of Life Sciences sowie dem EPFL AI Center verbunden. Positionsübersicht Wir rekrutieren einen Postdoc mit starker Expertise in der modernen KI, insbesondere die Entwicklung generativer KI-Technologien wie Diffusionsmodelle, Flow Matching, generative Transformatoren oder verwandte Architekturen. Die Position ist hoch methodisch und konzentriert sich auf die Entwicklung neuer generativer Modellierungsansätze, skalierbarer Trainingsalgorithmen und Fundamentmodelltechnologien. Die Rolle ist geeignet für Kandidaten mit einem starken maschinellen Lernhintergrund, die sich freuen, den Stand der Technik in der generativen KI weiter voranzutreiben. Die Position bietet einen engagierten Zugang zum Schweizerischen Nationalen Supercomputing Center und der Schweizer AI-Initiative und bietet Möglichkeiten für die Zusammenarbeit in KI, Wissenschaft und Industrie. Forschungsrichtung Forschungsrichtung: - Generative KI: Entwicklung von Diffusionsmodellen, Flow Matching, Autore-Gigine-Modelle, Normalisierung von Strömungen oder verwandten generativen Architekturen. - Stiftungsmodellentwicklung: neuartige Vortrainingsziele, skalierbare Architekturen, Tokenisierung und Modellanpassungsstrategien. - Skalierbares KI-Training: verteilte Schulung, effiziente Feinabstimmung, Auswertung und Einsatz auf großformatigen Rechengeräten. - Multimodales Lernen: Repräsentationslernen und generative Modellierung über heterogene Datenmodalitäten. - KI für wissenschaftliche Entdeckung: methodische Fortschritte mit potenziellen Anwendungen über biomedizinische und wissenschaftliche Bereiche hinweg.
• Anforderungen Wir suchen Kandidaten mit - einem Doktorat in Maschinenbau, Informatik, angewandter Mathematik, Statistik, Physik, Ingenieurwesen oder einem eng verwandten Bereich, abgeschlossen oder in der Nähe abgeschlossen. - Nachweis der Expertise in generativen KI, wie Diffusionsmodelle, Flow Matching, Normalisierung von Strömungen, VAEs, generative Transformatoren oder verwandte Methoden. - Starke Programmierfähigkeiten und Erfahrung mit modernen Deep-Learning-Frameworks. - Erfahrung mit groß angelegten Modelltrainings, verteilten Schulungen oder substantiellen Berechnungen. - Starke Publikationsrekorde auf hochkarätigen Machine-Learning-Konferenzen und/oder einschlägigen wissenschaftlichen Zeitschriften. - Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Begeisterung für ambitionierte, interdisziplinäre KI-Forschung. Startdatum: idealerweise Herbst 2026, mit späteren Startterminen nach Absprache möglich. Kontakt Um sich zu bewerben, senden Sie bitte einen Lebenslauf, eine kurze Stellungnahme der Forschungsinteressen (1 Seite) und die Namen von zwei Referenzen. Weitere Informationen über aim.epfl.ch. Bewerbungen werden rolling-basiert geprüft.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Généralités

Le laboratoire d'intelligence artificielle en médecine moléculaire (AIMM), dirigé par Prof. Charlotte Bunne à l'EPFL, est à l'interface de l'informatique, de l'intelligence artificielle et des applications biomédicales. Le laboratoire est affilié à la School of Computer and Communication Sciences et à la School of Life Sciences, ainsi qu'au Centre AI de l'EPFL.

Nous recrutons un chercheur postdoctoral ayant une solide expertise dans l'IA moderne, en particulier le développement de technologies d'IA génératrices telles que les modèles de diffusion, l'appariement des flux, les transformateurs générateurs ou les architectures connexes. La position est hautement méthodologique et se concentre sur le développement de nouvelles approches de modélisation générative, des algorithmes de formation évolutive et des technologies de modèles de base.

Le rôle est adapté aux candidats ayant une solide formation en apprentissage automatique qui sont excités à faire progresser l'état de l'art dans l'IA générative. Il n'est pas nécessaire d'avoir une expérience préalable des données biologiques ou biomédicales. Le poste est doté d'un accès dédié au Centre national de supercomputation suisse et à l'Initiative suisse de l'IA, et offre des possibilités de collaboration entre l'IA, la science et l'industrie.

Les orientations de recherche comprennent :

• AI générative: développement de modèles de diffusion, adéquation des flux, modèles autorégressifs, flux de normalisation, ou architectures génératrices connexes.

• Développement de modèles de fondation : nouveaux objectifs de préformation, architectures évolutives, tokenisation et stratégies d'adaptation de modèles.

• Formation à l'IA évolutive : formation distribuée, réglage fin efficace, évaluation et déploiement sur calcul à grande échelle.

• Apprentissage multimodal: apprentissage de la représentation et modélisation générative selon des modalités de données hétérogènes.

• L'IA pour la découverte scientifique: progrès méthodologiques avec des applications potentielles dans les domaines biomédical et scientifique.

Nous cherchons des candidats avec

• Un doctorat en apprentissage automatique, en informatique, en mathématiques appliquées, en statistique, en physique, en génie ou dans un domaine étroitement lié, terminé ou presque terminé.

• Expertise démontrée en IA générative, comme les modèles de diffusion, l'appariement des flux, la normalisation des flux, les EAV, les transformateurs génératifs ou les méthodes connexes.

• Bonnes compétences en programmation et expérience avec des cadres modernes d'apprentissage profond.

• Expérience de la formation de modèles à grande échelle, de la formation distribuée ou de la formation de calcul substantiel.

• Une solide publication lors de conférences d'apprentissage automatique de haut niveau et/ou de revues scientifiques pertinentes.

• Excellentes compétences en communication et enthousiasme pour la recherche ambitieuse et interdisciplinaire sur l'IA.

Nous offrons

• Salaire postdoc compétitif de l'EPFL et prestations sociales complètes.

• Allocation de calcul dédiée au CSCS et à l'Initiative suisse d'IA.

• Un environnement de recherche méthodologiquement ambitieux à l'interface de l'IA générative, des modèles de fondation et de l'IA scientifique.

• Possibilités de collaboration avec des partenaires universitaires et industriels.

• Mentorship vers une carrière universitaire ou de recherche industrielle indépendante.

• Un environnement international et collaboratif dans l'une des grandes universités techniques européennes

Taux d'activité : 100%.

Date de début : idéalement Automne 2026, avec des dates de début ultérieures possibles par arrangement.

Pour postuler, veuillez envoyer un CV, un bref énoncé des intérêts de recherche (1 page) et le nom de deux références. Plus d'informations via aimm.epfl.ch . Les demandes sont examinées en continu.

General

The Artificial Intelligence in Molecular Medicine (AIMM) Lab, led by Prof. Charlotte Bunne at EPFL, sits at the interface of computer science and the life sciences, affiliated with both the School of Computer and Communication Sciences and the School of Life Sciences, as well as the EPFL AI Center.

We are recruiting two postdoctoral researchers with strong expertise in large-scale AI development and a background in biology . The positions cover the full stack of biological foundation model research: from core architecture design and pretraining at scale to integration into agentic interfaces. Both roles involve close collaboration with pharmaceutical industry partners and come with dedicated access to the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS) and the Swiss AI Initiative.

Research directions include

• Foundation model architecture development: novel pretraining objectives, tokenization, and scalable architectures for biological data.

• Multimodal learning: representation learning across diverse biological data modalities.

• Agentic interfaces: integrating foundation models into reasoning and decision-support systems.

• Translational applications: bridging foundation model research towards impact in early drug-discovery and biomedical sciences.

We are looking for candidates with

• A PhD in machine learning, computer science, computational biology, or a closely related field (completed or near completion).

• Demonstrated experience in largescale AI development, including pretraining, finetuning, or scaling on substantial compute.

• A solid biological background; familiarity with biological data modalities is expected.

• A strong publication record at toptier ML conferences and/or life science journals.

• Excellent communication skills and enthusiasm for interdisciplinary research.

We offer

• Competitive EPFL postdoc salary and full social benefits.

• Dedicated compute allocation on CSCS and the Swiss AI Initiative.

• Direct collaboration with pharmaceutical industry partners.

• Mentorship toward an independent academic or industry research career.

• An international, collaborative environment at one of Europe's leading technical universities.

Start date : ideally Fall 2026, with later start dates possible by arrangement.

jobs.description:
Mission

The LSBI is a multidisciplinary group at the crossroads of engineering and biology. Our research explores materials, technology and integration of soft bioelectronic interfaces and electronic skins. We design, fabricate and characterise stretchable devices, and implement them in ultra-compliant circuitry and soft bioelectronic interfaces. Our field of applications ranges from neuroelectronic devices for neuroprosthetics, to wearable sensors and actuators, as well as soft in vitro interfaces.

The Postdoc will contribute to the development and verification of an optoelectronic therapy for bladder dysfunction .

More specifically, he/she will be responsible for overseeing the in vivo testing, optimization and functional verification of optoelectronic devices based on µLED’s assembled on compliant substrates.

The Postdoc will join a multidisciplinary team including micro-/neuro- technologists, neuroscientists, and molecular biologists.

We are looking for an excellent candidate with a high level of motivation, independence and capacity for teamwork.

Main duties and responsibilities

In this position, the Postdoc will have a broad set of responsibilities including:

• Lead the optimization, application and verification of an optoelectronic implant for bladder dysfunction in rodent models

• Collect and analyse electrophysiological and behavioural data

• Histologically evaluate tissue following chronic implantation

• Work independently and as part of a collaborative team to plan and execute experiments

• Maintain knowledge of published developments in research field and recommend alternative strategies

• Plan and organize workload to meet project milestones and timelines

• Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of experimental methods and outcomes in lab books and written reports

• Communicate research updates and outcomes effectively through verbal presentations at lab meetings and conferences

• Contribute to scientific publications as well as to patents

Qualifications

• PhD in neuroscience, neuroengineering, or related field

• Relevant experience in preclinical neuroscience using implanted interfaces

Mission The LSBI is a multidisciplinary group at the crossroads of engineering and biology. Our research explores materials, technology and integration of soft bioelectronic interfaces and electronic skins. We design, fabricate and characterise stretchable devices, and implement them in ultra-compliant circuitry and soft bioelectronic interfaces. Our field of applications ranges from neuroelectronic devices for neuroprosthetics, to wearable sensors and actuators, as well as soft in vitro interfaces. The Postdoc will contribute to the development and verification of an optoelectronic therapy for bladder dysfunction. More specifically, he/she will be responsible for overseeing the in vivo testing, optimization and functional verification of optoelectronic devices based on µLED’s assembled on compliant substrates. The Postdoc will join a multidisciplinary team including micro-/neuro- technologists, neuroscientists, and molecular biologists. We are looking for an excellent candidate with a high level of motivation, independence and capacity for teamwork. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Mission

Le LSBI est un groupe multidisciplinaire au carrefour de l'ingénierie et de la biologie. Notre recherche explore les matériaux, la technologie et l'intégration des interfaces bioélectroniques douces et des peaux électroniques. Nous concevons, fabriquons et caractérisons des appareils extensibles et les implémentons dans des circuits ultra-conformes et des interfaces bioélectroniques douces. Notre champ d'application va des appareils neuroélectroniques pour la neuroprothèse, aux capteurs et actionneurs portables, ainsi qu'aux interfaces in vitro douces.

Le Postdoc contribuera au développement et à la vérification d'une thérapie optoélectronique pour le dysfonctionnement de la vessie.

Plus précisément, il sera chargé de superviser les essais in vivo, l'optimisation et la vérification fonctionnelle des dispositifs optoélectroniques basés sur les μLED.

Le Postdoc se joindra à une équipe multidisciplinaire comprenant des micro-/neuro-technologues, des neuroscientifiques et des biologistes moléculaires.

Nous cherchons un excellent candidat avec un haut niveau de motivation, d'indépendance et de capacité de travail en équipe.

Principales tâches et responsabilités

Dans ce poste, le Postdoc aura un large éventail de responsabilités, notamment :

• Diriger l'optimisation, l'application et la vérification d'un implant optoélectronique pour le dysfonctionnement de la vessie chez les modèles rongeurs

• Collecte et analyse de données électrophysiologiques et comportementales

• Évaluation histologique des tissus après implantation chronique

• Travailler de manière indépendante et dans le cadre d'une équipe collaborative pour planifier et exécuter des expériences

• Maintenir la connaissance des développements publiés dans le domaine de la recherche et recommander d'autres stratégies

• Planifier et organiser la charge de travail pour respecter les jalons et les échéances du projet

• Conserver une documentation précise et détaillée des méthodes expérimentales et des résultats dans les livres de laboratoire et les rapports écrits

• Communiquer efficacement les mises à jour et les résultats de la recherche au moyen de présentations verbales lors de réunions et de conférences en laboratoire

• Contribuer aux publications scientifiques et aux brevets

Compétences

• Doctorat en neuroscience, neuroingénierie ou domaine connexe

• Expérience pertinente en neurosciences précliniques utilisant des interfaces implantées

• Expertise en techniques d'électrophysiologie, y compris des enregistrements in vivo de l'activité neuronale (potentiels locaux sur le terrain), enregistrements EMG

• Expérience des techniques chirurgicales et comportementales complexes dans les modèles rongeurs

• Familiarité avec l'optogénétique (préféré)

• Connaissance pratique des méthodes histologiques et de la microscopie fluorescente (préféré)

• Une attitude ouverte, proactive, de résolution de problèmes avec un fort sentiment d'appropriation et de dynamisme

• Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante, tout en contribuant efficacement à un environnement d'équipe collaborative

• Efficace, flexible, avec de solides compétences organisationnelles et de gestion du temps

• Le français est un plus

Nous offrons

• Une occasion de travailler sur un projet de pointe en neurosciences et en neurotechnologie au sein d'une communauté d'ingénieurs, de neuroscientifiques et de médecins de calibre mondial.

• Un environnement de travail dynamique, multidisciplinaire, international et collaboratif basé sur le Campus Biotech de l'EPFL à Genève.

• L'EPFL est une institution d'ingénierie de calibre international et mondial qui abrite des installations expérimentales et informatiques de pointe, une communauté scientifique et entrepreneuriale riche et dynamique.

Seules les demandes soumises par l'intermédiaire de la plateforme en ligne sont prises en considération.

jobs.description:
Description

The Industry Liaison Officer develops, supports and nurtures a trustful relationship between EPFL's industrial partners and EPFL ecosystem. You will be responsible for establishing and maintaining long-term relationship between industrial accounts and EPFL. You will be able to identify needs and requirements to develop industry – academia collaboration. You will be the privileged point of contact for all kinds of collaboration models. You will work with other EPFL services and entities to promote EPFL's research competencies and innovation capabilities.

Mission

In this position, you will be part of the Industrial Liaison Office and work closely with all the units of the Vice-Presidency for Innovation and Impact (VPI), developing a solid knowledge of the EPFL Innovation ecosystem, including research laboratories, students and startups, to become a privileged point of contact for a portfolio of companies and a trusted point of contact for researchers. In addition, you will contribute to the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of EPFL Open Innovation Program, creating value for participating companies while strengthening long-term engagement with EPFL.

Main duties and responsibilities

• Foster trustful relationship with a portfolio of companies having a long-term relationship with EPFL.

• Build relationships with new industry partners.

• Actively contribute to the design, delivery and continuous improvement of our Open Innovation Program, ensuring a high-value experience for participating companies and alignment with institutional objectives.

• Acquire a thorough understanding of companies and professors' needs and ensure appropriate collaboration models and services are developed and delivered. Link to other EPFL entities depending on the needs.

• Acquire a strong knowledge and understanding of EPFL ecosystem for helping companies to identify the right partners for their innovation projects

• Be proactive in proposing new potential collaboration opportunities by following EPFL research activities.

• Resolve any issues and problems the partner faces and deal with complaints to maintain trust and enrich existing collaboration.

• Serve as the communication link between companies, researchers, EPFL & VPI teams and services.

• Represent the VPI and organize industrial visits.

• Prepare regular reports of progress and forecasts using key account metrics.

Other activities

• Support the different VPI and EPFL industry support programs and contribute developing new services for VPI and EPFL.

Profile

• Scientific or engineering background (Master degree, Ph.D. a plus), with a specialization in Life Sciences.

• Passion for science and technology-driven innovation

• Three to five years of relevant experience and/or training or equivalent combination.

• Former experience in product development and/or innovation management in a technology company.

• Experience in providing solutions based on customer needs.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills with aptitude in building relationships with professionals of all organization levels and different cultures.

• Excellent organizational skills and ability in problem-solving and negotiation.

• Excellent presentation skills.

• Languages: Fluency in English and French is required, and other languages (e.g., German/) would be a plus.

• Team player, autonomous, curious with a strong commitment to results.

We offer

• Collaborative and innovative work environment.

• Access to a diverse and dynamic community of researchers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.

• A stimulating and friendly work atmosphere with excellent working conditions.

• An inclusive workspace and equal opportunities for all.

Remark

Only candidates who applied through EPFL website or our partner Jobup’s website will be considered. Files sent by agencies without a mandate will not be taken into account.

Informations

Contract Start Date : 09/01/2026

Activity Rate M

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione

L'Industry Liaison Officer sviluppa, sostiene e alimenta un rapporto di fiducia tra i partner industriali dell'EPFL e l'ecosistema EPFL. Sarete responsabili di stabilire e mantenere il rapporto a lungo termine tra conti industriali e EPFL. Sarete in grado di identificare le esigenze e i requisiti per sviluppare l'industria – collaborazione accademica. Sarete il punto di contatto privilegiato per tutti i tipi di modelli di collaborazione. Potrai lavorare con altri servizi e entità EPFL per promuovere le competenze di ricerca e le capacità di innovazione di EPFL.

Missione

In questa posizione, sarai parte dell'Ufficio di collegamento industriale e lavorerai a stretto contatto con tutte le unità della Vice-Presidenza per l'innovazione e l'impatto (VPI), sviluppando una solida conoscenza dell'ecosistema di innovazione EPFL, tra cui laboratori di ricerca, studenti e startup, per diventare un punto di contatto privilegiato per un portafoglio di aziende e un punto di contatto affidabile per i ricercatori. Inoltre, contribuirai alla progettazione, alla consegna e al miglioramento continuo del programma EPFL Open Innovation, creando valore per le aziende partecipanti, rafforzando l'impegno a lungo termine con EPFL.

Principali doveri e responsabilità

• Promuovere un rapporto fidato con un portafoglio di aziende che hanno un rapporto a lungo termine con EPFL.

• Costruire relazioni con nuovi partner del settore.

• Contribuisci attivamente alla progettazione, alla consegna e al miglioramento continuo del nostro Open Innovation Program, garantendo un'esperienza di alto valore per le aziende partecipanti e l'allineamento con gli obiettivi istituzionali.

• Acquisire una comprensione approfondita delle esigenze delle aziende e dei professori e garantire modelli e servizi di collaborazione appropriati sono sviluppati e consegnati. Link ad altre entità EPFL a seconda delle esigenze.

• Acquisire una forte conoscenza e comprensione dell'ecosistema EPFL per aiutare le aziende a identificare i partner giusti per i loro progetti di innovazione

• Siate proattivi nel proporre nuove potenziali opportunità di collaborazione seguendo le attività di ricerca EPFL.

• Risolvere eventuali problemi e problemi che il partner affronta e affrontare reclami per mantenere la fiducia e arricchire la collaborazione esistente.

• Servire come collegamento di comunicazione tra aziende, ricercatori, team e servizi EPFL & VPI.

• Rappresentare il VPI e organizzare visite industriali.

• Preparare rapporti regolari di progresso e previsioni utilizzando metriche di conto chiave.

Altre attività

• Sostenere i diversi programmi di supporto del settore VPI e EPFL e contribuire a sviluppare nuovi servizi per VPI e EPFL.

Profilo

• Sfondo scientifico o ingegneristico (Master Degree, Ph.D. a plus), con una specializzazione in Scienze della Vita.

• Passione per la scienza e l'innovazione tecnologica

• Da tre a cinque anni di esperienza e/o formazione o combinazione equivalente.

• Ex esperienza nello sviluppo del prodotto e/o nella gestione dell'innovazione in un'azienda tecnologica.

• Esperienza nella fornitura di soluzioni basate sulle esigenze del cliente.

• Forte comunicazione e competenze interpersonali con aptitude nella costruzione di relazioni con i professionisti di tutti i livelli di organizzazione e culture diverse.

• Eccellente capacità organizzativa e capacità di problem solving e negoziazione.

• Eccellente capacità di presentazione.

• Lingue: È richiesta la fluenza in inglese e francese, e altre lingue (ad esempio, tedesco/) sarebbero un plus.

• Giocatore di squadra, autonomo, curioso con un forte impegno per i risultati.

Offriamo

• Ambiente di lavoro collaborativo e innovativo.

• Accesso a una comunità diversificata e dinamica di ricercatori, imprenditori ed esperti del settore.

• Un ambiente di lavoro stimolante e amichevole con eccellenti condizioni di lavoro.

• Uno spazio di lavoro inclusivo e pari opportunità per tutti.

Osservazioni

Saranno considerati solo i candidati che hanno applicato il sito web EPFL o il sito web del nostro partner Jobup. I file inviati da agenzie senza mandato non saranno presi in considerazione.

Informazioni

Data di inizio del contratto: 09/01/2026

Tasso di attività M

Mission In dieser Position werden Sie Teil des Industrial Liaison Office und arbeiten eng mit allen Einheiten der Vize-Präsidentschaft für Innovation und Wirkung (VPI) zusammen, um ein solides Wissen über das EPFL Innovation Ökosystem zu entwickeln, einschließlich Forschungslabors, Studenten und Startups, um ein privilegierter Ansprechpartner für ein Portfolio von Unternehmen und ein vertrauenswürdiger Ansprechpartner für Forscher zu werden. Darüber hinaus werden Sie zur Gestaltung, Lieferung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung des EPFL Open Innovation Program beitragen, wodurch Sie Wert für teilnehmende Unternehmen schaffen und gleichzeitig die langfristige Zusammenarbeit mit EPFL stärken. Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten - Förderung vertrauensvolle Beziehung zu einem Portfolio von Unternehmen, die eine langfristige Beziehung mit EPFL haben. - Aufbau von Beziehungen zu neuen Industriepartnern. - Aktiv zur Gestaltung, Bereitstellung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unseres Open Innovation Programms beitragen, um eine hochwertige Erfahrung für teilnehmende Unternehmen und die Ausrichtung auf institutionelle Ziele zu gewährleisten. - Erwerben Sie ein gründliches Verständnis der Bedürfnisse von Unternehmen und Professoren und gewährleisten Sie, dass geeignete Kooperationsmodelle und -dienste entwickelt und bereitgestellt werden. - Erwirb ein starkes Wissen und Verständnis über EPFL-Ökosystem, um Unternehmen bei der Identifizierung der richtigen Partner für ihre Innovationsprojekte zu helfen - Sei proaktiv bei der Einreichung neuer potenzieller Kooperationsmöglichkeiten, indem du EPFL-Forschungsaktivitäten folgst. - Lösen Sie Probleme und Probleme, mit denen der Partner konfrontiert ist, und behandeln Sie Beschwerden, um das Vertrauen zu erhalten und die bestehende Zusammenarbeit zu bereichern. - Serve as the communication link between companies, forschers, EPFL & VPI teams and services. - Vertreten Sie den VPI und organisieren Sie industrielle Besuche. - Vorbereitung regelmäßiger Berichte über Fortschritte und Prognosen mit Hilfe von Key Account Metriken. Andere Aktivitäten - Unterstützung der verschiedenen VPI- und EPFL-Industrie-Support-Programme und die Entwicklung neuer Dienstleistungen für VPI und EPFL. Profil - Wissenschaftlicher oder technischer Hintergrund (Master-Abschluss, Ph.D. a plus), mit einer Spezialisierung auf Life Sciences. - Leidenschaft für Wissenschaft und technologiegetriebene Innovation - Drei bis fünf Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung und/oder Ausbildung oder gleichwertige Kombination. - Ehemalige Erfahrung in der Produktentwicklung und/oder Innovationsmanagement in einem Technologieunternehmen. - Erfahrung in der Bereitstellung von Lösungen auf der Grundlage der Kundenbedürfnisse. - Starke Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten mit Eignung in der Herstellung von Beziehungen mit Fachleuten aller Organisationsebenen und verschiedenen Kulturen. - Ausgezeichnete organisatorische Fähigkeiten und Fähigkeiten in Problemlösung und Verhandlungen. - Ausgezeichnete Präsentation Fähigkeiten. - Sprachen: Fluency in Englisch und Französisch erforderlich ist, und andere Sprachen (z.B. jobs.description:
Mission

Le CMi est une plateforme technologique dotée d’un important parc d’équipements de micro- et de nano- fabrication. Une équipe pluridisciplinaire de 25 personnes est en charge d’en assurer le fonctionnement et l’évolution. La plateforme accueille annuellement plus de 650 utilisateurs, principalement des doctorants de l’EPFL, et aussi des postdocs, des étudiants, des chercheurs internes et externes, ainsi que des industriels, qui réalisent tous eux-mêmes leurs procédés. Les challenges sont multiples, que ceci soit pour offrir des procédés du plus haut niveau, satisfaisant aux besoins de la recherche, pour assurer les formations, pour offrir une expertise et des conseils très larges, ou pour garantir la sécurité. Rapportant au responsable de l’équipe des ingénieurs des procédés, vous collaborez étroitement avec l’ensemble de l’équipe existante et pluridisciplinaire des ingénieurs et des techniciens. Nous cherchons une personne avec des connaissances de base solides, prête à s’investir et à progresser rapidement pour réaliser des interventions techniques et scientifiques exigeantes.

Principales tâches et responsabilités

• Former les utilisateurs sur les équipements.

• Conseiller les utilisateurs sur les meilleurs choix technologiques.

• Acquérir, installer, qualifier et exploiter des équipements dont la valeur dépasse le million de francs

• Travailler avec des prestataires externes.

• Documenter les équipements et les procédés.

Profil

Profil recherché :

• Master of sciences, ou titre jugé équivalent.

• Idéalement avec de l’expérience :

• dans les domaines CVD, PVD ou galvanoplastie.

• en métrologie des couches minces.

Compétences personnelles et sociales :

• Excellentes aptitudes à communiquer.

• Sens aigu du service.

• Esprit d'initiative.

• Rigueur et autonomie dans le travail.

• Capacité à travailler en équipe, ouvert d’esprit et engagé.

• Grand sens pratique.

• Résistance au stress.

Compétences Linguistiques :

• Très bonnes connaissances en français (lu, écrit, parlé), niveau équivalent C1.

• Bonnes connaissances en anglais (lu, écrit, parlé), niveau équivalent B2.

Nous offrons

• La possibilité d’intégrer une équipe dynamique et stimulante.

• Un environnement de travail multiculturel et académique de qualité.

• Des possibilités de formation continue.

• Un travail sur des équipements industriels dans une salle blanche évolutive de clase ISO5.

Informations

Date d'entrée en fonction : de suite ou à convenir

Taux d'occupation 100%

Type de contrat : CDD

Durée : 1 an renouvelable

Informations complémentaires : https://cmi.epfl.ch/

descriptionByLocale.en:
Mission The CMi is a technological platform with a large fleet of micro- and nano-manufacturing equipment. A multidisciplinary team of 25 people is responsible for ensuring its operation and development. The platform welcomes more than 650 users annually, mainly doctoral students from EPFL, and also postdocs, students, internal and external researchers, as well as industrialists, all of whom carry out their own processes. The challenges are multiple, whether to offer processes of the highest level, meeting research needs, to provide training, to offer very broad expertise and advice, or to guarantee security. Reporting to the head of the process engineering team, you will work closely with the entire existing, multidisciplinary team of engineers and technicians. We are looking for a person with solid basic knowledge, ready to invest and progress quickly to carry out demanding technical and scientific interventions. Main tasks and responsibilities
• Train users on the equipment.
• Advise users on the best technological choices.
• Acquire, install, qualify and operate equipment whose value exceeds one million francs
• Work with external service providers.
• Document equipment and processes. Profile Profile sought:
• Master of sciences, or title deemed equivalent.
• Ideally with experience:
• in the fields of CVD, PVD or electroplating.
• in thin layer metrology. Personal and Social Skills:
• Excellent communication skills.
• Strong sense of service.
• Spirit of initiative.
• Rigor and autonomy in the work.
• Ability to work in a team, open-minded and committed.
• Great practical sense.
• Resistance to stress. Linguistic Skills:
• Very good knowledge of French (read, written, spoken), C1 equivalent level.
• Good knowledge of English (read, written, spoken), B2 equivalent level. We offer
• The opportunity to join a dynamic and stimulating team.
• A quality multicultural and academic working environment.
• Continuing education opportunities.
• Work on industrial equipment in a scalable ISO5 class clean room. Information Start date: immediately or to be agreed Occupancy rate 100% Contract type: CDD Duration: 1 year renewable Additional information: https://cmi.epfl.ch/

jobs.description:
Mission

We are offering two challenging positions as a full-time (100%) PhD Student at ENAC at EPFL, Lausanne, Switzerland. Our Laboratory EESD is focused on investigating the seismic behavior of reinforced concrete and unreinforced masonry buildings. Our approaches include numerical and mechanical modeling, large-scale testing as well as data-driven methods. The PhD candidates will contribute to advancing the understanding of the seismic behavior of historic brick masonry building aggregates through a combination of large-scale experimental testing, field investigations, and numerical simulations. The research will focus on the behavior and interaction of buildings within masonry aggregates, supporting the development of innovative assessment approaches and resilient retrofit solutions for historic urban environments exposed to earthquake risk.

You will be working on the ZAGGREGATE project, a collaborative research initiative between EPFL, University of Zagreb, and other academic and professional partners. The project aims to improve the understanding, assessment and rehabilitation of historic masonry building aggregates in seismic regions. The successful candidates will join a team of researchers working at the interface of structural engineering, earthquake engineering, and heritage conservation, and will have opportunities for collaboration and research visits in Croatia.

Main duties and responsibilities

As a PhD student you will be expected to:

• Conduct original doctoral research using experimental, numerical, and analytical methods to investigate the seismic response of masonry buildings as stand-alone buildings and within aggregates

• Contribute to the development of innovative assessment methodologies and resilient retrofit strategies for historic urban environments exposed to earthquake hazard

• Collaborating with project partners at EPFL, the University of Zagreb, and other international institutions

• Disseminating research findings through scientific publications and conference presentations

• Have full responsibility for your own dissertation

• Participating in education and co-supervise student projects

Profile

• A MSc degree (or equivalent) in Civil Engineering with a focus on Structural Engineering

• Experience or strong interest in experimental and/or numerical methods in structural engineering

• Interest in traditional construction techniques and interdisciplinary collaboration (engineering, heritage, architecture)

• Self-motivated, independent, and collaborative mindset with a high level of rigor for academic research work

• Excellent communication skills in English (written and spoken) and willingness to work as part of a team

• Familiarity with Python, MATLAB or similar for data analysis

• Familiarity with numerical modeling tools (e.g. OpenSees, Abaqus, DIANA) is an asset

We offer

• A stimulating and international working environment

• Competitive salary and excellent working conditions, 1-year fixed-term contract (CDD), renewable for 3 years (4 years in total) to complete your PhD; more information can be found on our website

• You will be part of the EDCE doctoral program

• Opportunity to perform state-of-the-art research in one of the most dynamic scientific institutions in Europe

• Opportunity to interact with internationally renowned experts, and with a strong team of postdoctoral researchers and PhD students

• Opportunity to conduct meaningful research bridging engineering, cultural heritage, and development

Informations

The selection process involves multiple stages, and short-listed candidates will be requested to apply to a specific EPFL Doctoral Program to qualify for a PhD at EPFL, i.e. Doctoral School of Civil and Environmental Engineering (EDCE) .
Please check this page for additional information on admission.

Please note that this is a separate application process necessary to be eligible to complete your PhD at EPFL.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione Offriamo due posizioni stimolanti come dottorando a tempo pieno (100%) presso l'ENAC presso l'EPFL, Losanna, Svizzera. Il nostro Laboratorio EESD è focalizzato sullo studio del comportamento sismico degli edifici in cemento armato e muratura non armata. I nostri approcci includono modellazione numerica e meccanica, test su larga scala e metodi basati sui dati. I dottorandi contribuiranno a migliorare la comprensione del comportamento sismico degli aggregati edilizi storici in muratura attraverso una combinazione di prove sperimentali su larga scala, indagini sul campo e simulazioni numeriche. La ricerca si concentrerà sul comportamento e sull’interazione degli edifici all’interno degli aggregati di muratura, supportando lo sviluppo di approcci di valutazione innovativi e soluzioni di retrofit resilienti per ambienti urbani storici esposti al rischio sismico. Lavorerai al progetto ZAGGREGATE, un'iniziativa di ricerca collaborativa tra EPFL, Università di Zagabria e altri partner accademici e professionali. Il progetto mira a migliorare la comprensione, la valutazione e la riabilitazione degli aggregati edilizi in muratura storica nelle regioni sismiche. I candidati prescelti entreranno a far parte di un team di ricercatori che lavorano all'interfaccia tra ingegneria strutturale, ingegneria sismica e conservazione del patrimonio e avranno opportunità di collaborazione e visite di ricerca in Croazia. Principali compiti e responsabilità Come dottorando dovrai:
• Condurre ricerche di dottorato originali utilizzando metodi sperimentali, numerici e analitici per studiare la risposta sismica degli edifici in muratura come edifici autonomi e all'interno di aggregati
• Contribuire allo sviluppo di metodologie di valutazione innovative e strategie di retrofit resilienti per ambienti urbani storici esposti al rischio di terremoto
• Collaborare con i partner di progetto presso l'EPFL, l'Università di Zagabria e altre istituzioni internazionali
• Divulgare i risultati della ricerca attraverso pubblicazioni scientifiche e presentazioni a conferenze
• Avere pieno responsabilità per la propria tesi
• Partecipare alla formazione e co-supervisionare progetti degli studenti Profilo
• Una laurea magistrale (o equivalente) in ingegneria civile con particolare attenzione all'ingegneria strutturale
• Esperienza o forte interesse per metodi sperimentali e/o numerici nell'ingegneria strutturale
• Interesse per le tecniche di costruzione tradizionali e la collaborazione interdisciplinare (ingegneria, patrimonio, architettura)
• Mentalità automotivata, indipendente e collaborativa con un alto livello di rigore per il lavoro di ricerca accademica
• Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione in inglese (scritto e parlato) e disponibilità a lavorare come parte di un team
• Familiarità con Python, MATLAB o simili per l'analisi dei dati

Mission

We are offering two challenging positions as a full-time (100%) PhD Student at ENAC at EPFL, Lausanne, Switzerland. Our Laboratory EESD is focused on investigating the seismic behavior of reinforced concrete and unreinforced masonry buildings. Our approaches include numerical and mechanical modeling, large-scale testing as well as data-driven methods. The PhD candidates will contribute to advancing the understanding of the seismic behavior of historic brick masonry building aggregates through a combination of large-scale experimental testing, field investigations, and numerical simulations. The research will focus on the behavior and interaction of buildings within masonry aggregates, supporting the development of innovative assessment approaches and resilient retrofit solutions for historic urban environments exposed to earthquake risk.

You will be working on the ZAGGREGATE project, a collaborative research initiative between EPFL, University of Zagreb, and other academic and professional partners. The project aims to improve the understanding, assessment and rehabilitation of historic masonry building aggregates in seismic regions. The successful candidates will join a team of researchers working at the interface of structural engineering, earthquake engineering, and heritage conservation, and will have opportunities for collaboration and research visits in Croatia.

Main duties and responsibilities

As a PhD student you will be expected to:

• Conduct original doctoral research using experimental, numerical, and analytical methods to investigate the seismic response of masonry buildings as stand-alone buildings and within aggregates

• Contribute to the development of innovative assessment methodologies and resilient retrofit strategies for historic urban environments exposed to earthquake hazard

• Collaborating with project partners at EPFL, the University of Zagreb, and other international institutions

• Disseminating research findings through scientific publications and conference presentations

• Have full responsibility for your own dissertation

• Participating in education and co-supervise student projects

Profile

• A MSc degree (or equivalent) in Civil Engineering with a focus on Structural Engineering

• Experience or strong interest in experimental and/or numerical methods in structural engineering

• Interest in traditional construction techniques and interdisciplinary collaboration (engineering, heritage, architecture)

• Self-motivated, independent, and collaborative mindset with a high level of rigor for academic research work

• Excellent communication skills in English (written and spoken) and willingness to work as part of a team

• Familiarity with Python, MATLAB or similar for data analysis

• Familiarity with numerical modeling tools (e.g. OpenSees, Abaqus, DIANA) is an asset

We offer

• A stimulating and international working environment

• Competitive salary and excellent working conditions, 1-year fixed-term contract (CDD), renewable for 3 years (4 years in total) to complete your PhD; more information can be found on our website

• You will be part of the EDCE doctoral program

• Opportunity to perform state-of-the-art research in one of the most dynamic scientific institutions in Europe

• Opportunity to interact with internationally renowned experts, and with a strong team of postdoctoral researchers and PhD students

• Opportunity to conduct meaningful research bridging engineering, cultural heritage, and development

Informations

The selection process involves multiple stages, and short-listed candidates will be requested to apply to a specific EPFL Doctoral Program to qualify for a PhD at EPFL, i.e. Doctoral School of Civil and Environmental Engineering (EDCE) .
Please check this page for additional information on admission.

Please note that this is a separate application process necessary to be eligible to complete your PhD at EPFL.

jobs.description:
Mission

We are offering a full-time (100%) PhD Student at the Laboratory for the Chemistry of Materials and Manufacturing (ALCHEMY) at EPFL Neuchatel. At EPFL ALCHEMY, we are focused on developing accessible chemistries and processing strategies that can enable the fabrication of a wide variety of advanced functional materials and devices.

A core area of research in ALCHEMY is the development of methods for converting 3D printed polymers into metals. We previously pioneered a technology called Hydrogel Infusion Additive Manufacturing (HIAM) that is capable of transforming polymers into composites, ceramics, and metals (Composites: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.matt.2026.102809 , https://doi.org/10.1021/acsmaterialslett.5c00407 ;Ceramics/Metals: https://doi.org/10.1002/adma.202504951 ).

The goal of this PhD will be to expand the HIAM technology towards new classes of materials. Depending on the candidate, this could include non-oxide ceramics, metal-matrix composites, ceramic-matrix composites, polymer composites, or high entropy alloys. The PhD will span the development of chemistries and processes that result in high quality architected ceramic/metal parts, and the applications of these materials.

Main duties and responsibilities

As a PhD Student, you will be expected to:

• Have full responsibility for your own dissertation

• Research in close collaboration with other lab members and international collaborators;

• Experiment design and execution

• Analyze and interpret experimental results

• Write scientific articles for publication in peer-reviewed journals

• Present at international conferences

• Participate in education and supervise student projects

Profile

• A MSc degree in the fields of materials science, chemistry, or polymer science

• Strong experimental skills and a practical and hands-on mindset

• Experience with materials characterization is required

• Excellent comunication skills in English

• Experience with ceramic and/or metal characterization is a bonus

• Experience with nanoparticle synthesis is a bonus

We offer

• 4 years to complete your PhD with a competitive remuneration

• You will be part of the EDMX, EDAM, or EDCH doctoral program

• An opportunity to develop a scientific career in materials science and additive manufacturing

• A world-class research and training environment with access to state-of-the-art research facilities

• International collaboration and visiting opportunities

• A 1-year fixed-term contract (CDD), renewable for 4 years

Informations

Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered . Please apply by uploading a single PDF file that contains the following:

• Cover/Motivation Letter that detail your past research experiences and your fit for the position

• Detailed CV

• Names and contact information of at least 2 references willing to write recommendation letters for you

The selection process involves multiple stages, and short-listed candidates will be requested to apply to a specific EPFL Doctoral Program to qualify for a PhD at EPFL, i.e. [EDMX, EDAM, or EDCH.

Please note that this is a separate application process necessary to be eligible to complete your PhD at EPFL.

Mission Nous proposons un doctorant à temps plein (100%) au Laboratoire de Chimie des Matériaux et de Fabrication (ALCHIMIE) de l'EPFL Neuchâtel. À l'EPFL ALCHEMY, nous nous concentrons sur le développement de produits chimiques et de stratégies de traitement accessibles qui peuvent permettre la fabrication d'une grande variété de matériaux et de dispositifs fonctionnels avancés. Un domaine de recherche central d’ALCHEMY est le développement de méthodes de conversion de polymères imprimés en 3D en métaux. Nous avons précédemment lancé une technologie appelée Hydrogel Infusion Additive Manufacturing (HIAM) capable de transformer des polymères en composites, céramiques et métaux (Composites : https://doi.org/10.1016/j.matt.2026.102809 , https://doi.org/10.1021/acsmaterialslett.5c00407 ;Ceramics/Metals : https://doi.org/10.1002/adma.202504951 ). L'objectif de cette thèse sera d'étendre la technologie HIAM vers de nouvelles classes de matériaux. Selon le candidat, cela pourrait inclure des céramiques sans oxyde, des composites à matrice métallique, des composites à matrice céramique, des composites polymères ou des alliages à haute entropie. Le doctorat couvrira le développement de produits chimiques et de processus qui aboutissent à des pièces architecturées en céramique/métal de haute qualité, ainsi que les applications de ces matériaux. Principales tâches et responsabilités En tant que doctorant, vous devrez :
• Avoir l'entière responsabilité de votre propre thèse
• Effectuer des recherches en étroite collaboration avec d'autres membres du laboratoire et des collaborateurs internationaux ;
• Conception et exécution d'expériences
• Analyser et interpréter les résultats expérimentaux
• Rédiger des articles scientifiques pour publication dans des revues à comité de lecture
• Présenter à des conférences internationales
• Participer à l'éducation et superviser des projets étudiants Profil
• Une maîtrise dans les domaines de la science des matériaux, de la chimie ou de la science des polymères
• Solides compétences expérimentales et un esprit pratique et pratique
• Une expérience en caractérisation des matériaux est requise
• Excellentes compétences en communication en anglais
• Une expérience en caractérisation de la céramique et/ou des métaux est un bonus
• Une expérience en synthèse de nanoparticules est un bonus Nous offrons
• 4 ans pour compléter votre doctorat avec une rémunération compétitive
• Vous ferez partie du programme de doctorat EDMX, EDAM ou EDCH
• Une opportunité de développer une carrière scientifique en science des matériaux et en fabrication additive
• Un environnement de recherche et de formation de classe mondiale avec accès à des installations de recherche de pointe
• Des opportunités de collaboration et de visite internationales
• Un contrat à durée déterminée (CDD) d'un an, renouvelable pour 4 ans Informations Seules les candidatures soumises via la plateforme en ligne sont prises en considération. Veuillez postuler en téléchargeant un seul fichier PDF contenant les éléments suivants :
• Lettre de motivation/de motivation détaillant vos expériences de recherche passées et votre adéquation au poste

• Noms et coordonnées d'au moins 2 références disposées à rédiger des lettres de recommandation pour vous Le processus de sélection comporte plusieurs étapes et les candidats présélectionnés seront invités à postuler à un programme de doctorat spécifique de l'EPFL pour se qualifier pour un doctorat à l'EPFL, c'est-à-dire [EDMX, EDAM ou EDCH. Veuillez consulter cette page pour plus d'informations sur l'admission. Veuillez noter qu'il s'agit d'un processus de candidature distinct, nécessaire pour pouvoir terminer votre doctorat à l'EPFL. jobs.description:
Mission

The Laboratory of Photonics and Quantum Measurements is seeking a Laboratory Manager to oversee and implement data management and regulatory compliance and support the laboratory’s experimental research. The role involves laboratory organisation, equipment maintenance, documentation management, user support and coordination of shared experimental infrastructure.

Main duties and responsibilities

• Laboratory compliance: help establish and maintain good laboratory practices, user routines, documentation standards, and internal procedures. Maintain the safety, organization and cleanliness of laboratories and storage spaces in compliance with laboratory rules and in coordination with group members. Implement a booking system for lab equipment usage by spin-offs. Organise new setups, lab spaces and renovations (Advanced Science Building). Oversee safety audits and lab safety training for internal and external users.

• Data management and team support: control of laboratory notebooks (TEAMS), management of internal IT simulation software for the laboratory (COMSOL, Lumerical, Ansys and Sonnet) and assist in monitoring and establishing proper documentation of scientific and technical results (via e.g. GIT, Lab/task management software). Initiate weekly laboratory organization meetings with sub-teams. Support the onboarding and training of new students, postdocs, and technical staff in laboratory routines.

• Cleanroom support (fabrication, packaging, and sample flow coordination): liaise with the R&D team and senior processing engineer to ensure the continuity of fabrication-related activities, including nanofabrication tasks, documentation of established processes and techniques, and equipment requests (platform tools), as well as installation and testing. Contribute to maintaining and improving routines for photonic chip packaging, testing, and experimental integration.

• Equipment : assist with purchase orders of large-scale equipment, including commissioning, installation, troubleshooting, maintenance, repairs and upgrades.

• Records management: maintain an internal database of stock/inventory of materials and equipment, as well as a central inventory system.

• Continuous monitoring and innovation management: maintain an orderly environment in the labs (ASANA) and take the lead in adopting the latest technology and software to efficiently document knowledge, samples and research management.

Profile

For this position, we are looking for solution-oriented candidates with the following profile:

• Master’s degree or PhD in EE, Physics or Computer Science

• Attention to detail and passion for organization and efficiency

• Management experience in a similar role

• Familiarity with software and computer programming (Python, GIT, etc.) strongly preferred

• Basic cleanroom experience preferable

• Excellent technical problem-solving skills

• Open-mindedness, communication skills and critical thinking

• Willingness to learn

• Working proficiency in English and French (written/spoken)

We offer

• Excellent international working environment with access to world-class facilities

• A young, dynamic, flexible and highly motivated research group

• EPFL is located in the French speaking part of Switzerland on the shores of Lake Geneva, with a university campus offering a rich cultural environment

Information

Contract Start Date : 01.08.2026

Activity Rate : 50 - 70%

Contract Type: CDD

Duration: 1 year, renewable

Reference: 2311

Contact

For complementary information, please contact Prof. Tobias Kippenberg per e-mail: tobias.kippenberg@epfl.ch

Missione Il Laboratorio di Fotonica e Misurazioni Quantistiche cerca un Responsabile di Laboratorio che supervisioni e implementi la gestione dei dati e la conformità normativa e supporti la ricerca sperimentale del laboratorio. Il ruolo coinvolge l'organizzazione del laboratorio, la manutenzione delle attrezzature, la gestione della documentazione, il supporto agli utenti e il coordinamento dell'infrastruttura sperimentale condivisa. Principali compiti e responsabilità - Conformità di laboratorio: aiutare a stabilire e mantenere buone pratiche di laboratorio, routine degli utenti, standard di documentazione e procedure interne. Mantenere la sicurezza, l'organizzazione e la pulizia dei laboratori e degli spazi di stoccaggio in conformità con le regole del laboratorio e in coordinamento con i membri del gruppo. Implementare un sistema di prenotazione per l'uso delle attrezzature di laboratorio tramite spin-off. Organizzare nuove allestimenti, spazi di laboratorio e ristrutturazioni (Edificio Avanzato di Scienze). Supervisionare audit di sicurezza e formazione in laboratorio per utenti interni ed esterni. - Gestione dei dati e supporto al team: controllo dei quaderni di laboratorio (TEAMS), gestione del software interno di simulazione IT per il laboratorio (COMSOL, Lumerical, Ansys e Sonnet) e assistenza nel monitoraggio e nell'istituzione di una corretta documentazione dei risultati scientifici e tecnici (ad esempio tramite GIT, software di gestione del laboratorio/attività). Avviare riunioni settimanali di organizzazione del laboratorio con i sotto-team. Supportare l'inserimento e la formazione di nuovi studenti, postdoc e personale tecnico nelle routine di laboratorio. - Supporto in camera bianca (fabbricazione, confezionamento e coordinamento del flusso di campioni): coordinarsi con il team R&D e l'ingegnere senior di processo per garantire la continuità delle attività legate alla fabbricazione, inclusi compiti di nanofabbricazione, documentazione dei processi e delle tecniche consolidate, richieste di apparecchiature (strumenti della piattaforma), oltre a installazione e test. Contribuire al mantenimento e al miglioramento delle routine per il packaging dei chip fotonici, i test e l'integrazione sperimentale. - Attrezzature: assiste con gli ordini di acquisto di attrezzature su larga scala, inclusi messa in servizio, installazione, risoluzione dei problemi, manutenzione, riparazioni e aggiornamenti. - Gestione dei documenti: mantenere un database interno di scorte/inventario di materiali e attrezzature, nonché un sistema centrale di inventario. - Monitoraggio continuo e gestione dell'innovazione: mantenere un ambiente ordinato nei laboratori (ASANA) e essere leader nell'adozione delle tecnologie e dei software più recenti per documentare in modo efficiente conoscenze, campioni e gestione della ricerca. Profilo Per questa posizione, cerchiamo candidati orientati alle soluzioni con il seguente profilo: - Master o PhD in Ingegneria Elettrica, Fisica o Informatica - Attenzione ai dettagli e passione per l'organizzazione e l'efficienza - Esperienza manageriale in un ruolo simile - Familiarità con software e programmazione informatica (Python, GIT, ecc.) fortemente preferita - Esperienza di base in camera bianca preferibile - Eccellenti capacità tecniche di problem solving - Apertura mentale, Competenze comunicative e pensiero critico - Disponibilità ad apprendere - Competenza lavorativa in inglese e francese (scritto/parlato)
• Cosa offriamo - Eccellente ambiente di lavoro internazionale con accesso a strutture di livello mondiale - Un gruppo di ricerca giovane, dinamico, flessibile e altamente motivato - EPFL si trova nella parte francofona della Svizzera sulle rive del Lago di Ginevra, con un campus universitario che offre un ricco ambiente culturale Informazioni - Data di inizio contratto: 01.08.2026 - Tasso di attività: 50 - 70% - Tipo contratto: CDD - Durata: 1 anno, rinnovabile - Riferimento: 2311 Contatto Per informazioni complementari, si prega di contattare il Prof. Tobias Kippenberg via e-mail: tobias.kippenberg@epfl.ch

Mission Das Labor für Photonik und Quantenmessungen sucht einen Laborleiter, der das Datenmanagement und die Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorschriften überwacht und umsetzt sowie die experimentelle Forschung des Labors unterstützt. Die Rolle umfasst Labororganisation, Gerätewartung, Dokumentationsmanagement, Benutzersupport und Koordination gemeinsamer experimenteller Infrastruktur. Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten – Laboreinhaltung: Unterstützung bei der Etablierung und Aufrechterhaltung guter Laborpraktiken, Benutzerroutinen, Dokumentationsstandards und internen Verfahren. Aufrechterhaltung der Sicherheit, Organisation und Sauberkeit von Laboren und Lagerräumen gemäß den Laborregeln und in Abstimmung mit den Gruppenmitgliedern. Implementieren Sie ein Buchungssystem für die Nutzung von Laborausrüstung durch Spin-offs. Organisieren Sie neue Einrichtungen, Laborräume und Renovierungen (Advanced Science Building). Überwachung von Sicherheitsaudits und Laborsicherheitsschulungen für interne und externe Nutzer. - Datenmanagement und Teamunterstützung: Kontrolle von Labornotizbüchern (TEAMS), Verwaltung interner IT-Simulationssoftware für das Labor (COMSOL, Lumerical, Ansys und Sonnet) sowie Unterstützung bei der Überwachung und ordnungsgemäßen Dokumentation wissenschaftlicher und technischer Ergebnisse (z. B. über GIT, Labor-/Aufgabenmanagementsoftware). Initiieren Sie wöchentliche Organisationssitzungen für das Labor mit Unterteams. Unterstützung der Einarbeitung und Ausbildung neuer Studierender, Postdocs und technischer Mitarbeiter in Laborroutinen. - Reinraumunterstützung (Fertigung, Verpackung und Probenflusskoordination): Zusammenarbeit mit dem F&E-Team und dem leitenden Prozessingenieur, um die Kontinuität der fertigungsbezogenen Aktivitäten sicherzustellen, einschließlich Nanofertigungsaufgaben, Dokumentation etablierter Prozesse und Techniken sowie Ausrüstungsanfragen (Plattformwerkzeuge) sowie Installation und Tests. Tragen Sie zur Aufrechterhaltung und Verbesserung von Routinen für die Verpackung, Tests und experimentelle Integration von photonischen Chips bei. - Ausrüstung: Unterstützung bei Bestellungen groß angelegter Ausrüstung, einschließlich Inbetriebnahme, Installation, Fehlersuche, Wartung, Reparaturen und Modernisierungen. - Aktenverwaltung: Pflege einer internen Datenbank über Lagerbestände/Inventar von Materialien und Ausrüstung sowie ein zentrales Inventarsystem. - Kontinuierliches Monitoring und Innovationsmanagement: Aufrechterhaltung eines geordneten Umfelds in den Laboren (ASANA) und Vorreiterrolle bei der Einführung der neuesten Technologien und Software, um Wissen, Proben und Forschungsmanagement effizient zu dokumentieren. Profil Für diese Position suchen wir lösungsorientierte Kandidaten mit folgendem Profil: - Masterabschluss oder Promotion in Elektrotechnik, Physik oder Informatik - Liebe zum Detail und Leidenschaft für Organisation und Effizienz - Managementerfahrung in einer ähnlichen Rolle - Vertrautheit mit Software und Computerprogrammierung (Python, GIT usw.) sehr bevorzugt - Grundlegende Reinraumerfahrung vorzuziehen - Ausgezeichnete technische Problemlösungsfähigkeiten - Aufgeschlossenheit, Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und kritisches Denken – Lernbereitschaft – Arbeitskompetenz in Englisch und Französisch (geschrieben/gesprochen) –
• Was wir bieten – Ausgezeichnetes internationales Arbeitsumfeld mit Zugang zu erstklassigen Einrichtungen – Eine junge, dynamische, flexible und hochmotivierte Forschungsgruppe – EPFL befindet sich im französischsprachigen Teil der Schweiz am Ufer des Genfersees, mit einem Universitätscampus, der eine reiche kulturelle Umgebung bietet Informationen – Vertragsbeginn: 01.08.2026 - Aktivitätsrate: 50 - 70 % - Vertragsart: CDD - Dauer: 1 Jahr, verlängerbar - Referenz: 2311 Kontakt Für ergänzende Informationen wenden Sie sich bitte an Prof. Tobias Kippenberg per E-Mail: tobias.kippenberg@epfl.ch
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Mission

Le Laboratoire de photonique et de mesure quantique cherche un gestionnaire de laboratoire pour superviser et mettre en oeuvre la gestion des données et la conformité réglementaire et appuyer la recherche expérimentale du laboratoire. Ce rôle implique l'organisation des laboratoires, la maintenance des équipements, la gestion de la documentation, le soutien des utilisateurs et la coordination des infrastructures expérimentales partagées.

Principales tâches et responsabilités

• Conformité des laboratoires : aider à établir et à maintenir de bonnes pratiques de laboratoire, des routines d'utilisation, des normes de documentation et des procédures internes. Maintenir la sécurité, l'organisation et la propreté des laboratoires et des espaces de stockage conformément aux règles de laboratoire et en coordination avec les membres du groupe. Mettre en place un système de réservation de matériel de laboratoire par spin-offs. Organiser de nouveaux aménagements, espaces de laboratoire et rénovations (Avanced Science Building). Superviser les audits de sécurité et la formation en sécurité en laboratoire pour les utilisateurs internes et externes.

• Gestion des données et soutien de l'équipe : contrôle des carnets de laboratoire (TEAMS), gestion des logiciels internes de simulation informatique pour le laboratoire (COMSOL, Lumerical, Ansys et Sonnet) et aide à la surveillance et à l'établissement d'une documentation appropriée des résultats scientifiques et techniques (par exemple GIT, logiciel de gestion de laboratoire/task). Entreprendre des réunions hebdomadaires d'organisation de laboratoire avec des sous-équipes. Soutenir l'embarquement et la formation des nouveaux étudiants, des postdoctorants et du personnel technique dans les routines de laboratoire.

• Soutien en salle propre (fabrication, emballage et coordination du flux d'échantillons) : assurer la liaison avec l'équipe de R-D et l'ingénieur principal de traitement pour assurer la continuité des activités liées à la fabrication, y compris les tâches de nanofabrication, la documentation des procédés et techniques établis, les demandes d'équipement (outils de plate-forme), ainsi que l'installation et les essais. Contribuer au maintien et à l'amélioration des routines d'emballage, d'essai et d'intégration expérimentale des puces photoniques.

• Matériel : aider à l'achat de gros équipements, y compris la mise en service, l'installation, le dépannage, l'entretien, les réparations et les mises à niveau.

• Gestion des dossiers : tenir une base de données interne sur les stocks et les stocks de matériel et d'équipement, ainsi qu'un système central d'inventaire.

• Surveillance continue et gestion de l'innovation : maintenir un environnement ordonné dans les laboratoires (ASANA) et prendre l'initiative d'adopter les dernières technologies et logiciels pour documenter efficacement les connaissances, les échantillons et la gestion de la recherche.

Profil

Pour ce poste, nous cherchons des candidats orientés vers la solution avec le profil suivant:

• Maîtrise ou doctorat en EE, physique ou informatique

• Attention aux détails et passion pour l'organisation et l'efficacité

• Expérience de gestion dans un rôle similaire

• Familiarité avec les logiciels et la programmation informatique (Python, GIT, etc.) fortement préféré

• Expérience de base en salle propre préférable

• Excellentes compétences techniques pour résoudre les problèmes

• Ouverture d'esprit, aptitudes à la communication et pensée critique

• Volonté d'apprendre

• Compétence professionnelle en anglais et en français (écrit/parlé)

Nous offrons

• Excellent environnement de travail international avec accès à des installations de classe mondiale

• Un groupe de recherche jeune, dynamique, flexible et très motivé

• L'EPFL est située dans la partie francophone de la Suisse sur les rives du lac Léman, avec un campus universitaire offrant un environnement culturel riche

jobs.description:
Mission

The EPFL Al Center focuses on advancing research, education and innovation in Al at EPFL and beyond. It is at the core of a vibrant EPFL community and dynamic external ecosystem that includes a large number of partners and stakeholders in Al, including academia, industry, government, and international organisations.

We are searching for a Regulatory Data Manager for National Initiatives in AI for Health

The role will support important research initiatives led by the EPFL AI Center, and the Swiss Data Science Center (SDSC). In particular, the new Regulatory Data Manager will be mainly involved in the National AI Initiative for Precision Oncology (NAIPO), which transforms cancer care in Switzerland by integrating advanced AI across the patient journey. It unites hospitals, companies, and startups to drive innovation, reduce healthcare costs, and position Switzerland as a leader in personalised medicine. NAIPO is led by the EPFL AI Center and comprises 31 partners such as universities, cantonal and private hospitals, national research infrastructure such as SDSC and CSCS, universities, private companies such as pharmaceutical companies or start-ups. That main mission will be complemented by an additional role in supporting translational initiatives led by the SDSC.

Please note that only applications meeting the criteria of the advertisement will be considered.

Main duties and responsibilities

You will collaborate with the EPFL AI Center, the SDSC and its clinical partners, the NAIPO Management Support Team, the legal department/office of each partner, the clinical coordinators and the NAIPO members.

In the context of NAIPO, you will

• Coordinate a comprehensive Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) with research, hospital, and legal partners, evaluating privacy risks and mitigation strategies for each subproject.

• Coordinate the drafting of Clinical Study Protocols according to the Swiss Human Research Act and standardized Patient Information and Consent Forms (PICFs).

• Develop a modular Data Privacy Compliance Framework.

• Develop a standard Data Processing and Transfer Agreements (DPAs, DTAs).

• Define an AI model validation guidelines aligned with Swissmedic standards and ISO norms for medical software, ensuring the clinical deployment of AI tools meets regulatory expectations.

• Coordinate with the different legal department / office of each institution.

• Define, maintain and oversee the data management of NAIPO, in close collaboration with the data managers from SDSC and the implementation partners.

• Develop and implement a Regulatory Monitoring Plan to track changes to data protection, AI, and clinical research regulations over the project's lifetime, ensuring adaptive compliance. Promoting the EPFL AI Center, managing our extensive partner network, and building our ecosystem in Switzerland and beyond.

Furthermore, in the context of SDSC translational AI for health research projects, you will

• Support the writing of Data Processing and Transfer and Usage Agreements (DPAs, DTUAs) for Health & Biomedical projects.

• Support to organizations – particularly Swiss SMEs - in the path to SAMD : advise them regarding which types of projects and products explicitly require to undergo the process, and which ones make it highly recommended; advise them on the process and milestones linked to the different SAMD levels.

Profile

• More than five years of professional experience in a clinical regulatory environment and in writing clinical protocols

• Demonstrated expertise of the Swiss regulatory landscape and ethics committees (Swiss Human Research Act, data protection regulations…)

• Experience in negotiating with ethics committees

• Proven ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical operational frameworks for complex, multi-partner projects

• Ability to integrate in highly dynamic environments

• Capabilities for managing several projects at once and meeting deadlines

• Excel

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione Il Centro Al dell'EPFL si concentra sul progresso della ricerca, dell'istruzione e dell'innovazione nel campo dell'Al all'EPFL e oltre. È al centro di una vivace comunità EPFL e di un dinamico ecosistema esterno che comprende un gran numero di partner e parti interessate in Al, tra cui il mondo accademico, l'industria, il governo e le organizzazioni internazionali. Stiamo cercando un responsabile dei dati normativi per le iniziative nazionali in AI for Health. Il ruolo supporterà importanti iniziative di ricerca guidate dall'EPFL AI Center e dallo Swiss Data Science Center (SDSC). In particolare, il nuovo Regulatory Data Manager sarà coinvolto principalmente nell’Iniziativa nazionale sull’oncologia di precisione (NAIPO), che trasforma la cura del cancro in Svizzera integrando l’IA avanzata lungo il percorso del paziente. Unisce ospedali, aziende e startup per promuovere l’innovazione, ridurre i costi sanitari e posizionare la Svizzera come leader nella medicina personalizzata. La NAIPO è guidata dal Centro AI dell'EPFL e comprende 31 partner tra cui università, ospedali cantonali e privati, infrastrutture di ricerca nazionali come SDSC e CSCS, università, aziende private come aziende farmaceutiche o start-up. Questa missione principale sarà integrata da un ruolo aggiuntivo nel sostenere le iniziative di traduzione guidate dall’SDSC. Si prega di notare che verranno prese in considerazione solo le candidature che soddisfano i criteri dell'annuncio. Principali compiti e responsabilità Collaborerai con il Centro EPFL AI, l'SDSC e i suoi partner clinici, il team di supporto gestionale della NAIPO, il dipartimento/ufficio legale di ciascun partner, i coordinatori clinici e i membri della NAIPO. Nel contesto di NAIPO, dovrai:
• Coordinare una valutazione completa dell'impatto della protezione dei dati (DPIA) con partner di ricerca, ospedali e legali, valutando i rischi per la privacy e le strategie di mitigazione per ciascun sottoprogetto.
• Coordinare la stesura dei protocolli di studio clinico secondo la legge svizzera sulla ricerca umana e dei moduli di informazione e consenso dei pazienti standardizzati (PICF).
• Sviluppare un quadro modulare di conformità alla privacy dei dati.
• Sviluppare accordi standard sul trattamento e sul trasferimento dei dati (DPA, DTA).
• Definire linee guida per la validazione del modello di IA in linea con gli standard Swissmedic e le norme ISO per il software medico, garantendo che l'implementazione clinica degli strumenti di IA soddisfi le aspettative normative.
• Coordinarsi con i diversi dipartimenti/uffici legali di ciascuna istituzione.
• Definire, mantenere e supervisionare la gestione dei dati della NAIPO, in stretta collaborazione con i gestori dei dati di SDSC e i partner di implementazione.
• Sviluppare e implementare un piano di monitoraggio normativo per tenere traccia delle modifiche alle normative sulla protezione dei dati, sull'intelligenza artificiale e sulla ricerca clinica nel corso della durata del progetto, garantendo la conformità adattiva. Promozione dell'EPFL AI Center, gestione della nostra vasta rete di partner e costruzione del nostro ecosistema in Svizzera e oltre. Inoltre, nel contesto dell'intelligenza artificiale traslazionale SDSC per progetti di ricerca sanitaria,
• Sosterrai la scrittura di accordi di elaborazione, trasferimento e utilizzo dei dati (DPA, DTUA) per progetti sanitari e biomedici.
• Supporto alle organizzazioni – in particolare alle PMI svizzere – nel percorso verso SAMD: consigliarle su quali tipologie di progetti e prodotti richiedono esplicitamente di sottoporsi al processo e quali lo rendono altamente raccomandato; consigliarli sul processo e sulle tappe fondamentali legate ai diversi livelli SAMD. • Più di cinque anni di esperienza professionale in un ambiente normativo clinico e nella scrittura di protocolli clinici
