jobs.description:
Mission

L’EPFL a des défis majeurs en termes de gestion du Système d’Information. La Direction des Systèmes d’Information de l’EPFL (DSI) est responsable de mettre en œuvre la stratégie numérique de l’EPFL. Ces missions incluent, dans une combinaison de responsabilités directes et de responsabilités matricielles, l'élaboration et la mise en œuvre de la stratégie informatique et du plan directeur de l’EPFL, la digitalisation des processus métiers, la sécurité informatique, la gestion des infrastructures informatiques centrales, la gestion des applications cœur-de-métier, ainsi que la coordination avec les services informatiques des Facultés.

Le Service « Systèmes d’Information pour les Services Académiques » (ISAS) est au cœur de la création de valeur du Système d’Information de l’EPFL et de ses évolutions. Les équipes collaborent avec les métiers de l’EPFL pour analyser les besoins, développer, enrichir et consolider des solutions informatiques, tout en maintenant leur stabilité. Elles conseillent également sur l’impact potentiel des solutions sur les processus métiers et proposent des améliorations des processus sur la base de solutions standard du marché ou plus rarement sur la base de solutions spécifiques.

En tant que Chef·fe d’unité informatique pour l’Éducation & Responsable du projet de migration ERP Académique pour notre unité ISAS-GIF, vous êtes responsable d’une équipe de personnes en charge des outils informatiques destinés à la gestion des études et vous veillez à ce qu’ils soient adaptés aux besoins des corps estudiantin, professoral, doctoral et surtout personnel académique. Vous travaillez en collaboration étroite avec l’ensemble de la Vice-Présidence pour l’Éducation (Académique), ainsi qu’avec des partenaires de tierces maintenances applicatives. Vous êtes également responsable du projet actuel de migration de l’ERP Académique de l’EPFL.

À ces titres, vous avez un rôle stratégique dans la définition et l’exécution de la stratégie IT de l’École en lien avec le domaine de l’Éducation. Dans ce domaine, vous pilotez l’ensemble des projets et des services qui vous sont assignés, et ce, sous tous les aspects : ressources humaines et financières, qualité, reporting et gouvernance. Avec votre équipe, avec vos collègues chef·fe·s d’unités, chef·fe·s de services, et surtout avec les Vice-Présidence concernées par le domaine, vous participez activement à l’excellence opérationnelle de l’EPFL.

Principales tâches et responsabilités

Principales tâches et responsabilités, en tant que Chef·fe d’unité :

• Encadrer et animer l’unité : coordonner et gérer le personnel, contrôler les activités. Développer le savoir-faire. Veiller à la maintenance de la cartographie et l’alignement des compétences de l’unité aux besoins et à l’évolution du SI.

• Planifier le plan de charge de son équipe. Faire le monitoring, du reporting, de la production de tableaux de bord à l’attention du management et des partenaires.

• Piloter en continu la gestion financière de l’unité, et la budgétisation prévisionnelle annuelle, en respect des procédures.

• Garantir la cohérence des projets ou des services de son périmètre de responsabilités.

• Travailler conjointement avec les partenaires métiers et les équipe de la VPO (Vice-Présidence pour les Opérations) pour l’établissement des roadmaps des projets de digitalisation.

• Fixer les objectifs pour l’unité, les suivre et les revoir périodiquement. Mettre en œuvre des décisions de Direction, et participer activement au développement de talents.

• Recruter des collaborateurs·trices de l’unité et/ou des prestataires.

• Conduire des projets ou un programme de projets des différents développements en lien dans le périmètre ISAS-GIF.

• Suivre le contrat lié à l’ERP Éducation actuel avec la société en charge de la tierce maintenance applicative.

En tant que Responsable du projet de migration ERP Académique :

• Assurer la coordination des différents développements de l’ERP Éducation.

• Piloter,

descriptionByLocale.it:
La missione L, EPFL, ha grandi sfide in termini di gestione del sistema informativo. La Direzione Sistemi Informativi dell'EPFL (DSI) è responsabile dell'attuazione della strategia digitale dell'EPFL. Tali missioni comprendono, in una combinazione di responsabilità dirette e responsabilità matrice, lo sviluppo e l'attuazione della strategia e del piano di gestione dell'IT EPFL, la digitalizzazione dei processi aziendali, la sicurezza informatica, la gestione dell'infrastruttura informatica centrale, la gestione delle applicazioni di base del business e il coordinamento con i dipartimenti delle facoltà. Il Servizio "Sistemi di informazione per i servizi accademici" (ISAS) è al centro della creazione di valore del Sistema informativo di EPFL, EPFL e delle sue evoluzioni. I team collaborano con i mestieri di EPFL per analizzare le esigenze, sviluppare, arricchire e consolidare le soluzioni IT, mantenendone la stabilità. Inoltre consigliano l'impatto potenziale delle soluzioni sui processi aziendali e propongono miglioramenti dei processi basati su soluzioni standard di mercato o più raramente sulla base di soluzioni specifiche. In qualità di capo dell'unità IT per l'istruzione e il progetto di migrazione accademica per la nostra unità ISAS-GIF, è responsabile di un team di responsabili degli strumenti informatici per la gestione degli studi e si assicura che siano adattati alle esigenze dello studente, del dipartimento e del personale accademico. Lavora in stretta collaborazione con l'intero Vicepresidente per l'Istruzione e con partner terzi per l'applicazione. Siete inoltre responsabili dell'attuale progetto di migrazione dell'ERP Accademico dell'EPFL. In questo modo avete un ruolo strategico nella definizione e attuazione della strategia IT della Scuola in relazione al settore dell'Istruzione. In questo campo, guidate tutti i progetti e i servizi assegnativi, sotto tutti gli aspetti: risorse umane e finanziarie, qualità, reporting e governance. Con il vostro team, con i vostri colleghi, capi unità, capi servizi, e soprattutto con i Vicepresidenti interessati al settore, partecipate attivamente all'eccellenza operativa dell'EPFL. Principali compiti e responsabilità Principali compiti e responsabilità, in qualità di Capo unità:
• Supervisionare e animare l'unità: coordinare e gestire il personale, controllare le attività. Sviluppare il know-how. Per garantire il mantenimento della mappatura e l'allineamento delle competenze dell'unità alle esigenze e all'evoluzione dell'IS.
• Pianificare il piano di carico del suo team. Fare il monitoraggio, la segnalazione, dalla produzione di dashboard all'attenzione della direzione e dei partner.
• Pilotare su base continua la gestione finanziaria dell'unità, e la previsione annuale, secondo le procedure.
• Garantire la coerenza dei progetti o servizi del suo ambito di responsabilità.
• Lavorare insieme con i partner commerciali e i team VPO (Vice-Presidente per le Operazioni) per la creazione dei progetti di digitalizzazione.
• Stabilire gli obiettivi dell'unità, monitorarli e rivederli periodicamente. Attuare decisioni di gestione e partecipare attivamente allo sviluppo dei talenti.
• Reclutare i dipendenti e/o i fornitori dell'unità.
• Condurre progetti o un programma di progetto dei vari sviluppi collegati all'interno del perimetro ISAS-GIF.
• Seguire il contratto relativo all'attuale ERP Education, con la società responsabile della terza manutenzione dell'applicazione. In qualità di capo del progetto di migrazione accademica:
• garantire il coordinamento dei vari sviluppi dell'ERP sull'istruzione.

Mission L, EPFL has major challenges in terms of management of the Information System. The Information Systems Directorate of EPFL (DSI) is responsible for implementing the digital strategy of EPFL. These missions include, in a combination of direct responsibilities and matrix responsibilities, the development and implementation of the EPFL IT strategy and master plan, the digitalisation of business processes, IT security, the management of central IT infrastructure, the management of core business applications, and coordination with the departments of the faculties. The "Information Systems for Academic Services" (ISAS) Service is at the heart of the value creation of the Information System of EPFL, EPFL and its evolutions. The teams collaborate with EPFL's trades to analyse needs, develop, enrich and consolidate IT solutions, while maintaining their stability. They also advise on the potential impact of solutions on business processes and propose process improvements based on standard market solutions or more rarely on the basis of specific solutions. As Head of IT Unit for Education & Head of the Academic migrating project for our ISAS-GIF unit, you are responsible for a team of people in charge of the computer tools for the management of studies and you ensure that they are adapted to the needs of student, departmental, and academic staff. You work in close collaboration with the whole of the Vice-President for Education and with third party partners for application. You are also responsible for the current migration project of EPFL's Academic ERP. As such, you have a strategic role in defining and implementing the IT strategy of the School in relation to the field of Education. In this field, you lead all the projects and services assigned to you, in all aspects: human and financial resources, quality, reporting and governance. With your team, with your colleagues, heads of units, heads of services, and especially with the Vice-Presidents concerned with the field, you are actively participating in the operational excellence of EPFL. Main tasks and responsibilities Main tasks and responsibilities, as Head of Unit:
• To supervise and animate the unit: to coordinate and manage the staff, to control the activities. To develop the know-how. To ensure the maintenance of the mapping and the alignment of the unit's skills to the needs and evolution of the IS.
• Plan the load plan of his team. Do the monitoring, the reporting, from the production of dashboards to the attention of management and partners.
• Pilot on a continuous basis the financial management of the unit, and the annual forecasting, in accordance with the procedures.
• Ensure the coherence of the projects or services of its scope of responsibility.
• Work jointly with the business partners and the VPO (Vice-President for Operations) teams for the establishment of the digitalization projects.
• Set the objectives for the unit, monitor them and review them periodically. Implement management decisions, and actively participate in talent development.
• Recruit unit employees and/or providers.
• Conduct projects or a project programme of the various developments linked within the ISAS-GIF perimeter.
• Follow the contract related to the current ERP Education, with the company in charge of the application third maintenance. As Head of the Academic migrating project:
• Ensure coordination of the various developments of the Education ERP.
• Pilot,

Mission L, EPFL hat große Herausforderungen in Bezug auf die Verwaltung des Informationssystems. Die Direktion Informationssysteme der EPFL (DSI) ist für die Umsetzung der digitalen Strategie der EPFL verantwortlich. Zu diesen Aufgaben gehören in einer Kombination aus direkter Verantwortung und Matrix-Verantwortung die Entwicklung und Umsetzung der EPFL-IT-Strategie und -Masterplan, die Digitalisierung von Geschäftsprozessen, IT-Sicherheit, das Management der zentralen IT-Infrastruktur, das Management von Kerngeschäftsanwendungen und die Koordination mit den Fachbereichen der Fakultäten. Der Service „Information Systems for Academic Services" (ISAS) ist das Herzstück der Wertschöpfung des Informationssystems der EPFL, EPFL und seiner Entwicklungen. Die Teams arbeiten mit den EPFL-Fachgeschäften zusammen, um die Bedürfnisse zu analysieren, IT-Lösungen zu entwickeln, zu bereichern und zu konsolidieren und gleichzeitig ihre Stabilität zu erhalten. Sie beraten auch über die potenziellen Auswirkungen von Lösungen auf Geschäftsprozesse und schlagen Prozessverbesserungen vor, die auf Standardmarktlösungen oder seltener auf der Grundlage spezifischer Lösungen basieren. Als Leiter des Projekts für die akademische Migration unseres ISAS-GIF-Bereichs sind Sie für ein Team von Mitarbeitern verantwortlich, die für die Verwaltung des Studiums zuständig sind und sicherstellen, dass diese an die Bedürfnisse von Studierenden, Abteilungs- und akademischen Mitarbeitern angepasst sind. Sie arbeiten in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem gesamten Vizepräsidenten für Bildung und mit Drittpartnern für die Bewerbung. Sie sind auch für das aktuelle Migrationsprojekt des Academic ERP der EPFL verantwortlich. So haben Sie eine strategische Rolle bei der Festlegung und Umsetzung der IT-Strategie der Schule im Bereich Bildung. In diesem Bereich führen Sie alle Ihnen zugewiesenen Projekte und Dienstleistungen in allen Bereichen: Human- und Finanzressourcen, Qualität, Reporting und Governance. Mit Ihrem Team, mit Ihren Kollegen, Referatsleitern, den Leitern der Dienste und vor allem mit den mit dem Bereich befassten Vizepräsidenten, nehmen Sie aktiv an der operativen Exzellenz der EPFL teil. Hauptaufgaben und Aufgaben Hauptaufgaben und Aufgaben, als Referatsleiter:
• Die Abteilung überwachen und animieren: die Mitarbeiter koordinieren und verwalten, die Aktivitäten steuern. Know-how entwickeln. Die Erhaltung der Kartierung und die Ausrichtung der Fähigkeiten der Einheit auf die Bedürfnisse und die Entwicklung des IS gewährleisten.
• Planen Sie den Lastplan seines Teams. Führen Sie die Überwachung, die Berichterstattung, von der Produktion von Armaturenbrettern bis hin zur Aufmerksamkeit der Geschäftsleitung und der Partner.
• Pilotieren Sie kontinuierlich die finanzielle Verwaltung der Einheit und die jährliche Prognose, entsprechend den Verfahren.
• Sicherstellen Sie die Kohärenz der Projekte oder Dienstleistungen ihres Verantwortungsbereichs.
• Arbeiten Sie gemeinsam mit den Geschäftspartnern und den VPO (Vice-President for Operations) Teams für die Einrichtung der Digitalisierungsprojekte.
• Stellen Sie die Ziele für die Einheit, überwachen Sie sie und überprüfen Sie sie regelmäßig. Führen Sie Managemententscheidungen, und aktiv an der Talententwicklung teilnehmen.
• Rekrutieren Sie Mitarbeiter und / oder Anbieter.
• Projekte oder ein Projektprogramm der verschiedenen Entwicklungen innerhalb der ISAS-GIF-Perimeter verbunden.
• Folgen Sie dem Vertrag im Zusammenhang mit der aktuellen ERP-Ausbildung, mit dem Unternehmen verantwortlich für die Anwendung dritte Wartung. Als Leiter des Projekts Akademische Migrating:
• Gewährleistung der Koordination der verschiedenen Entwicklungen des Bildungs-ERP.
• Pilot,

titleByLocale.fr: Formatrice ou Formateur - Laboratoire Ecole de Physique

jobs.description:
Mission

Avec plus de 100 apprenti·es en formation dans une douzaine de professions, l’EPFL est une entreprise formatrice à part entière.
Quel que soit l’apprentissage choisi à l’EPFL, les apprenti·es réalisent leur formation professionnelle dans un environnement hors du commun, multinational, composé de laboratoires de recherche dans des domaines aussi variés que l’ingénierie, les sciences exactes et l’architecture. Ils et Elles bénéficient de tout le dynamisme et la diversité d’un campus universitaire qui leur offre de nombreuses perspectives, avantages et possibilités d’épanouissement personnel.

Dans la perspective de renforcer la formation des apprenti·es laborantin·es en physique , l’EPFL crée un laboratoire école dédié à cette profession à la rentrée scolaire 2027.
Pour mettre en place les bases de ce laboratoire école, le gérer et enseigner les cours d’électronique aux apprenti·es nous cherchons une Formatrice ou un Formateur Responsable à 100%.
La personne retenue sera aussi amenée à donner des cours d’électronique aux étudiants en 2ème année de Bachelor en physique de l’EPFL, dans le cadre des travaux pratiques d’électronique.

Principales tâches et responsabilités

• Définir et organiser le plan de formation propre à l'EPFL pour les apprenti·es laborantin·es en physique

• Animer et soutenir le réseau des formateurs sur la place de travail des apprenti·es laborantin·e en physique ; en particulier :
- Participer à la procédure de sélection des futur·es apprenti·es laborantin·es en physique
- Suivi du plan de formation, des objectifs de formation et des examens

• Organisation des rotations / stages dans les différentes unités formant des apprenti·es

• Promouvoir la formation de laborantin·e en physique, tant à l’interne de l’EPFL qu’auprès des écoliers et autres parties prenantes

• Former en électronique les apprenti·es laborantin·es en physique

• Préparer et enseigner des cours théoriques et pratiques d'électronique analogique et numérique,

• Participer à l’enseignement des cours interentreprises en technique et méthodes de mesures

• Enseigner l’électronique aux étudiants de Bachelor 2ème année en physique
- Enseignement théorique (1h/semaine) et pratique(2h/semaine)
- structuré en deux semestres : électronique fondamentale, analogique et numérique, traitement du signal, montages, manipulation d’instruments de mesure, programmation Arduino…

• Participer à la réalisation de montages destinés aux travaux pratiques de physique et/ou aux expériences d’auditoire

Profil

• Formation supérieure (niveau HES) en électronique ou en génie électrique, ou formation de technicien en mécatronique

• Connaissances et capacité à transmettre ses connaissances, à expliquer des concepts complexes de manière claire et accessible à des apprenti·es sur les points suivants :
- Electronique : très bonnes connaissances des concepts théoriques et des pratiques de l'électronique analogique et numérique, connaissance pratique en traitement du signal.

Mission With more than 100 apprentices in training in a dozen professions, EPFL is a fully-fledged training company. Regardless of the apprenticeship chosen at EPFL, apprentices carry out their vocational training in an extraordinary, multinational environment composed of research laboratories in fields as varied as engineering, the exact sciences and architecture. They benefit from all the dynamism and diversity of a university campus that offers them many opportunities, benefits and opportunities for personal development. With a view to strengthening the training of apprentices in physics, EPFL creates a school laboratory dedicated to this profession at the beginning of the 2027 school year. To set up the basics of this laboratory school, manage it and teach the electronics courses to apprentices we are looking for a 100% Responsible Trainer or Trainer. The person selected will also be required to give electronics courses to students in the second year of EPFL's Bachelor in Physics, as part of the practical electronics work. Main tasks and responsibilities
• Defining and organising the EPFL-specific training plan for apprentices in physics
• To facilitate and support the network of trainers in the workplace of apprentices working in physics; in particular: - Participation in the procedure for selecting future apprentices in physics - Monitoring of training plan, training objectives and examinations
• Organization of rotations / internships in the different units forming apprentices
• Promoting the training of laboratory staff in physics, both internally at EPFL and among schoolchildren and other stakeholders
• Training in electronics for apprentices in physics

• Participate in the teaching of inter-company courses in measurement techniques and methods

jobs.description:
Mission

Contribution

The Materials in Transition (MATR) Lab at the School of ENAC, EPFL, is seeking a self-driven and inquisitive post-doctoral researcher to start between August and October 2026, in the field of sustainable construction. The research integrates dynamic material value-chain analyses, ownership models, technical performance assessment, and design-for-disassembly strategies to support the reuse and adaptation of building components.

Key responsibilities will include:

• Analysis and synthesis of existing research on material value chains and building stock inventories to quantify the adaptation potential of construction elements

• Investigations into building ownership models that support the reuse of building elements

• Identification and analysis of underlying mechanisms for deterioration in building envelope performance

• Development of standardised test protocols for non-destructive assessment of building envelope elements

• Support for ongoing practical research on design for disassembly and engineered reversible connection systems

MATR Lab

The incoming candidate will be part of a growing and dynamic research team at the MATR lab, led by Prof. Rebecca Hartwell, where we seek to:

• Integrate resilience into the design and application of construction materials in response to evolving socio-economic challenges, such as climate change, social equity, occupant health, and strategic independence in material supply-chains.

• Develop comprehensive digital assessment methods to evaluate whole-life material flows and their associated impact across sectors to inform policy and practice.

• Engineer whole-life adaptability at the product-scale through material science and design.

Main duties and responsibilities

As a research collaborator, you will be expected to:

• Conduct cutting-edge research including experimental design, data collection and analysis, and dissemination;

• Research in collaboration with academic partners and international collaborators;

• Lead and contribute to scientific articles for publication in peer-reviewed journals;

• Support in funding acquisition;

• Contribute to laboratory activities, including PhD and Master student supervision and teaching assistance.

Profile

• PhD in architecture, civil engineering, building technology, material science or a related discipline. Candidates without a PhD but with equivalent research experience and expertise may also be considered for an alternative appointment as a scientific assistant

• Strong interest in emerging, interdisciplinary fields within architecture and material science

• Knowledge of building construction methods, materials, architectural design principles, and building lifecycle processes

• Hands-on experience in laboratory environment

• Creative and eager to explore and develop new methodological approaches

• Experience with quantitative research methods with a strong interest in contributing to both the conceptual and empirical dimensions of research

• Proficient in, or willing to learn, programming languages (e.g. MATLAB, Python, R)

• Experience with one or more of the following is an asset: building technology, LCA methods, computational design, structural design, material testing & characterisation, fabrication or prototyping

• Experience in building energy performance simulations is a plus

• Ability to communicate with researchers from different disciplines

• Self-driven with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively

• Fluency in English is essential [French would be an asset]

We offer

• World-class and international research and training environment with access to state-of-the art experimental facilities and a rich and vibrant scientific and entrepreneurial community

• Competitive renumeration

• International collaboration and visiting opportunities through an excellent network of collaborations with industrial stakeholders and leading international universities.

• Stimulating

Missione Contributo Il Laboratorio Materiali in Transizione (MATR) presso la Scuola di ENAC, EPFL, è alla ricerca di un ricercatore post-dottorato autogestito e inquisitivo da iniziare tra agosto e ottobre 2026, nel campo della costruzione sostenibile. La ricerca integra analisi dinamiche del valore-catena dei materiali, modelli di proprietà, valutazione delle prestazioni tecniche e strategie di progettazione-per-smontaggio per supportare il riutilizzo e l'adattamento dei componenti di costruzione. Le responsabilità chiave includono:
• Analisi e sintesi della ricerca esistente sulle catene dei valori materiali e sugli inventari delle scorte di costruzione per quantificare il potenziale di adattamento degli elementi di costruzione
• Indagini sui modelli di proprietà degli edifici che supportano il riutilizzo degli elementi di costruzione
• Identificazione e analisi dei meccanismi sottostanti per il deterioramento delle prestazioni delle buste da costruzione
• Sviluppo di protocolli di prova standardizzati per la valutazione non distruttiva degli elementi di busta da costruzione
• Supporto per una continua ricerca pratica sulla progettazione per sistemi di connessione reversibili disassembly e ingegnerizzati MATR Lab Il candidato in arrivo sarà parte di un team di ricerca crescente e dinamico presso il laboratorio MATR, guidato dal Prof. Rebecca. Hartwell, dove cerchiamo di:
• Integrare la resilienza nella progettazione e nell'applicazione dei materiali da costruzione in risposta alle sfide socio-economiche in evoluzione, come il cambiamento climatico, l'equità sociale, la salute degli occupanti e l'indipendenza strategica nelle supply-chains materiali.
• Sviluppare metodi di valutazione digitale completi per valutare i flussi di materiale intero e il loro impatto associato in tutti i settori per informare la politica e la pratica.
• Ingegnere l'adattabilità di tutta la vita a livello di prodotto attraverso la scienza materiale e il design. Principali doveri e responsabilità Come collaboratore di ricerca, ci si aspetta che:
• condurre ricerche all'avanguardia, tra cui progettazione sperimentale, raccolta e analisi dei dati e diffusione;
• Ricerca in collaborazione con partner accademici e collaboratori internazionali;
• portare e contribuire a articoli scientifici per la pubblicazione in riviste peer-reviewed;
• Sostegno all'acquisizione di finanziamenti;
• Contribuisci alle attività di laboratorio, tra cui la supervisione e l'assistenza agli studenti di dottorato e Master. Profilo
• PhD in architettura, ingegneria civile, tecnologia di costruzione, scienza materiale o una disciplina relativa. I candidati senza dottorato di ricerca, ma con esperienza di ricerca e competenza equivalenti possono anche essere considerati per un appuntamento alternativo come assistente scientifico
• Forte interesse nei campi emergenti, interdisciplinari all'interno dell'architettura e della scienza materiale
• Conoscenza dei metodi di costruzione, materiali, principi di progettazione architettonica e processi di costruzione del ciclo di vita
• Esperienza pratica in ambiente di laboratorio
• Creativo e desideroso di esplorare e sviluppare nuovi approcci metodologici
• Esperienza con metodi di ricerca quantitativi con un forte interesse a contribuire sia alle dimensioni concettuali che empiriche della ricerca
• Proficiente in, o disposto a imparare, linguaggi di programmazione (ad esempio MATLAB, Python, R)
• L'esperienza con uno o più dei seguenti è un bene: tecnologia di costruzione, metodi LCA, progettazione computazionale, progettazione strutturale, test materiali e caratterizzazione, fabbricazione o prototipazione
• L'esperienza nella costruzione di simulazioni di prestazioni energetiche è un plus
• Capacità di comunicare con i ricercatori di diverse discipline
• Autodidatta con la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e collaborativo
• La fluenza in inglese è essenziale [il francese sarebbe un bene] Offriamo
• Ambiente di ricerca e formazione internazionale di livello mondiale e con accesso a strutture sperimentali all'avanguardia e a una comunità scientifica e imprenditoriale ricca e vivace
• Rinumerazione competitiva
• Collaborazione internazionale e opportunità di visita attraverso un'eccellente rete di collaborazioni con gli stakeholder industriali e le principali università internazionali.
• Stimolare

Mission Beitrag Das Materials in Transition (MATR) Lab an der School of ENAC, EPFL, sucht zwischen August und Oktober 2026 einen selbstgesteuerten und neugierigen Postdoktoranden im Bereich nachhaltiges Bauen. Die Forschung integriert dynamische Materialwertschöpfungskettenanalysen, Eigentümermodelle, technische Leistungsbewertung und Design-for-Demontage-Strategien, um die Wiederverwendung und Anpassung von Gebäudekomponenten zu unterstützen. Zu den wichtigsten Aufgaben gehören:
• Analyse und Synthese bestehender Forschungen zu Materialwertschöpfungsketten und Gebäudebestand zur Quantifizierung des Anpassungspotenzials von Bauelementen
• Untersuchungen zu Gebäudeeigentumsmodellen, die die Wiederverwendung von Gebäudeelementen unterstützen
• Identifizierung und Analyse der zugrunde liegenden Mechanismen für eine Verschlechterung der Gebäudehüllenleistung
• Entwicklung standardisierter Testprotokolle für die zerstörungsfreie Bewertung von Gebäudehüllenelementen
• Unterstützung der laufenden praktischen Forschung zum Design für Demontage- und Engineering reversibler Verbindungssysteme MATR Lab Der neue Kandidat wird Teil eines wachsenden und dynamischen Forschungsteams im MATR-Labor unter der Leitung von Prof. Rebecca Hartwell, wo wir versuchen:
• Integrieren Sie Resilienz in die Gestaltung und Anwendung von Baumaterialien als Reaktion auf sich entwickelnde sozioökonomische Herausforderungen wie Klimawandel, soziale Gerechtigkeit, Gesundheit der Bewohner und strategische Unabhängigkeit in Materiallieferketten.
• Entwicklung umfassender digitaler Bewertungsmethoden zur Bewertung der gesamten Materialflüsse und der damit verbundenen sektorübergreifenden Auswirkungen, um Politik und Praxis zu informieren.

• Leitung und Beitrag zu wissenschaftlichen Artikeln zur Veröffentlichung in von Experten begutachteten Fachzeitschriften;
• Unterstützung bei der Finanzierung von Akquisitionen;

• Starkes Interesse an aufstrebenden, interdisziplinären Feldern in Architektur und Materialwissenschaften
• Wissen über Baumethoden, Materialien, architektonische Gestaltungsprinzipien und Gebäudelebenszyklusprozesse
• Praxiserfahrung im Laborumfeld
• Kreativ und eifrig, neue methodische Ansätze zu erforschen und zu entwickeln
• Erfahrung mit quantitativen Forschungsmethoden mit einem starken Interesse daran, sowohl zur konzeptionellen als auch zur empirischen Dimension der Forschung beizutragen
• Programmiersprachen beherrschend oder lernwillig (z. B. MATLAB, Python, R)
• Erfahrung mit einem oder mehreren der folgenden Punkte ist ein Vorteil: Gebäudetechnik, LCA-Methoden, Computerdesign, Strukturdesign, Materialprüfung & Charakterisierung, Fertigung oder Prototyping
• Erfahrung in Gebäudeenergieleistungssimulationen ist ein Plus
• Fähigkeit, mit Forschern aus verschiedenen Disziplinen zu kommunizieren

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Mission Contribution Le Laboratoire Matériaux en Transition (MATR) de l'Ecole d'ENAC, à l'EPFL, cherche un chercheur postdoctorant autodidacte et curieux qui commencera entre août et octobre 2026 dans le domaine de la construction durable. La recherche intègre des analyses dynamiques de la chaîne de valeur des matériaux, des modèles de propriété, une évaluation de la performance technique et des stratégies de conception pour le démontage afin de soutenir la réutilisation et l'adaptation des composants du bâtiment. Les principales responsabilités seront les suivantes :
• Analyse et synthèse des recherches en cours sur les chaînes de valeur des matériaux et les inventaires des stocks de bâtiments pour quantifier le potentiel d'adaptation des éléments de construction
• Enquêtes sur les modèles de propriété des bâtiments qui appuient la réutilisation des éléments de construction
• Identification et analyse des mécanismes sous-jacents de détérioration de la performance de l'enveloppe du bâtiment
• Élaboration de protocoles d'essai normalisés pour l'évaluation non destructive des éléments de l'enveloppe du bâtiment
• Soutien à la recherche pratique en cours sur la conception de systèmes de connexion réversibles de démontage et d'ingénierie Laboratoire MATR Le nouveau candidat fera partie d'une équipe de recherche dynamique et croissante au laboratoire MATR, dirigée par le Prof. Rébecca Hartwell, où nous cherchons à:
• Intégrer la résilience dans la conception et l'application des matériaux de construction en réponse à l'évolution des défis socio-économiques, comme le changement climatique, l'équité sociale, la santé des occupants et l'indépendance stratégique dans les chaînes d'approvisionnement en matériaux.
• Élaborer des méthodes d'évaluation numérique exhaustives afin d'évaluer les flux de matériel tout-terrain et leurs répercussions dans tous les secteurs pour éclairer les politiques et les pratiques.
• Aptitude de l'ingénieur à l'échelle du produit grâce à la science des matériaux et à la conception. Principales fonctions et responsabilités En tant que collaborateur de recherche, vous devrez :
• Mener des recherches de pointe, y compris la conception expérimentale, la collecte et l'analyse des données et la diffusion;
• Recherche en collaboration avec des partenaires universitaires et des collaborateurs internationaux;
• Diriger et contribuer à la publication d'articles scientifiques dans des revues évaluées par des pairs;
• Appui à l ' acquisition de fonds;
• Contribuer aux activités de laboratoire, y compris la supervision et l'aide pédagogique des étudiants au doctorat et à la maîtrise. Profil
• Doctorat en architecture, génie civil, technologie du bâtiment, sciences des matériaux ou une discipline connexe. Les candidats qui n'ont pas de doctorat mais qui possèdent une expérience et une expertise de recherche équivalentes peuvent également être considérés pour un autre rendez-vous en tant qu'assistant scientifique
• Un vif intérêt pour les nouveaux domaines interdisciplinaires dans l'architecture et la science matérielle
• Connaissance des méthodes de construction, des matériaux, des principes de conception architecturale et des processus du cycle de vie du bâtiment
• Expérience pratique en laboratoire
• Créative et désireuse d'explorer et de développer de nouvelles approches méthodologiques
• Expérience des méthodes de recherche quantitative avec un vif intérêt à contribuer aux dimensions conceptuelles et empiriques de la recherche
• Compétence ou volonté d'apprendre des langages de programmation (p. ex. MATLAB, Python, R)
• L'expérience avec un ou plusieurs des éléments suivants est un atout: technologie de construction, méthodes LCA, conception informatique, conception structurelle, essais et caractérisation des matériaux, fabrication ou prototypage
• L'expérience dans les simulations de performance énergétique du bâtiment est un plus
• Capacité de communiquer avec des chercheurs de différentes disciplines
• Autodidacte, capable de travailler de manière indépendante et collaborative
• La maîtrise de l'anglais est essentielle [le français serait un atout] Nous offrons
• Un environnement de recherche et de formation de classe mondiale et internationale avec accès à des installations expérimentales de pointe et à une communauté scientifique et entrepreneuriale riche et dynamique

jobs.description:
Profile

The Structural Xploration Lab is seeking a new research collaborator with a PhD in building technology, preferably in the field of building materials and/or building envelope performance and/or building renovation. The candidate must be familiar with contemporary construction techniques and have an interest in 20th-century construction techniques or vernacular architecture. Experience in Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), Building Information Modelling (BIM), Geographic Information Systems (GIS) or computer programming is a plus. A master's degree or professional experience in architecture is preferred but not required.

The employment rate varies between 80% and 100%, depending on the candidate's availability. This is a 9-month contract, renewable. The earliest start date is May 1st or as soon as possible.

Missions

The main research activities will be related to the characterization and circular performance assessment of building envelopes in Europe, with a scope ranging from construction details and building archetypes to large-scale inference of building stocks. The project is embedded into a EU-Horizon project in collaboration with foreign industrial and research partners.

The candidate may also contribute to other research and teaching activities as well as to the supervision of architecture students at bachelor's and master's level.

About us

The Structural Xploration Lab is a group of doctoral and postdoctoral researchers in architecture and civil engineering. It is known for its development of tools, design methods, large-scale analyses and built prototypes aimed at enabling the Architecture, Engineering and Construction (AEC) sector to adopt more circular load-bearing systems. SXL also contributes to teaching building technologies and circular practices to undergraduate, master's students and professionals in architecture and civil engineering. As a unit of EPFL's ENAC faculty and located in the Smart Living Lab in Fribourg (CH), SXL benefits from state-of-the-art research infrastructure and offers an inclusive, international and stimulating work environment.

Application

Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered. You are asked to supply your CV and a brief statement of interests.

For any further information, please contact teresa.messina@epfl.ch .

descriptionByLocale.it:
Profilo

Il Laboratorio di Xploration strutturale sta cercando un nuovo collaboratore di ricerca con un PhD nella tecnologia dell'edilizia, preferibilmente nel campo dei materiali da costruzione e/o delle prestazioni della busta da costruzione e/o della ristrutturazione di edifici. Il candidato deve conoscere le tecniche costruttive contemporanee e avere un interesse per le tecniche costruttive del XX secolo o l'architettura vernacolare. Esperienza in Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), Building Information Modelling (BIM), Geographic Information Systems (GIS) o programmazione del computer è un plus. Un master o esperienza professionale in architettura è preferito ma non richiesto.

Il tasso di occupazione varia tra l'80% e il 100%, a seconda della disponibilità del candidato. Questo è un contratto di 9 mesi, rinnovabile. La prima data di inizio è il 1 maggio o il più presto possibile.

Missioni

Le principali attività di ricerca saranno connesse alla caratterizzazione e alla valutazione delle prestazioni circolari delle buste edili in Europa, con un ambito che spazia dai dettagli delle costruzioni e dagli archetipi di costruzione all'inferenza su larga scala delle scorte edilizie. Il progetto è integrato in un progetto EU-Horizon in collaborazione con partner industriali e di ricerca esteri.

Il candidato può anche contribuire ad altre attività di ricerca e di insegnamento, nonché alla supervisione di studenti di architettura a livello di bachelor e master.

Su di noi

Il Laboratorio di Xploration strutturale è un gruppo di ricercatori di dottorato e post-dottorato in architettura e ingegneria civile. È noto per il suo sviluppo di strumenti, metodi di progettazione, analisi su larga scala e prototipi costruiti volti a consentire al settore Architettura, Ingegneria e Costruzione (AEC) di adottare sistemi di carico più circolari. SXL contribuisce anche all'insegnamento delle tecnologie costruttive e delle pratiche circolari per laurearsi, master e professionisti in architettura e ingegneria civile. Come un'unità della facoltà ENAC di EPFL e situata nello Smart Living Lab di Fribourg (CH), SXL beneficia dell'infrastruttura di ricerca all'avanguardia e offre un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, internazionale e stimolante.

Applicazione

Vengono prese in considerazione solo le applicazioni presentate attraverso la piattaforma online. Ti viene chiesto di fornire il tuo CV e una breve dichiarazione di interessi.

Per ulteriori informazioni, contattare teresa.messina@epfl.ch .

jobs.description:
Mission

L’Institut des Sciences et Ingénieries Chimiques (ISIC, https://www.epfl.ch/schools/sb/research/isic/) de l’EPFL recherche un.e laborantin.e en chimie pour travailler au sein de la plateforme de résonance magnétique nucléaire (ISIC-NMRP) et de la plateforme des magasins de chimie (ISIC-CHSP).

Vous aurez la mission de prendre en charge les analyses RMN de routine en phase solide pour les laboratoires de recherche de l’EPFL et les autres utilisateurs de nos plateformes. Vous serez impliqué.e dans la préparation d’échantillons, les mesures, les opérations de dépannage et de maintenance des instruments, et le support aux utilisateurs. Vous contribuerez également au fonctionnement des magasins de chimie de l’ISIC (Lausanne et Sion). Le profil des utilisateurs et la nature des activités étant extrêmement variés, nous recherchons une personne ouverte, flexible et organisée, souhaitant travailler dans un environnement cosmopolite et multiculturel.

Les candidat.e.s motivé.e.s doivent soumettre leur candidature en ligne, incluant les documents ci-après. Le CV doit mentionner : i) la liste des compétences techniques ; ii) l’expérience professionnelle et les formations suivies, validées par des attestations/certificats ; et iii) les coordonnées d’au moins trois personnes de référence. La lettre de motivation doit mettre en évidence l’expérience passée qui pourra être mise à profit pour ce poste. Les copies des diplômes, attestations de formations complémentaires et des certificats de travail doivent être soumis en ligne. Seules les candidatures complètes et soumises jusqu’au 22 juillet 2026, via le site internet de l’EPFL ou celui de notre partenaire Jobup seront prises en compte .

Principales tâches et responsabilités

Activités au sein de la plateforme de RMN

• Analyses RMN :

- Préparation d’échantillons pour la RMN du solide

- Mise en place d’expériences RMN solide de routine

- Supervision des analyses sur les automates RMN solide et liquide

• Support technique aux utilisateurs pour les analyses RMN solide

• Entretien et dépannages des équipements d’analyse

• Gestion des stocks de consommables

Activités au sein de la plateforme des magasins de chimie

• Accueil des clients au magasin et conseil pour l'achat de consommables et d'équipements de laboratoire.

• Réception et distribution des marchandises (contrôle qualité et traçabilité)

• Entretien des stocks, rangements et propreté du magasin

• Soutien au traitement des déchets chimiques spéciaux et suivi administratif

Profil

• Certificat Fédéral de Capacité (CFC) de laborantin.e en chimie ou formation jugée équivalente.

• Une expérience préalable dans le domaine de la chimie analytique, en entreprise ou dans le milieu académique, est un atout.

• Rigueur, sens de l'organisation, flexibilité et adaptation aux changements.

• Fort esprit d’équipe tout en sachant opérer de manière autonome et prendre des initiatives

• Excellentes aptitudes dans la communication ouverte et constructive.

• Capacité à travailler dans des plateformes de service multi-utilisateurs et un milieu cosmopolite

• Maîtrise des outils informatiques standards

• De solides connaissances du français et de l’anglais écrit et parlé sont indispensables – niveau B2 exigé.

Nous offrons

• La possibilité d’intégrer une équipe dynamique et un environnement de travail évolutif

• Une activité variée et indépendante au sein d’infrastructures bénéficiant d’équipements à la pointe de la technologie

• De nombreux contacts avec les chercheurs et les collaborateurs des autres plateformes de l’ISIC

• La possibilité de développer vos compétences et de recevoir une formation approfondie sur des techniques analytiques modernes du domaine de la chimie

Informations

Date d'entrée en fonction : 01/09/2026

Taux d'occupation : 100,00

Type de contrat : CDI

Référence : 2323

descriptionByLocale.en:
Mission The Institute of Chemical Sciences and Engineering (ISIC, https://www.epfl.ch/schools/sb/research/isic/) of EPFL is looking for a laboratory in chemistry to work within the Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Platform (ISIC-NMRP) and the Chemical Stores Platform (ISIC-CHSP). You will have the mission to support routine solid phase NMR analyses for EPFL research laboratories and other users of our platforms. You will be involved in the preparation of samples, measurements, troubleshooting and maintenance of instruments, and support to users. You will also contribute to the operation of the chemical stores of the ISIC (Lausanne and Sion). Since the user profile and nature of the activities are extremely varied, we are looking for an open, flexible and organized person who wants to work in a cosmopolitan and multicultural environment. jobs.description:
Mission

We are offering a full-time (100%) PhD Student at the Laboratory for the Chemistry of Materials and Manufacturing (ALCHEMY) at EPFL Neuchatel. At EPFL ALCHEMY, we are focused on developing accessible chemistries and processing strategies that can enable the fabrication of a wide variety of advanced functional materials and devices. You will be working on a project whose goal is to develop new photocrosslinking chemistries for vat photopolymerization 3D printing technology.

Main duties and responsibilities

As a PhD Student, you will be expected to:

• Have full responsibility for your own dissertation

• Experiment design and execution

• Analyze and interpret experimental results

• Write scientific articles for publication in peer-reviewed journals

• Present at international conferences

• Participate in education and supervise student projects

More specifically, within this project, you will:

• Develop non-acrylate, non-thiol-ene photocrosslinking strategies

• Develop recyclable resins for vat photopolymerization printing

• Explore high-viscosity printing with volumetric printing

Profile

• A MSc degree in the fields of materials science, chemistry, or polymer science.

• Experience with polymer characterization is required

• Excellent comunication skills in English

• Experience with small-molecule and/or polymer synthesis would be a bonus

• Experience with vat photopolymerization (broadly defined) would be a bonus

We offer

• 4 years to complete your PhD with a competitive remuneration

• You will be part of the EDMX, EDAM, or EDCH doctoral program

• An opportunity to develop a scientific career in materials science and additive manufacturing

• A world-class research and training environment with access to state-of-the-art research facilities
• A multi-cultural and stimulating work environment

• A 1-year fixed-term contract (CDD), renewable for 4 years

Informations

The selection process involves multiple stages, and short-listed candidates will be requested to apply to a specific EPFL Doctoral Program to qualify for a PhD at EPFL, i.e. EDMX, EDAM, or EDCH.
Please check this page for additional information on admission.

Please note that this is a separate application process necessary to be eligible to complete your PhD at EPFL.

Your application should contain:

• A brief state of your past research experience and future goals (max 2 pages)

• Your detailed CV

• Contact information

• The names and contact information of 2 references willing to write a recommendation letter

Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered.

Application deadline: [01/07/2026]

Contract Start Date: As soon as possible

Activity Rate : 100.00

Contract Type: PhD Student

Duration: 1 year, renewable for 4 years

Reference: 2251

For more questions, please contact: daryl.yee@epfl.ch

jobs.description:
Introduction

The Apertus project, a joint effort between EPFL and ETH Zürich, is seeking a practical and motivated engineer to help build the next generation of open foundation models. The successful candidate will help develop and run post-training and reinforcement learning pipelines for the Apertus project.

Apertus is trained and developed on Alps, the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre’s supercomputing infrastructure. The role requires someone who is comfortable working in an HPC environment and collaborating with researchers and infrastructure engineers.

Main duties and responsibilities

The engineer will contribute to the development, execution, and evaluation of scalable post-training workflows for Apertus.

Infrastructure and systems engineering

• Build and maintain containerized environments for LLM post-training and RL workloads.

• Adapt containers and dependencies for execution on Alps / CSCS infrastructure.

• Run and monitor Slurm-based training and evaluation jobs.

• Debug failures related to distributed execution, checkpointing, filesystem performance, networking, and GPU utilization.

• Help maintain reproducible training recipes, configuration files, launch scripts, and documentation.

• Work with researchers and CSCS engineers to improve the reliability and performance of large-scale experiments.

LLM post-training and Reinforcement Learning

• Support SFT, preference optimization, and reinforcement learning workflows.

• Build and run RL environments for tasks with verifiable outcomes, such as mathematics, code, tool-use, and reasoning.

• Develop reward modeling, reward calibration and verifier-based training.

• Generate and validate synthetic or gym training tasks.

• Run ablation studies comparing algorithms, reward functions, data mixtures, hyperparameters, and infrastructure settings.

• Evaluate model behavior across reasoning, coding, mathematics, instruction-following, multilingual, tool-use, and safety benchmarks.

• Debug common post-training issues, including optimization instability, reward hacking, regressions, and evaluation failures.

Profile

Essential

• MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field. Exceptional BSc candidates with strong engineering experience will also be considered.

• Experience in AI and neural network architectures

• Strong collaboration and communication skills and ability to work across research and engineering teams.

Strongly preferred

• Experience with Slurm or another HPC workload manager.

• Experience building or adapting containers for HPC or GPU clusters.

• Experience with LLM fine-tuning, post-training, preference optimization, or reinforcement learning.

• Familiarity with distributed training concepts such as data parallelism, tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, checkpointing, and GPU communication.

• Experience with frameworks such as veRL, slime, Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, TRL, vLLM, SGLang, or similar tools.

Nice to have

• Experience with RL for LLMs, online policy optimization, reward modeling, or RLVR.

• Experience creating verifiable tasks for mathematics, code, reasoning, or tool use.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction

The Apertus project, a joint effort between EPFL and ETH Zürich, is seeking a practical and motivated engineer to help build the next generation of open foundation models. The successful candidate will help develop and run post-training and reinforcement learning pipelines for the Apertus project.

Apertus is trained and developed on Alps, the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre’s supercomputing infrastructure. The role requires someone who is comfortable working in an HPC environment and collaborating with researchers and infrastructure engineers.

Main duties and responsibilities

The engineer will contribute to the development, execution, and evaluation of scalable post-training workflows for Apertus.

Infrastructure and systems engineering

• Build and maintain containerized environments for LLM post-training and RL workloads.

• Adapt containers and dependencies for execution on Alps / CSCS infrastructure.

• Run and monitor Slurm-based training and evaluation jobs.

• Debug failures related to distributed execution, checkpointing, filesystem performance, networking, and GPU utilization.

• Help maintain reproducible training recipes, configuration files, launch scripts, and documentation.

• Work with researchers and CSCS engineers to improve the reliability and performance of large-scale experiments.

LLM post-training and Reinforcement Learning

• Support SFT, preference optimization, and reinforcement learning workflows.

• Build and run RL environments for tasks with verifiable outcomes, such as mathematics, code, tool-use, and reasoning.

• Develop reward modeling, reward calibration and verifier-based training.

• Generate and validate synthetic or gym training tasks.

• Run ablation studies comparing algorithms, reward functions, data mixtures, hyperparameters, and infrastructure settings.

• Evaluate model behavior across reasoning, coding, mathematics, instruction-following, multilingual, tool-use, and safety benchmarks.

• Debug common post-training issues, including optimization instability, reward hacking, regressions, and evaluation failures.

Profile

Essential

• MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field. Exceptional BSc candidates with strong engineering experience will also be considered.

• Experience in AI and neural network architectures

• Strong collaboration and communication skills and ability to work across research and engineering teams.

Strongly preferred

• Experience with Slurm or another HPC workload manager.

• Experience building or adapting containers for HPC or GPU clusters.

• Experience with LLM fine-tuning, post-training, preference optimization, or reinforcement learning.

• Familiarity with distributed training concepts such as data parallelism, tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, checkpointing, and GPU communication.

• Experience with frameworks such as veRL, slime, Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, TRL, vLLM, SGLang, or similar tools.

Nice to have

• Experience with RL for LLMs, online policy optimization, reward modeling, or RLVR.

• Experience creating verifiable tasks for mathematics, code, reasoning, or tool use.

• Familiarity with lower-level GPU/distributed libraries such as NCCL, Transformer Engine, FlashAttention, or communication backends.

• Experience with large-scale evaluation pipelines.

We offer

• A stimulating academic environment at one of the world's leading technical universities

• The opportunity to work with state-of-the-art supercomputing infrastructure and cutting-edge AI research

• Collaboration with top researchers and engineers from EPFL, ETH Zürich, CSCS, and other Swiss institutions

• Flexible working arrangements, including options for remote work

• Professional development opportunities, including conference attendance and specialized training

• The chance to contribute to open-source projects with global impact

• Access to the broader Swiss academic ecosystem

jobs.description:
Mission

Rejoignez l'EPFL et contribuez à un environnement de travail et d'études respectueux, où chaque personne sait vers qui se tourner.

L'EPFL met en place un nouveau cadre institutionnel de gestion des plaintes pour atteinte à la personnalité et de gestion de conflits. Vous en accompagnez d'abord la mise en œuvre, puis en assurez le pilotage opérationnel et la coordination au quotidien. Votre rôle garantit la bonne articulation des différentes parties prenantes, internes et externes, et veille à ce que ce cadre reste accessible, compréhensible et orienté service pour l'ensemble de la communauté.

C'est un poste à fort impact humain, au croisement de l'organisation, de la collaboration et du discernement, pour une personne qui sait conjuguer rigueur procédurale et sens des situations.

Principales tâches et responsabilités

Pilotage et coordination

• Assurer la coordination opérationnelle et le suivi quotidien du dispositif, des dossiers, des actions et des décisions, dans le respect des délais et des procédures institutionnelles.

• Coordonner le traitement interne, cohérent, diligent et confidentiel des situations transmises par l'instance externe chargée de la réception des plaintes et de l'enquête préliminaire, notamment en réunissant le comité interne qui analyse l'enquête et ses recommandations.

• Constituer un point de contact et d'orientation pour les principales parties prenantes internes et l’instance externe.

• Préparer et coordonner les séances de gouvernance du dispositif, rédiger les procès-verbaux et assurer la traçabilité des éléments de suivi et de décision.

Collaboration transverse et amélioration continue

• Collaborer étroitement avec les unités en charge de la prévention, de l'accompagnement et du soutien, pour une approche coordonnée et cohérente.

• Structurer, documenter et faire évoluer les procédures, outils et modalités de coordination du dispositif.

• Participer à l'évolution du dispositif institutionnel de gestion des atteintes à la personnalité.

Reporting

Contribuer à la consolidation des données, au suivi des indicateurs et au reporting institutionnel liés aux atteintes à la personnalité.

Profil

• Formation universitaire ou équivalente en ressources humaines, psychologie du travail, gestion, santé au travail ou domaine connexe.

• Expérience dans la coordination de dispositifs transverses ou la gestion de processus, idéalement en environnement institutionnel ou dans l'accompagnement de situations sensibles.

• Une expérience en gestion de projets ou en amélioration continue constitue un atout.

• Excellentes capacités d'organisation, de coordination et de structuration de processus complexes.

• Orientation service et sens de l'expérience utilisatrice.

• Très bonnes compétences relationnelles et de communication en français et anglais, avec une aisance à collaborer avec des interlocutrices et interlocuteurs variés dans un environnement sensible.

• Sens marqué de la confidentialité, du discernement et de l'éthique, esprit d'analyse et capacité de synthèse.

Nous offrons

• Un poste où vous aurez l’occasion de construire, d’analyser, de proposer des améliorations pour apporter une réelle valeur ajoutée

• Un environnement de travail stimulant, dynamique et multiculturel au sein de notre Vice-Présidence pour le développement humain

• Des conditions de travail attractive favorisant l’équilibre, le développement et l'engagement professionnel.

Informations

Date d'entrée en fonction : Dès que possible

Taux d'occupation min : 80.00

Taux d'occupation max : 100.00

Type de contrat : CDI

Référence : 2325

• Un forte senso di riservatezza, discernimento ed etica, uno spirito di analisi e capacità di sintesi. Offriamo

Missione Unisciti al vice-presidente EPFL per lo sviluppo umano (VH) e diventare un supporto di gestione chiave sulle sue questioni più strategiche. All'incrocio di analisi, coordinamento e consulenza, si prepara e segue i file chiave che informano il processo decisionale e anticipano i progetti prioritari HPV. È una posizione per una persona che ama comprendere questioni complesse, identificare gli elementi essenziali e trasformare l'analisi in raccomandazioni chiare, con rigore, discrezione e senso di esito. Principali compiti e responsabilità Analisi strategica e preparazione delle decisioni
• Analisi, reporting e studi strategici relativi a questioni umane e organizzative.
• Condurre sintesi esecutive evidenziando i risultati, i rischi, i problemi e le opzioni di decisione.
• Preparare i file di gestione, garantendo qualità, rilevanza e affidabilità delle analisi.
• Sviluppare note di briefing, presentazioni e materiali decisionali su misura per le esigenze di gestione.
• Contribuire al pensiero strategico fornendo opportunità di miglioramento e raccomandazioni. Condurre e seguire i file di taglio incrociato
• Monitorare i file strategici e i piani di azione affidati dalla gestione HPV.
• Coordinare i contributi dei vari stakeholder e facilitare gli scambi tra gli attori interessati.
• Sviluppare e mantenere strumenti di monitoraggio e pilotaggio.
• Identificare i rischi e le strozzature, e proporre misure per anticipazione o correzione.
• Assicurarsi che le scadenze, gli impegni e i consegnabili siano rispettati. Profilo
• Istruzione universitaria (Bachelor o Master) in pubblica amministrazione, risorse umane, gestione, scienze politiche, diritto, economia, relazioni internazionali o equivalente. La formazione aggiuntiva nella gestione o nella gestione dei progetti è un bene.
• 5-7 anni di esperienza nelle funzioni analitiche, di project management o di consulenza, idealmente con una pratica di preparazione dei file decisionali per la gestione.
• Conoscenza del settore pubblico o parapubblico, un bene.
• Analisi e sintesi eccellenti: comprensione di problemi complessi, identificazione di questioni chiave e raccomandazioni chiare e pragmatiche.
• Un senso di consulenza e supporto per il processo decisionale: produrre analisi affidabili, mettere in prospettiva diverse opzioni e accompagnare la gestione nelle loro scelte.
• Forte capacità di organizzare e gestire le priorità, con autonomia e proattività nella conduzione simultanea di diversi file.
• Capacità di coordinare più stakeholder e mobilitare interlocutori non gerarchici, sviluppando relazioni di fiducia.
• Ottimissime competenze editoriali e relazionali, con comunicazione adattata a vari pubblico, in francese e in inglese.
• Discrezione, senso di responsabilità e trattamento riservato di informazioni sensibili. Offriamo
• Una posizione in cui si avrà l'opportunità di costruire, analizzare, proporre miglioramenti per portare valore aggiunto reale

descriptionByLocale.en:
Mission Join EPFL's Vice-President for Human Development (VH) and become key management support on its most strategic issues. At the intersection of analysis, coordination and advice, you prepare and follow key files that inform decision-making and advance HPV priority projects. It is a position for a person who likes to understand complex issues, identify the essentials and turn analysis into clear recommendations—with rigour, discretion and sense of outcome. Main tasks and responsibilities Strategic analysis and decision preparation
• Analysis, reporting and strategic studies related to human and organizational issues.
• Conduct executive summaries highlighting findings, risks, issues and decision options.
• Prepare management files, ensuring quality, relevance and reliability of analyses.
• Develop briefing notes, presentations and decision-making materials tailored to management needs.
• Contribute to strategic thinking by providing opportunities for improvement and recommendations. Conduct and follow-up of cross-cutting files
• Monitor strategic files and action plans entrusted by HPV management.
• Coordinate the contributions of the various stakeholders and facilitate exchanges between the actors concerned.
• Develop and maintain monitoring and piloting tools.
• Identify risks and bottlenecks, and propose measures for anticipation or correction.
• Ensure that deadlines, commitments and deliverables are met. Profile
• University education (Bachelor or Master's degree) in public administration, human resources, management, political science, law, economics, international relations or equivalent. Additional training in project management or management is an asset.
• 5-7 years of experience in analytical, project management or advisory functions, ideally with a practice of preparing decision-making files for management.
• Knowledge of the public or parapublic sector, an asset.
• Excellent analysis and synthesis: understanding complex issues, identifying key issues and making clear and pragmatic recommendations.
• A sense of advice and support for decision-making: producing reliable analysis, putting different options into perspective and accompanying management in their choices.
• Strong capacity to organize and manage priorities, with autonomy and proactivity in the simultaneous conduct of several files.
• Ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and mobilize non-hierarchical interlocutors, developing trust relationships.
• Excellent editorial and relational skills, with communication adapted to various audiences, in French and English.
• Discretion, sense of responsibility and confidential treatment of sensitive information. We offer
• A position where you will have the opportunity to build, analyse, propose improvements to bring real added value
• A stimulating, dynamic and multicultural working environment within our Vice-President for Human Development
• Attractive working conditions that promote balance, development and professional commitment. Information Effective date: As soon as possible Min occupancy rate : 80.00 Max occupancy rate : 100,00 Type of contract: CDI Duration: Reference: 2324

Mission Treten Sie dem Vizepräsidenten für menschliche Entwicklung (VH) der EPFL bei und werden Sie wichtige Management-Unterstützung bei ihren wichtigsten strategischen Themen. An der Schnittstelle von Analyse, Koordination und Beratung erstellen und folgen Sie Schlüsseldateien, die die Entscheidungsfindung beeinflussen und HPV-Prioritätsprojekte vorantreiben. Es ist eine Position für eine Person, die gerne komplexe Themen versteht, das Wesentliche identifiziert und Analysen in klare Empfehlungen umwandelt - mit Strenge, Diskretion und Ergebnissinn. Hauptaufgaben und Zuständigkeiten Strategische Analyse und Entscheidungsvorbereitung
• Analyse, Berichterstattung und strategische Studien zu menschlichen und organisatorischen Fragen.
• Führen Sie Zusammenfassungen durch, in denen Ergebnisse, Risiken, Probleme und Entscheidungsoptionen hervorgehoben werden.
• Bereiten Sie Verwaltungsdateien vor und gewährleisten Sie Qualität, Relevanz und Zuverlässigkeit der Analysen.
• Entwicklung von Briefing-Notizen, Präsentationen und Entscheidungsunterlagen, die auf die Managementanforderungen zugeschnitten sind.
• Tragen Sie zum strategischen Denken bei, indem Sie Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten und Empfehlungen bieten. Durchführung und Weiterverfolgung bereichsübergreifender Dateien
• Überwachen Sie strategische Dateien und Aktionspläne, die vom HPV-Management anvertraut wurden.
• Koordinierung der Beiträge der verschiedenen Interessengruppen und Erleichterung des Austauschs zwischen den betroffenen Akteuren.
• Entwicklung und Pflege von Überwachungs- und Pilotierungsinstrumenten.
• Identifizieren Sie Risiken und Engpässe und schlagen Sie Maßnahmen zur Antizipation oder Korrektur vor.
• Gewährleistung, dass Fristen, Verpflichtungen und Ergebnisse eingehalten werden. Profil
• Hochschulbildung (Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss) in öffentlicher Verwaltung, Personalwesen, Management, Politikwissenschaft, Recht, Wirtschaft, internationale Beziehungen oder gleichwertig. Zusätzliche Schulungen im Projektmanagement oder Management sind ein Gewinn.
• 5-7 Jahre Erfahrung in analytischen, Projektmanagement- oder Beratungsfunktionen, idealerweise mit der Vorbereitung von Entscheidungsakten für das Management.
• Kenntnisse des öffentlichen oder paraöffentlichen Sektors, ein Vermögenswert.
• Ausgezeichnete Analyse und Synthese: komplexe Themen verstehen, Schlüsselthemen identifizieren und klare und pragmatische Empfehlungen geben.
• Ein Gefühl der Beratung und Unterstützung bei der Entscheidungsfindung: Erstellung zuverlässiger Analysen, Perspektivisierung verschiedener Optionen und Begleitung des Managements bei seinen Entscheidungen.
• Starke Fähigkeit, Prioritäten zu organisieren und zu verwalten, mit Autonomie und Proaktivität bei der gleichzeitigen Durchführung mehrerer Dateien.
• Fähigkeit, mehrere Stakeholder zu koordinieren und nicht-hierarchische Gesprächspartner zu mobilisieren, um Vertrauensbeziehungen aufzubauen.
• Hervorragende redaktionelle und relationale Fähigkeiten, mit an verschiedene Zielgruppen angepasster Kommunikation, in Französisch und Englisch.
• Diskretion, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und vertraulicher Umgang mit sensiblen Informationen. Wir bieten
• Eine Position, in der Sie die Möglichkeit haben, Verbesserungen aufzubauen, zu analysieren und vorzuschlagen, um einen echten Mehrwert zu schaffen
• Ein anregendes, dynamisches und multikulturelles Arbeitsumfeld in unserem Vizepräsidenten für menschliche Entwicklung
• Attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen, die Balance, Entwicklung und professionelles Engagement fördern. Information Datum des Inkrafttretens: So bald wie möglich Mindestbelegungsrate: 80,00 Max Belegungsrate: 100,00 Art des Vertrags: CDI Dauer: Bezug: 2324

jobs.description:
Mission

The EPFL computer vision lab ( https://www.epfl.ch/labs/cvlab/ ) is looking for a postdoctoral fellow to work on issues related to co-design for aerodynamic shape and control along the lines described in the following tech report https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06760 . A potential target application is the design of model gliders to compete in FAI competitions such as https://www.fai.org/page/f5-electric-flight .

Profile

Potential candidates are expected to have:

• A doctorate in a Machine-Learning related field

• A deep knowledge of Control Theory, both classical and deep learning based

• A solid publication record in top level ML venues such as NeurIPs, ICML, and ICLR

• Familiarity with aerodynamics and aircraft design would be a plus

We offer

• A stimulating and international working environment

• Competitive salary and excellent working conditions – more information can be found on our website ( https://www.epfl.ch/campus/services/human-resources/en/basic-starting-salary-of-doctoral-assistants-and-postdocs/)

• Opportunity to perform state-of-the-art research in one of the most dynamic scientific institutions in Europe.

• Opportunity to interact with internationally renowned experts, and with a strong team of postdoctoral researchers and PhD students

Informations

Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered. You are asked to supply:

A brief cover letter (pdf, up to 2 pages).

And in one PDF:

A CV with a publication list.
A research statement (pdf, up to 3 pages).
Contact details for 3 referees.

Contract start date : Flexible (Fall 2026 preferred)

Activity rate : 100%

Contract type : CDD

Duration : One year, renewable

Mission

Le laboratoire de vision informatique de l'EPFL (https://www.epfl.ch/labs/cvlab/ ) est à la recherche d'un boursier postdoctoral pour travailler sur des questions liées à la co-conception pour la forme et le contrôle aérodynamiques selon les lignes décrites dans le rapport technique suivant https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06760 . Une application cible possible est la conception de planeurs modèles pour participer à des concours FAI tels que https://www.fai.org/page/f5-electric-flight .

Profil

Les candidats potentiels devraient avoir :

• Un doctorat dans un domaine lié à l'apprentissage automatique

• Une connaissance approfondie de la théorie du contrôle, à la fois classique et fondée sur l'apprentissage profond

• Un solide record de publication dans des sites de niveau supérieur comme les NeurIP, le CIML et le CILR

• La familiarité avec l'aérodynamique et la conception des avions serait un plus

jobs.description:
Mission

The A. Mathis Group for Computational Neuroscience and AI (CNAI), led by Professor Alexander Mathis, is seeking two postdoctoral fellows to join our team working at the intersection of artificial intelligence and neuroscience. Our research is built around three intertwined questions: how to measure and understand behavior with AI, how brains and embodied agents learn to control the body, and how the brain builds a sense of its body through proprioception. We develop widely-used open-source tools (e.g., DeepLabCut), train biomechanically realistic embodied agents (e.g., MuscleMimic, Kinesis, Arnold), and build AI-based models of sensorimotor processing.

We are recruiting two postdocs:

• Postdoc in Computer Vision & AI for Behavior Analysis

• Postdoc in Embodied AI (Reinforcement Learning for Motor Control)

Main duties and responsibilities

For both positions:

• Conduct innovative, independent research aligned with the lab's mission and the candidate's interests

• Contribute to the lab's open-source software, datasets, and benchmarks

• Mentor PhD and Master's students and contribute to the lab's collaborative culture

• Engage with collaborators across EPFL and beyond (neuroscience labs, ecology partners, clinical collaborators)

• Present research at international conferences and workshops

Position 1: Computer Vision & AI for Behavior Analysis

• Contribute to the creation of behavioral datasets for groups of animals

• Develop methods for animal and environment reconstruction

• Develop methods for behavior understanding from multi-view video and audio recordings

• Advance multimodal large language models for fine-grained action understanding and reasoning

• Help shape the next generation of DeepLabCut and related open-source tools used by labs worldwide.

Position 2: Embodied AI

• Train muscle-actuated, biomechanically realistic agents to perform skilled motor tasks using reinforcement learning, imitation learning, and curriculum methods;

• Develop new methods for full-body musculoskeletal control

• Probe links between learned control policies and neural representations of movement in collaboration with experimental labs

Profile

Common requirements:

• PhD (completed or close to completion) in computer science, applied mathematics, computational neuroscience, robotics, physics or a closely related field;

• Strong publication record in relevant venues;

• Solid programming skills in Python and a modern deep-learning framework

• Excellent communication skills in spoken and written English;

• Self-motivated, collaborative, and committed to open science and reproducible research;

• Demonstrated ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

Position 1 — additional desirable expertise:
computer vision, video understanding, action recognition, multimodal/vision-language models, pose estimation, or large-scale self-supervised learning. Familiarity with neuroscience, or ethology is a plus.

Position 2 — additional desirable expertise:
reinforcement learning, imitation learning, optimal control, dynamical systems, or related ML areas; experience with physics simulators (MuJoCo). Familiarity with motor neuroscience and biomechanics is a plus.

We offer

• A vibrant, collaborative research environment at the intersection of AI and neuroscience

• Access to EPFL's compute infrastructure and to the broader EPFL ecosystem

• Competitive salary in line with EPFL postdoc standards

• Excellent working conditions

• Opportunities for international collaboration, conference travel, and professional development

Informations

• Contract start date: flexible, ideally summer 2026 or as soon as possible thereafter

• Activity rate: 100%

• Contract type: fixed-term, initially one year with the possibility of extension

• Work location: Campus Biotech, Geneva

How to apply

Applications should be submitted exclusively through the EPFL website. Postdoctoral applications should consist of:

Mathis Gruppe für Computational Neuroscience and AI (CNAI), geleitet von Professor Alexander Mathis, sucht zwei Postdoc-Stipendiaten, die sich unserem Team anschließen, das an der Schnittstelle von künstlicher Intelligenz und Neurowissenschaften arbeitet. MuscleMimic, Kinesis, Arnold) et construisons des modèles de traitement sensorimoteur basés sur l'IA.

• Postdoc dans l'IA (Apprentissage du renforcement pour le contrôle moteur)

• Aidez à façonner la prochaine génération de DeepLabCut et les outils open-source connexes utilisés par les laboratoires du monde entier.

la vision informatique, la compréhension vidéo, la reconnaissance de l'action, les modèles multimodaux/vision-langue, l'estimation de pose ou l'apprentissage autosupervisé à grande échelle. La connaissance des neurosciences ou de l'éthologie est un atout.

renforcement de l'apprentissage, imitation de l'apprentissage, contrôle optimal, systèmes dynamiques, ou domaines ML connexes; expérience avec les simulateurs de physique (MuJoCo). La connaissance de la neuroscience motrice et de la biomécanique est un plus.

jobs.description:
IMOS

The Intelligent Maintenance and Operations Systems (IMOS) Lab at EPFL is looking for a motivated and out-of-the-box thinking PhD researcher, (100%, in Lausanne, fixed-term) starting in September or upon agreement.

Project description

The objective of this project is to develop novel methodologies based on physics-informed graph neural networks (PI-GNNs) to understand and model the impact of operational loads on system degradation at the compenent level in complex engineering systems, with a particular focus on wind turbines.

The research will focus on explicitly integrating physical laws, load dynamics, and degradation mechanisms into graph-based models, enabling a principled understanding of how operating conditions drive the evolution of system health over time. Particular emphasis will be placed on spatiotemporal modeling of interacting subsystems, where degradation emerges from coupled physical processes across components.

The project will explore how graph-based representations can capture:
• the propagation of loads and stresses across interconnected components,
• the accumulation of fatigue and damage under variable loading conditions, and
• the interaction between structural dynamics and degradation processes.

A central aspect of the research is the incorporation of physics-based inductive biases into learning architectures. This will enable the development of models that are physically consistent, interpretable, and robust under varying operating conditions, going beyond purely data-driven approaches.

Applications will include complex industrial and energy systems, with a particular focus on wind turbines, where load conditions directly influence the degradation of critical components such as blades, gearboxes, and bearings. The developed methods will contribute to improving lifetime modeling, reliability assessment, and physics-informed predictive maintenance.

This PhD position is part of an ERC Consolidator Grant, supporting cutting-edge research on physics-informed AI, intelligent maintenance, and the modeling of degradation processes in complex systems.

Profile

We are looking for a PhD candidate with a strong analytical background and an outstanding MSc degree in Mechanical Engineering, Computational Mechanics, Engineering Science, Physics, Applied Mathematics, or a closely related field.

You should have a solid foundation in machine learning (e.g., deep learning) and mathematical modeling, including experience with dynamical systems or differential equations. A strong interest in modeling physical systems and degradation processes (e.g., fatigue, damage accumulation) is expected.

Experience with graph neural networks or spatiotemporal models is highly desirable, as well as familiarity with physics-informed approaches that incorporate physical inductive bias into learning models.

Knowledge of one or more of the following areas is considered a strong asset:

• Physics-informed machine learning and hybrid modeling approaches

• Computational mechanics, structural dynamics, or fatigue and damage modeling

• Signal processing and analysis of measurement data from physical systems

• Scientific machine learning or numerical methods for physical systems

Strong programming skills and the ability to work at the interface of machine learning and physics-based modeling of engineering systems are expected.

We expect the candidate to be self-driven, with strong problem-solving abilities and out-of-the-box thinking. Professional command of English (both written and spoken) is mandatory.
