jobs.description:
Mission

Dans le cadre d'un remplacement congé maternité, nous recherchons une ou un Partenaire Expérience Employé·es.

Dans cette fonction, vous interviendrez directement dans la gestion du périmètre attribué pour apporter conseil et soutien à une Vice-Présidence ainsi qu’aux équipes.

Principales tâches et responsabilités

La ou le Partenaire Expérience Employé.es :

- Soutient la Direction du périmètre attribué pour toutes les questions liées à la gestion du personnel

- Participe aux diverses réunions de Direction et avec les membres du personnel pour présenter et les accompagner sur les différents sujets

- Conseille et accompagne des responsables d’unités dans la gestion de leur équipe, en développant les bonnes pratiques managériales

- Selon besoin, participe aux processus de recrutements

- Conseille et accompagne les collaborateurs et collaboratrices tout au long de leur carrière à l’EPFL et répond à leurs questions, par exemple : rémunération, développement, compétences, mobilité interne, évaluations, etc.

- Gère et assure le suivi des situations problématiques liées au personnel

- Soutient les responsables d’unité dans les projets de transformation (réorganisation, fermeture de laboratoires, etc.)

- Pilote les processus annuels tel que révision de salaire, gestion de la performance et développement du personnel, primes, etc.

- Collabore avec les différents pôles d’expertises

- Garantit la mise en application des politiques VPH et des cadres légaux

- Assure le traitement des échéances et questions liées aux employé·es du périmètre (workflows, signature des contrats, etc.)

- Garantit la transparence sur les situations cas complexes et sensibles (cas juridiques, sensibles ou à fort enjeu)

- Contribue activement à des projets internes et transversaux, à des groupes de travail, à des animations d’ateliers dans le but de développer nos processus et prestations

Profil

- Formation universitaire ou HES, avec une spécialisation en Ressources Humaines, ou formation jugée équivalente

- Minimum 5 ans d’expérience dans une fonction analogue avec le même type de responsabilités, au sein d’une grande entreprise ou institution, ainsi que dans la gestion de grandes populations

- Bonnes connaissances des cadres légaux et administratifs RH suisses ; connaissance du droit public représente un atout

- Excellentes compétences de communication orale et écrite, en français et anglais

- Très forte orientation clients et sens relationnel pour créer des partenariats de confiance

- Approche orientée solutions et capacité à prendre des initiatives

- Bienveillance et diplomatie, patience et capacité à gérer des situations complexes

- Capacité d’analyse, de synthèse et de mise en oeuvre de solutions

- Très bonne organisation et excellente capacité à gérer les priorités et le stress

- Capacité à travailler en réseau et esprit d’équipe développé

Nous offrons

- Un environnement de travail stimulant, dynamique et multiculturel au sein du Domaine Expérience Employé·es de notre Vice-Présidence pour le développement humain ( lien )

- Une équipe qui se construit où chaque membre valorise la collaboration, la fluidité des activités et la bienveillance

- Des conditions de travail attractive favorisant l’équilibre, le développement et l'engagement professionnel.

Informations

Date d'entrée en fonction : à convenir

Taux d'occupation min : 80%

Taux d'occupation max : 100%

Type de contrat : CDD

Durée : 6 à 8 mois

Référence : 2189

titleByLocale.de: PhD-Position in interpretable AI für koupierte Multiphysik von Geomaterialien
titleByLocale.fr: Poste de PhD dans l'intelligence artificielle pour la multiphysique couplée des géomatériaux

jobs.description:
Mission

• The Data-Driven Mechanics Laboratory invites applications for a fully funded PhD position at
• the intersection of computational mechanics, multiphysics of geomaterials, and interpretable
• machine learning. The project focuses on the discovery of governing equations and constitutive
• relations for key multiphysics phenomena on the basis of rich micromechanical and
• experimental data. It pushes the boundaries of modeling and understanding crucial processes
• in geomaterials across scales, with application to geophysics, energy and sustainability.

Main roles and responsibilities

• The successful candidate will contribute to a next-generation data-driven framework for
• scientific discovery in geomaterials. Research will involve the development of techniques
• spanning mechanics and AI, including physics-based modeling across scales
• (discrete/mesoscale/continuum), thermodynamics-informed machine learning and
• neurosymbolic AI. They will also have the opportunity to lead international collaborations with
• experimental research groups.

Requirements

• ● Master’s degree in Mechanics, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geophysics,
• Applied Mathematics, Computational Science or related areas.
• ● Strong computational/programming skills (Python/C/C++) including computational
• mechanics, and scientific machine learning.
• ● Excellent English communication skills (oral and written).

We offer

• ● World-class multi-cultural environment on the shores of beautiful Lake Leman.
• ● Innovative interdisciplinary research at the Data-Driven Mechanics Lab.
• ● Exceptional research infrastructure and access to world-class computational resources.
• ● Competitive salary and employment conditions.

Informations

• Please email a single PDF consisting of i) a Curriculum vitae (max. 2 pages) with contact details
• of at least 2 referees, ii) Detailed transcripts, and iii) a Motivation letter (max. 1 page), to
• konstantinos.karapiperis@epfl.ch, indicating in the subject “PhD Application LMD – Last Name”
• until July 15th 2026. Applications will be evaluated on a rolling basis in the order that they are
• received. For inquiries please contact Prof. Kostas Karapiperis at the same email.

Contract Start Date: Fall/Winter 2026

Activity Rate : 100.00

Contract Type: One-year renewable contract

Duration: 4 years

Reference: 2267

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione
• Il Data-Driven Mechanics Laboratory invita le applicazioni per una posizione di dottorato completamente finanziata
• l'intersezione di meccanica computazionale, multifisica di geomateriali e interpretabile
• apprendimento automatico. Il progetto si concentra sulla scoperta di equazioni di governo e costitutive
• relazioni per i principali fenomeni multifisici sulla base di ricchi micromeccanici e
• dati sperimentali. Spinge i confini della modellazione e della comprensione dei processi cruciali
• in geomateriali su scala, con applicazione a geofisica, energia e sostenibilità. Principali ruoli e responsabilità
• Il candidato di successo contribuirà ad un quadro di dati di nuova generazione per
• scoperta scientifica nei geomateriali. La ricerca coinvolgerà lo sviluppo delle tecniche
• meccanica e AI, compresa la modellazione fisica su scala
• (discreto/mesoscale/continuum), apprendimento automatico termodinamico e
• AI neurosimbolico. Essi avranno anche l'opportunità di condurre collaborazioni internazionali con
• gruppi di ricerca sperimentali. Requisiti
• ● laurea magistrale in meccanica, ingegneria civile, ingegneria meccanica, geofisica,
• Matematica applicata, Scienza computazionale o aree correlate.
• ● Forte competenze computazionali / di programmazione (Python/C/C++) tra cui computazionale
• meccanica e apprendimento delle macchine scientifiche.
• ● Eccellente capacità di comunicazione inglese (ordinario e scritto). Offriamo
• ● Ambiente multiculturale di livello mondiale sulle rive del bellissimo lago Leman.
• ● Ricerca interdisciplinare innovativa presso il Data-Driven Mechanics Lab.
• ● Eccezionale infrastruttura di ricerca e accesso alle risorse computazionali di livello mondiale.
• ● Contributi competitivi e condizioni di lavoro. Informazioni
• Si prega di inviare un singolo PDF composto da i) a Curriculum vitae (max. 2 pagine) con recapiti
• di almeno 2 arbitri, ii) Trascrizioni dettagliate, e iii) una lettera di motivazione (max. 1 pagina), a
• konstantinos.karapiperis@epfl.ch, indicando nel soggetto “PhD Application LMD – Last Name”
• fino al 15 luglio 2026. Le domande saranno valutate su una base di rotolamento nell'ordine che sono
• ricevuto. Per richieste rivolgersi al Prof. Kostas Karapiperis alla stessa e-mail. Data di inizio del contratto: autunno/inverno 2026 Tasso di attività: 100.00 Tipo di contratto: Contratto rinnovabile di un anno Durata: 4 anni Riferimento: 2267

jobs.description:
Mission

Despite recent technological advances both in the data management and in computer architecture domains, our ability to analyze data still falls behind the unstoppable data collection rates. Data-intensive applications are increasingly more demanding in sophisticated algorithms to store, manage, and interpret data. To meet the challenges, database software needs to communicate efficiently both with the application layer and with the underlying hardware platforms, and deliver seamless computational and data management support. Research in the DIAS lab addresses both aspects of the challenge: we adapt data management technology to computer architecture trends by designing data manipulation techniques that exploit optimally the underlying hardware and I/O devices, and we enable new discoveries in scientific domains through automating physical database design and revolutionizing exploration algorithms in very large data repositories. The DIAS lab pioneers just-in-time query engines which support analytics on raw data, data cleaning and query optimization for heterogeneous distributed data, and hardware/software codesigned engines for demanding applications.

Main duties and responsibilities

•
Work closely with all members of the lab carrying out excellent research

•
Supervise students and collaborate with other postdocs

•
(optional) Contribute to teaching (especially if interested in an academic career)

Profile

•
Highly motivated with proven scientific excellence in the areas of vector query processing, serverless/just-in-time query execution, parallel and distributed data management, and data management systems on emerging hardware

•
Passionate about inventing, building, and publishing quality database systems research

•
A strong publication record and hands-on experience in system development are especially important

We offer

• The DIAS Lab team is renowned for its collaborative and nourishing culture, which supports the lab’s members since their first day in the team and long after their departure

•
Excellent working conditions

•
The contract is fixed for one year initially, renewable up to four years

Informations

Interested parties should send an application through the system including a CV, a research statement, and the names of at least three references. For inquiries regarding the research aspects of the position, contact Prof. Anastasia Ailamaki .

Contract Start Date : 01/01/2026

Activity Rate : 100.00

Contract Type : CDD

Duration: 1-year fixed-term contract, renewable

Reference: 1809

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione

Nonostante i recenti progressi tecnologici sia nella gestione dei dati che nei domini dell'architettura informatica, la nostra capacità di analizzare i dati ricade ancora dietro i tassi di raccolta dei dati inarrestabili. Le applicazioni ad alta intensità di dati sono sempre più esigenti in algoritmi sofisticati per memorizzare, gestire e interpretare i dati. Per rispondere alle sfide, il software del database deve comunicare in modo efficiente sia con lo strato dell'applicazione che con le piattaforme hardware sottostanti, e fornire un supporto di calcolo e gestione dei dati senza soluzione di continuità. La ricerca nel laboratorio DIAS affronta entrambi gli aspetti della sfida: adattamo la tecnologia di gestione dei dati alle tendenze dell'architettura informatica progettando tecniche di manipolazione dei dati che sfruttano in modo ottimale l'hardware sottostante e i dispositivi I/O, e consentiamo nuove scoperte nei domini scientifici attraverso l'automazione della progettazione del database fisico e la rivoluzione degli algoritmi di esplorazione in repository di dati molto grandi. Il laboratorio DIAS pionieri dei motori di query just-in-time che supportano l'analisi dei dati grezzi, la pulizia dei dati e l'ottimizzazione delle query per i dati distribuiti eterogenei e i motori coprogetti hardware/software per applicazioni complesse.

Principali doveri e responsabilità

•
Lavorare a stretto contatto con tutti i membri del laboratorio che effettuano una ricerca eccellente

•
Superviare gli studenti e collaborare con altri postdoc

•
(opzionale) Contribuire all'insegnamento (specialmente se interessati ad una carriera accademica)

Profilo

•
Altamente motivato con comprovata eccellenza scientifica nei settori dell'elaborazione delle query vettoriali, dell'esecuzione delle query serverless/just-in-time, della gestione dei dati paralleli e distribuiti e dei sistemi di gestione dei dati sull'hardware emergente

•
Passione per l'invenzione, la costruzione e la pubblicazione di sistemi di database di qualità

•
Un forte record di pubblicazione e esperienza pratica nello sviluppo del sistema sono particolarmente importanti

Offriamo

• Il team DIAS Lab è rinomato per la sua cultura collaborativa e nutriente, che sostiene i membri del laboratorio fin dal primo giorno nella squadra e molto tempo dopo la loro partenza

•
Condizioni di lavoro eccellenti

•
Il contratto è fissato per un anno inizialmente, rinnovabile fino a quattro anni

Informazioni

Le parti interessate devono inviare una domanda attraverso il sistema compreso un CV, una dichiarazione di ricerca e i nomi di almeno tre riferimenti. Per domande riguardanti gli aspetti di ricerca della posizione, contattare Prof. Anastasia Ailamaki .

Data di inizio del contratto: 01/01/2026

Tasso di attività: 100.00

Tipo di contratto: CDD

Durata: 1 anno contratto a tempo determinato, rinnovabile

Riferimento: 1809

jobs.description:
Mission

The Chair of Operations, Economics and Strategy (OES) at the College of Management of Technology at EPFL invites applications for a full-time PhD student position within the EPFL doctoral school program in Management of Technology (EDMT).

We are offering a challenging full-time PhD student position at the Chair of Operations, Economics and Strategy (OES) at EPFL.

The mission of OES is to conduct world-class research and teaching at the intersection of operations, economics, and strategy, with a focus on organizations and their interactions.

At OES, you will have the opportunity to work on the design, analysis, and implementation of innovative models for decision-making, economics, and operations. Research topics may include optimization, decision-making under uncertainty, market design and pricing, operations research, dynamic systems, and strategy-relevant applications.

Main duties and responsibilities

• Develop and complete an original doctoral dissertation

• Conduct independent research in close interaction with the Chair and, where appropriate, with external or industry partners

• Contribute to teaching activities, including co-supervision of student projects

• Provide limited support for academic and administrative activities of the Chair

Profile

• An excellent Master’s-level degree in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field

• A strong mathematical background, including familiarity with optimization, probability, and the analysis of mathematical models

• A sincere interest in business-related, economic, and operational problems

• Proficiency in English

• Strong motivation for academic research, critical thinking, independence, good self-management skills, and team spirit

• Interest in a career involving research and teaching is an asset

We offer

• Excellent working conditions in an international research environment

• Individual and intensive supervision of your PhD project

• Financial support in accordance with EPFL doctoral student conditions

• The opportunity to work on rigorous, practically relevant research at the interface of operations, economics, and strategy

Informations

Your application should include:

• CV

• Motivation letter

• Diplomas

• Transcripts/grades from Bachelor’s and Master’s studies

To be eligible for a PhD at EPFL, candidates must be admitted to an EPFL doctoral school program. For this position, candidates should also apply to the EPFL EDMT Doctoral School :
https://www.epfl.ch/education/phd/edmt-management-of-technology/edmt-how-to-apply/

Application deadlines: January 15, 2027 and April 15, 2027. Applications to OES may be reviewed on a rolling basis; formal admission to EDMT requires a complete application by one of these deadlines.

Expected start date: September 1st, 2027. An alternative start date may exceptionally be agreed upon by mutual agreement.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Mission Der Lehrstuhl für Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaft und Strategie (OES) am College of Management of Technology der EPFL lädt Bewerbungen für eine Vollzeit-Doktorandenposition im Rahmen des Doktorandenprogramms der EPFL in Management of Technology (EDMT) ein. Wir bieten eine herausfordernde Vollzeit-Doktorandenposition am Lehrstuhl für Operations, Wirtschaft und Strategie (OES) der EPFL. Die Mission von OES ist es, weltweite Forschung und Lehre an der Schnittstelle von Operationen, Wirtschaft und Strategie zu führen, mit einem Fokus auf Organisationen und ihre Interaktionen. Bei OES haben Sie die Möglichkeit, an der Gestaltung, Analyse und Umsetzung innovativer Modelle für Entscheidungsfindung, Wirtschaft und Betrieb zu arbeiten. Forschungsthemen können Optimierung, Entscheidungsfindung unter Unsicherheit, Marktdesign und Preisgestaltung, Betriebsforschung, dynamische Systeme und strategierelevante Anwendungen umfassen. Hauptaufgaben und Zuständigkeiten
• Entwickeln und Vervollständigen einer ursprünglichen Dissertation
• Durchführung unabhängiger Forschungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Lehrstuhl und gegebenenfalls mit externen oder Industriepartnern
• Beitrag zur Lehrtätigkeit, einschließlich der Betreuung von Studentenprojekten
• begrenzte Unterstützung für akademische und administrative Aktivitäten des Lehrstuhls Profil
• Ein ausgezeichneter Master-Level-Abschluss in Engineering, Angewandte Mathematik, Operations Research, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Mathematik, Informatik oder ein verwandten quantitativen Bereich
• Ein starker mathematischer Hintergrund, einschließlich Vertrautheit mit Optimierung, Wahrscheinlichkeit und der Analyse mathematischer Modelle
• Ein aufrichtiges Interesse an geschäftlichen, wirtschaftlichen und betrieblichen Problemen
• Englischkenntnisse
• Starke Motivation für akademische Forschung, kritisches Denken, Unabhängigkeit, gute Selbstverwaltung Fähigkeiten und Teamgeist
• Interesse an einer Karriere in Forschung und Lehre ist ein Vermögen Wir bieten
• Ausgezeichnete Arbeitsbedingungen in einem internationalen Forschungsumfeld
• Individuelle und intensive Betreuung Ihres PhD-Projekts
• Finanzielle Unterstützung gemäß den Doktorandenbedingungen der EPFL
• Die Möglichkeit, an strenger, praktisch relevanter Forschung an der Schnittstelle von Betrieben, Wirtschaft und Strategie zu arbeiten Informationen Ã1⁄4ber Ihre Anwendung sollte beinhalten:
• Lebenslauf
• Motivationsschreiben
• Diplome
• Transkripte/Klassen aus Bachelor- und Masterstudien Um bei der EPFL eine Doktorandenausbildung in Anspruch nehmen zu können, müssen die Bewerber in ein Doktorandenprogramm der EPFL aufgenommen werden. Für diese Position sollten die Bewerber auch für die EPFL EDMT-Doktorandenschule gelten : http://www.epfl.ch/education/phd/edmt-management-of-technology/edmt-how-to-apply/ Bewerbungsfristen: 15. Januar 2027 und 15. April 2027. Bewerbungen an OES können rollend überprüft werden; die formale Zulassung zum EDMT erfordert eine vollständige Bewerbung um eine dieser Fristen. Voraussichtlicher Starttermin: 1. September 2027. Ein alternativer Starttermin kann in Ausnahmefällen durch gegenseitiges Einverständnis vereinbart werden. Es werden nur Bewerber kontaktiert.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Mission La Chaire d'exploitation, d'économie et de stratégie (OES) du Collège de gestion de la technologie de l'EPFL invite les candidats à un poste de doctorant à temps plein au sein du programme d'études doctorales de l'EPFL en gestion de la technologie (EDMT). Nous offrons un poste de doctorant à temps plein à la Chaire d'opérations, d'économie et de stratégie (OES) de l'EPFL. La mission de l'OES est de mener des recherches et de l'enseignement de calibre mondial à l'intersection des opérations, de l'économie et de la stratégie, en mettant l'accent sur les organisations et leurs interactions. Chez OES, vous aurez l'occasion de travailler sur la conception, l'analyse et la mise en œuvre de modèles innovants pour la prise de décision, l'économie et les opérations. Les sujets de recherche peuvent inclure l'optimisation, la prise de décisions dans le cadre de l'incertitude, la conception et la tarification du marché, la recherche opérationnelle, les systèmes dynamiques et les applications stratégiques. Principales fonctions et responsabilités
• Élaborer et compléter une thèse de doctorat originale
• Mener des recherches indépendantes en étroite collaboration avec la chaire et, le cas échéant, avec des partenaires extérieurs ou industriels
• Contribuer aux activités d'enseignement, y compris la co-surveillance des projets étudiants
• Apporter un appui limité aux activités universitaires et administratives de la chaire Profil
• Un excellent master en ingénierie, mathématiques appliquées, recherche opérationnelle, économie, génie industriel, mathématiques, informatique, ou un domaine quantitatif connexe
• Un solide contexte mathématique, y compris la familiarité avec l'optimisation, la probabilité et l'analyse des modèles mathématiques
• Un intérêt sincère pour les problèmes commerciaux, économiques et opérationnels
• Compétence en anglais
• Forte motivation pour la recherche académique, la pensée critique, l'indépendance, de bonnes compétences en autogestion et l'esprit d'équipe
• L'intérêt pour une carrière impliquant la recherche et l'enseignement est un atout Nous offrons
• Excellentes conditions de travail dans un environnement de recherche international
• Supervision individuelle et intensive de votre projet de doctorat
• Soutien financier selon les conditions de doctorants de l'EPFL
• La possibilité de travailler sur des recherches rigoureuses et pratiquement pertinentes à l'interface des opérations, de l'économie et de la stratégie Informations Votre demande devrait comprendre:
• CV
• Lettre de motivation
• Diplômes
• Transcriptions/grades des études de baccalauréat et de maîtrise Pour être éligible à un doctorat à l'EPFL, les candidats doivent être admis à un programme d'études doctorales de l'EPFL. Pour ce poste, les candidats doivent également postuler à l'Ecole EPFL EDMT Doctorale : https://www.epfl.ch/education/phd/edmt-management-of-technology/edmt-how-to-apply/ Dates limites de présentation des demandes : 15 janvier 2027 et 15 avril 2027. Les demandes à l'OES peuvent être examinées sur une base continue; l'admission officielle à l'EDMT exige une demande complète dans l'un de ces délais. Date de début prévue : 1er septembre 2027. Une autre date de début peut exceptionnellement être convenue d'un commun accord. Seuls les candidats présélectionnés seront contactés.

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile amministrativo e finanziario - Separazioni NCCR (80%)
titleByLocale.en: Administrative and financial manager - NCCR Separations (80%)
titleByLocale.fr: Responsable administratif·ve et financier·ère - NCCR Separations (80%)

jobs.description:
Mission

Le pôle de recherche national « NCCR Separation» est un projet d’envergure nationale suisse financé principalement par le Fonds National Suisse. Il rassemble de nombreux chercheurs de haut niveau provenant de tout le pays et a pour objectif de développer de nouvelles techniques en sciences de la séparation et à accélérer le transfert de technologie afin d’atteindre les objectifs de développement durable de la Suisse et d’accélérer la marche vers la neutralité climatique mondiale.

L’EPFL, qui assure la direction de ce projet, est à la recherche d’un·e responsable administratif-ve et financier-ère pour gérer les opérations financières. La mission principale de ce poste consiste à centraliser et consolider les informations financières liées au projet au sein de l’EPFL ainsi qu’avec les partenaires externes.

Principales tâches et responsabilités

Gestion financière

• Assurer la gestion financière et la comptabilité du projet NCCR Separations.

• Participer à l'élaboration, au suivi et au pilotage du budget en étroite collaboration avec la direction du NCCR et les Program Managers.

• Assurer le suivi budgétaire des différentes institutions partenaires et préparer les rapports financiers internes et externes.

• Gérer la collecte, la vérification, le remboursement et la comptabilisation des dépenses du projet en collaboration avec l'ensemble des partenaires.

• Collecter, contrôler et conserver les données financières nécessaires aux rapports intermédiaires et finaux destinés au Fonds national suisse (FNS) via le portail de reporting.

• Préparer, coordonner et assurer le suivi des audits financiers du FNS.

• Collaborer avec les services centraux de l'EPFL et les partenaires du consortium sur toutes les questions financières et administratives.

Administration et coordination

• Assurer le soutien administratif du NCCR, notamment l'organisation des réunions, la préparation des ordres du jour et des procès-verbaux, la gestion des listes de diffusion et le suivi de la documentation.

• Fournir un soutien administratif à l'équipe de management (Program Manager, Communication Officer, KTT Officer, Data Manager, Scientific Officer) selon les besoins.

• Participer aux procédures de recrutement et assurer le suivi administratif des ressources humaines (publication des offres, onboarding, offboarding, accréditations, suivi des absences) en coordination avec les services RH compétents.

• Coordonner l'organisation logistique des événements du NCCR (workshops, formations, retraites, réunions, assemblées générales et manifestations scientifiques).

• Soutenir l'organisation des déplacements, visites, séjours scientifiques, programmes d'échange, bourses et secondments des membres du NCCR.

• Contribuer aux tâches transversales de l'unité ECO et participer, selon les besoins, à des projets transversaux de l'EPFL.

Profil

• Formation en comptabilité, finance, gestion ou formation commerciale complétée par plusieurs années d'expérience dans une fonction similaire.

• Expérience confirmée dans la gestion financière et administrative de projets scientifiques ou de projets d'envergure comparable. Une expérience en fiduciaire ou en audit constitue un atout.

• Excellente maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.

• Très bonne maîtrise des outils bureautiques (Microsoft Office), avec une excellente maîtrise d'Excel.

• Excellentes capacités organisationnelles et aptitude à gérer simultanément plusieurs priorités dans un environnement dynamique et multipartenaire.

• Grande rigueur, sens de l'organisation et respect des délais, notamment dans le suivi budgétaire et administratif.

• Esprit d'initiative, autonomie et sens du service.

• Excellentes compétences relationnelles et capacité à collaborer avec des interlocuteurs variés (direction, chercheurs, professeurs, partenaires institutionnels, auditeurs et services administratifs).

• Personnalité dynamique, fiable, discrète et faisant preuve d'un haut niveau d'

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione Il National Research Centre "CNCR Separation" è un progetto nazionale svizzero finanziato principalmente dal Fondo nazionale svizzero. Esso riunisce numerosi ricercatori di alto livello provenienti da tutto il paese e mira a sviluppare nuove tecniche nella scienza della separazione e ad accelerare il trasferimento tecnologico per raggiungere gli obiettivi di sviluppo sostenibile della Svizzera e accelerare i progressi verso la neutralità del clima globale. L'EPFL, responsabile della gestione di questo progetto, sta cercando un gestore amministrativo e finanziario per gestire le operazioni finanziarie. La missione principale di questa posizione è quella di centralizzare e consolidare le informazioni finanziarie relative al progetto all'interno di EPFL e con partner esterni. Principali compiti e responsabilità Gestione finanziaria
• Fornire la gestione finanziaria e la contabilità per il progetto NCCR Separations.
• Partecipate allo sviluppo del budget, al monitoraggio e al pilotaggio in stretta collaborazione con NCCR management e Program Manager.
• Assicurare il controllo di bilancio delle varie istituzioni partner e preparare relazioni finanziarie interne ed esterne.
• Gestire la raccolta, l'audit, il rimborso e la contabilità delle spese di progetto in collaborazione con tutti i partner.
• Raccogliere, monitorare e mantenere i dati finanziari necessari per le relazioni intermedie e finali al Fondo nazionale svizzero (NSF) tramite il portale di segnalazione.
• Preparare, coordinare e monitorare gli audit finanziari NSF.
• Collabora con i servizi centrali EPFL e i partner di consorzio su tutte le questioni finanziarie e amministrative. Amministrazione e coordinamento
• Fornire supporto amministrativo al NCCR, tra cui l'organizzazione di riunioni, la preparazione di agenda e minuti, la gestione di mailing list e il monitoraggio della documentazione.
• Fornire supporto amministrativo al team di gestione (Program Manager, Communication Officer, KTT Officer, Data Manager, Scientific Officer) come richiesto.
• Partecipare alle procedure di reclutamento e garantire il follow-up amministrativo delle risorse umane (pubblicazione delle offerte, onboarding, offboarding, accreditamenti, follow-up delle assenze) in coordinamento con i servizi HR rilevanti.
• Coordinare l'organizzazione logistica degli eventi NCCR (laboratori, allenamenti, ritiri, riunioni, riunioni generali e eventi scientifici).
• Sostenere l'organizzazione di viaggi, visite, soggiorni scientifici, programmi di scambio, borse di studio e seconde dei membri del NCCR.
• Contribuire alle attività di taglio trasversale dell'unità ECO e partecipare, come richiesto, a progetti di taglio incrociato EPFL. Profilo
• Formazione in contabilità, finanza, gestione o formazione aziendale integrata da diversi anni di esperienza in una funzione simile.
• Esperienza confermata nella gestione finanziaria e amministrativa di progetti scientifici o progetti di dimensioni comparabili. Un'esperienza fiduciaria o audit è un bene.
• Ottima padronanza di francese e inglese, sia orale che scritta.
• Ottima padronanza degli strumenti di ufficio (Microsoft Office), con eccellente padronanza di Excel.
• Eccellente capacità organizzative e capacità di gestire più priorità simultaneamente in un ambiente dinamico e multi-partner.
• Grande rigore, senso di organizzazione e tempestività, in particolare nel controllo di bilancio e amministrativo.
• Iniziativa, autonomia e senso del servizio.
• Eccellente capacità relazionali e capacità di collaborare con una varietà di stakeholder (direzione, ricercatori, professori, partner istituzionali, revisori e servizi amministrativi).
• Una personalità dinamica, affidabile, discreta e di alto livello
descriptionByLocale.en:
Mission The National Research Centre "CNCR Separation" is a national Swiss project financed mainly by the Swiss National Fund. It brings together many high-level researchers from across the country and aims to develop new techniques in separation science and to accelerate technology transfer in order to achieve Switzerland's sustainable development goals and accelerate progress towards global climate neutrality. The EPFL, which is responsible for managing this project, is looking for an administrative and financial manager to manage financial operations. The main mission of this position is to centralize and consolidate the financial information related to the project within EPFL and with external partners. Main tasks and responsibilities Financial management
• Provide financial management and accounting for the NCCR Separations project.
• Participate in budget development, monitoring and piloting in close collaboration with NCCR management and Program Managers.
• Ensure budgetary monitoring of the various partner institutions and prepare internal and external financial reports.
• Manage the collection, audit, reimbursement and accounting of project expenditures in collaboration with all partners.
• Collect, monitor and maintain the financial data required for interim and final reports to the Swiss National Fund (NSF) via the reporting portal.
• Prepare, coordinate and monitor NSF financial audits.
• Collaborate with EPFL central services and consortium partners on all financial and administrative issues. Administration and coordination
• Provide administrative support to the NCCR, including the organization of meetings, preparation of agendas and minutes, management of mailing lists and monitoring of documentation.
• Provide administrative support to the management team (Program Manager, Communication Officer, KTT Officer, Data Manager, Scientific Officer) as required.
• Participate in recruitment procedures and ensure administrative follow-up of human resources (publication of offers, onboarding, offboarding, accreditations, follow-up of absences) in coordination with relevant HR services.
• Coordinate the logistical organization of NCCR events (workshops, trainings, retreats, meetings, general meetings and scientific events).
• Support the organization of travel, visits, scientific stays, exchange programmes, scholarships and secondments of NCCR members.
• Contribute to the cross-cutting tasks of the ECO unit and participate, as required, in EPFL cross-cutting projects. Profile
• Training in accounting, finance, management or business training supplemented by several years of experience in a similar function.
• Confirmed experience in the financial and administrative management of scientific projects or projects of comparable size. An experience in fiduciary or audit is an asset.
• Excellent mastery of French and English, both oral and written.
• Very good mastery of office tools (Microsoft Office), with excellent mastery of Excel.
• Excellent organizational capabilities and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously in a dynamic and multi-partner environment.
• Great rigour, sense of organisation and timeliness, particularly in budgetary and administrative monitoring.
• Initiative, autonomy and sense of service.
• Excellent relational skills and ability to collaborate with a variety of stakeholders (direction, researchers, professors, institutional partners, auditors and administrative services).
• A dynamic, reliable, discreet and high-level personality
descriptionByLocale.de:
Mission Das Nationale Forschungszentrum "CNCR Separation" ist ein nationales Schweizer Projekt, das hauptsächlich vom Schweizerischen Nationalfonds finanziert wird. Es bringt viele hochrangige Forscher aus dem ganzen Land zusammen und zielt darauf ab, neue Techniken in der Trennungswissenschaft zu entwickeln und den Technologietransfer zu beschleunigen, um die nachhaltigen Entwicklungsziele der Schweiz zu erreichen und Fortschritte in Richtung globaler Klimaneutralität zu beschleunigen. Die EPFL, die für die Verwaltung dieses Projekts verantwortlich ist, sucht einen Verwaltungs- und Finanzmanager, der die Finanzoperationen verwaltet. Die Hauptaufgabe dieser Position besteht darin, die mit dem Projekt verbundenen Finanzinformationen innerhalb der EPFL und mit externen Partnern zu zentralisieren und zu konsolidieren. Hauptaufgaben und Zuständigkeiten Finanzverwaltung
• Bereitstellung von Finanzmanagement und Buchhaltung für das NFS-Separationsprojekt.
• Beteiligen Sie sich an der Budgetentwicklung, -überwachung und -pilotierung in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem NFS-Management und den Programmmanagern.
• Gewährleistung der Haushaltsüberwachung der verschiedenen Partnerinstitutionen und Erstellung interner und externer Finanzberichte.
• Verwalten Sie die Erhebung, Prüfung, Erstattung und Abrechnung der Projektausgaben in Zusammenarbeit mit allen Partnern.
• Sammeln, überwachen und pflegen Sie die Finanzdaten, die für Zwischen- und Abschlussberichte an den Schweizerischen Nationalfonds (NSF) über das Meldeportal erforderlich sind.
• Vorbereitung, Koordinierung und Überwachung von NSF-Finanzprüfungen.
• Zusammenarbeit mit zentralen Diensten der EPFL und Konsortialpartnern in allen finanziellen und administrativen Fragen. Verwaltung und Koordinierung
• Gewährleistung administrativer Unterstützung des NFS, einschließlich der Organisation von Sitzungen, der Vorbereitung von Tagesordnungen und Protokollen, der Verwaltung von Mailinglisten und der Überwachung der Dokumentation.
• Je nach Bedarf administrative Unterstützung des Managementteams (Program Manager, Communication Officer, KTT Officer, Data Manager, Scientific Officer).
• Teilnahme an Einstellungsverfahren und Gewährleistung der administrativen Begleitung der Personalressourcen (Veröffentlichung von Angeboten, Onboarding, Offboarding, Akkreditierungen, Nachverfolgung von Abwesenheiten) in Abstimmung mit den zuständigen Personaldiensten.
• Koordinierung der logistischen Organisation von NFS-Veranstaltungen (Workshops, Schulungen, Retreats, Sitzungen, Hauptversammlungen und wissenschaftliche Veranstaltungen).
• Unterstützung der Organisation von Reisen, Besuchen, wissenschaftlichen Aufenthalten, Austauschprogrammen, Stipendien und Entsendungen von NFS-Mitgliedern.
• Beitrag zu den Querschnittsaufgaben der ECO-Stelle und gegebenenfalls Beteiligung an Querschnittsprojekten der EPFL. Profil
• Ausbildung in Buchhaltung, Finanzen, Management oder Business-Training ergänzt durch mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Funktion.
• Bestätigte Erfahrung in der finanziellen und administrativen Verwaltung von wissenschaftlichen Projekten oder Projekten vergleichbarer Größe. Eine Erfahrung im Treuhänder oder Audit ist ein Vermögenswert.
• Hervorragende Beherrschung von Französisch und Englisch, sowohl mündlich als auch schriftlich.
• Sehr gute Beherrschung von Office-Tools (Microsoft Office), mit hervorragender Beherrschung von Excel.
• Hervorragende organisatorische Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten gleichzeitig in einer dynamischen und Multi-Partner-Umgebung zu verwalten.
• Hohe Strenge, Organisationssinn und Aktualität, insbesondere bei der Haushalts- und Verwaltungskontrolle.
• Initiative, Autonomie und Sinn für Service.
• Hervorragende relationale Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit zur Zusammenarbeit mit einer Vielzahl von Interessengruppen (Leitung, Forscher, Professoren, institutionelle Partner, Auditoren und Verwaltungsdienste).
• Eine dynamische, zuverlässige, diskrete und hochrangige Persönlichkeit

titleByLocale.en: Administrative assistant 50%
titleByLocale.fr: Assistant administratif 50%

jobs.description:
Mission

The DIAS laboratory under the supervision of Professor Ailamaki, is seeking an Administrative Assistant to support its financial management, administrative operations, and collaborative activities.

Main duties and responsibilities

Administrative managemen t

• Staff administration, preparation of hiring/leaving files, employment contracts (academic, non-academic), employment of temporary academic and non-academic staff, visiting PhD students, Teaching assistants, internships (summer@epfl, summer in the lab) etc…

• Organization of trips, meetings, conferences, seminars, symposiums

• Orders and inventories of laboratory materials, equipment

• Creation and follow-up of expense reports and payment orders

• Mail and correspondance in French and English

• Welcoming new team members , reception (staff and visitors)

• Complete travel management for visitors (visiting professors, guests, trainees, visiting students, etc ... ) and invitation file, assistance with visa application, accommodation, reimbursement of expenses

• Absence management

• Agenda management (Professor and Lab)

• Documents and administrative tasks related to teaching

Financial management

• Annual Budget preparation

• Follow-up of budget accounts

• Follow-up of the administrative management of research projects or mandates

• Processing of supplier and debtor invoices

• Management of the laboratory's credit card

• Support coordination of collaborations and multi-partner projects

• Assist in grant budget preparation and administrative follow-up

• Track deliverables and reporting requirements

Event suppor t

• Provide administrative support for events, workshops, travel, and teaching activities (including invited speakers and summer schools)

• Team building organization

Profile

• Experience in budget organization and accounting

• Experience as an administrative assistant and in project coordination

• Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities

Mission

The EPFL Hydraulic Machinery Platform (PTMH ptmh.epfl.ch ) is a centre of scientific excellence in research and development of hydraulic machines, specializing in performance validation, hydrodynamics and cavitation leveraging advanced measurement techniques and state-of-the-art experimental infrastructure.

We are seeking an Operational Director who, under the guidance of the academic leadership, will lead and oversee the operations of PTMH’s experimental infrastructure. Holding responsibility for the operational management of service contracts, the Operational Director leads an engineering team of 8 staff members, ensures operational excellence and customer satisfaction, and implements strategic direction and service innovation by aligning work practices with institutional priorities.

Main Duties

• Line management of the engineering team

• Operational management of testing platforms and resources in alignment with the academic strategy

• Oversight of platform finances: budget monitoring, payment verification, resource follow-up and financial reporting

• Invoicing and financial follow-up

• Review of service contracts and interface with EPFL Legal Department and Technology Transfer Office

• Coordination of building needs and infrastructure requests

jobs.description:
Mission

Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF)-funded project on human motivation, stress physiology, immersive behavioral testing, and biological phenotyping.

The Laboratory of Behavioral Genetics at EPFL, led by Prof. Carmen Sandi, is seeking an outstanding postdoctoral researcher with a strong technical and quantitative profile to join a SNSF-funded project investigating human motivation and stress responsiveness.

The project will develop and validate individually calibrated behavioral tasks in immersive virtual reality (VR) to quantify effort-based motivation, vigor, persistence, and goal-directed versus habitual control. It will then test how acute stress alters these processes, combining behavioral performance, physiological monitoring, movement-based phenotyping, and advanced statistical and computational analyses.

This position is part of a broader two-position recruitment linked to the same SNSF-funded project. The present call is for the position focused on human experimental implementation, participant recruitment, psychobiological assessment, biological sampling, and translational biomarker integration. A complementary position will focus more specifically on multimodal sensing, experimental systems, physiological and movement data, and advanced behavioral data analysis.

The position is funded for three years. In line with standard EPFL procedures, the contract is issued on a one-year basis and renewable annually, subject to satisfactory progress and institutional regulations.

Project background

Understanding how stress influences motivated behavior requires experimental approaches that combine rigorous behavioral testing with careful assessment of individual differences and biological stress responses. In this project, participants will complete immersive behavioral tasks designed to measure how they choose, initiate action, sustain effort, adapt to changing contingencies, and respond to acute stress.

The study will combine a standardized acute stress manipulation and behavioral assessments in VR, physiological monitoring, and biological sampling. In addition to endocrine measures, we are eventually interested -in the second part of the project implementation- in integrating broader hormonal, metabolic, inflammatory, and mitochondrial-related biomarkers to better characterize individual biological profiles linked to stress responsiveness and motivated behavior.

A central aim is to develop and validate novel motivational tasks for VR and to understand how anxiety-related traits, stress physiology, and biological response profiles shape motivated behavior. The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring that the human experimental pipeline is scientifically rigorous, ethically sound, well organized, and suitable for future translational applications.

Main responsibilities

The postdoctoral researcher will lead the human experimental and translational phenotyping arm of the project. Responsibilities will include:

• Coordinating participant recruitment, screening, scheduling, consent, testing, and retention.

• Implementing the human experimental protocol with high fidelity, including acute stress and neutral control sessions, VR-based behavioral tasks, questionnaires, physiological recordings, and biological sampling.

• Developing and maintaining standard operating procedures for participant flow, stress testing, biological sample collection, sample processing, data tracking, and quality control.

• Training and supervising Master’s students, research assistants, or junior lab members involved in recruitment, participant testing, biological sample handling, and data entry.

• Overseeing saliva collection, processing, labeling, storage, and coordination of endocrine assays, particularly cortisol.

• Contributing to the possible extension of the project toward blood-based hormonal, metabolic, inflammatory, or mitochondrial-related biomarkers.

• Ensuring high-quality participant-facing implem

descriptionByLocale.it: Progetto finanziato dalla Mission Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF) sulla motivazione umana, fisiologia dello stress, test comportamentali immersivi e fenotipizzazione biologica. Il Laboratorio di Genetica Comportamentale dell'EPFL, guidato dalla Prof.ssa Carmen Sandi, è alla ricerca di un ricercatore post-dottorato eccezionale con un forte profilo tecnico e quantitativo per unirsi a un progetto finanziato dalla SNSF che indaga la motivazione umana e la reattività allo stress. Il progetto svilupperà e convaliderà compiti comportamentali calibrati individualmente nella realtà virtuale immersiva (VR) per quantificare la motivazione basata sullo sforzo, il vigore, la perseveranza e il controllo orientato agli obiettivi rispetto all'abitudine. Successivamente testerà come lo stress acuto alteri questi processi, combinando performance comportamentali, monitoraggio fisiologico, fenotipizzazione basata sul movimento e analisi statistiche e computazionali avanzate. Questa posizione fa parte di un più ampio reclutamento a due posizioni collegato allo stesso progetto finanziato dalla SNSF. L'attuale appello è per la posizione focalizzata sull'implementazione sperimentale umana, reclutamento di partecipanti, valutazione psicobiologica, campionamento biologico e integrazione di biomarcatori traslazionali. Una posizione complementare si concentrerà più specificamente sul sensore multimodale, sistemi sperimentali, dati fisiologici e di movimento, e analisi avanzata dei dati comportamentali. La posizione è finanziata per tre anni. In conformità con le procedure standard dell'EPFL, il contratto viene emesso su base annuale e rinnovabile annualmente, soggetto a progressi soddisfacenti e a regolamentazioni istituzionali. Contesto del progetto: Comprendere come lo stress influenzi il comportamento motivato richiede approcci sperimentali che combinino rigorosi test comportamentali con un'attenta valutazione delle differenze individuali e delle risposte biologiche allo stress. In questo progetto, i partecipanti completeranno compiti comportamentali immersivi progettati per misurare come scegliere, iniziare l'azione, sostenere lo sforzo, adattarsi a contingenze mutevoli e rispondere a uno stress acuto. Lo studio combinerà una manipolazione standardizzata dello stress acuto e valutazioni comportamentali in VR, monitoraggio fisiologico e campionamento biologico. Oltre alle misure endocrine, siamo infine interessati - nella seconda parte dell'implementazione del progetto - a integrare biomarcatori ormonali, metabolici, infiammatori e mitocondriali più ampi per caratterizzare meglio i profili biologici individuali legati alla reattività allo stress e al comportamento motivato. Uno degli obiettivi centrali è sviluppare e convalidare nuovi compiti motivazionali per la VR e comprendere come i tratti legati all'ansia, la fisiologia dello stress e i profili di risposta biologica plasmino il comportamento motivato. Il candidato selezionato avrà un ruolo chiave nel garantire che la pipeline sperimentale umana sia scientificamente rigorosa, eticamente solida, ben organizzata e adatta per future applicazioni traslazionali. Principali responsabilità Il ricercatore post-dottorato guiderà il ramo di fenotipizzazione sperimentale e traslazionale umana del progetto. Le responsabilità includeranno: - Coordinare il reclutamento dei partecipanti, lo screening, la programmazione, il consenso, i test e la fidelizzazione. - Implementare il protocollo sperimentale umano con alta fedeltà, inclusi sessioni di stress acuto e controllo neutro, compiti comportamentali basati su VR, questionari, registrazioni fisiologiche e campionamenti biologici. - Sviluppare e mantenere procedure operative standard per il flusso dei partecipanti, i test di stress, la raccolta di campioni biologici, l'elaborazione dei campioni, il tracciamento dei dati e il controllo qualità. - Formazione e supervisione di studenti di Master, assistenti di ricerca o membri junior di laboratorio coinvolti nel reclutamento, nei test dei partecipanti, nella gestione di campioni biologici e nell'inserimento dati. - Supervisionare la raccolta, l'elaborazione, l'etichettatura, l'archiviazione e il coordinamento degli saggi endocrini, in particolare del cortisolo. - Contribuire alla possibile estensione del progetto verso biomarcatori ormonali, metabolici, infiammatori o mitocondriali basati sul sangue. - Garantire un'implementazione di alta qualità rivolta ai partecipanti.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Mission Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF)-funded project on human motivation, stress physiology, immersive behavioral testing, and biological phenotyping. The Laboratory of Behavioral Genetics at EPFL, led by Prof. Carmen Sandi, is seeking an outstanding postdoctoral researcher with a strong technical and quantitative profile to join a SNSF-funded project investigating human motivation and stress responsiveness. The project will develop and validate individually calibrated behavioral tasks in immersive virtual reality (VR) to quantify effort-based motivation, vigor, persistence, and goal-directed versus habitual control. It will then test how acute stress alters these processes, combining behavioral performance, physiological monitoring, movement-based phenotyping, and advanced statistical and computational analyses. This position is part of a broader two-position recruitment linked to the same SNSF-funded project. The present call is for the position focused on human experimental implementation, participant recruitment, psychobiological assessment, biological sampling, and translational biomarker integration. A complementary position will focus more specifically on multimodal sensing, experimental systems, physiological and movement data, and advanced behavioral data analysis. The position is funded for three years. In line with standard EPFL procedures, the contract is issued on a one-year basis and renewable annually, subject to satisfactory progress and institutional regulations. Project background Understanding how stress influences motivated behavior requires experimental approaches that combine rigorous behavioral testing with careful assessment of individual differences and biological stress responses. In this project, participants will complete immersive behavioral tasks designed to measure how they choose, initiate action, sustain effort, adapt to changing contingencies, and respond to acute stress. The study will combine a standardized acute stress manipulation and behavioral assessments in VR, physiological monitoring, and biological sampling. In addition to endocrine measures, we are eventually interested -in the second part of the project implementation- in integrating broader hormonal, metabolic, inflammatory, and mitochondrial-related biomarkers to better characterize individual biological profiles linked to stress responsiveness and motivated behavior. A central aim is to develop and validate novel motivational tasks for VR and to understand how anxiety-related traits, stress physiology, and biological response profiles shape motivated behavior. The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring that the human experimental pipeline is scientifically rigorous, ethically sound, well organized, and suitable for future translational applications. Main responsibilities The postdoctoral researcher will lead the human experimental and translational phenotyping arm of the project.
• Responsibilities will include: - Coordinating participant recruitment, screening, scheduling, consent, testing, and retention. - Implementing the human experimental protocol with high fidelity, including acute stress and neutral control sessions, VR-based behavioral tasks, questionnaires, physiological recordings, and biological sampling. - Developing and maintaining standard operating procedures for participant flow, stress testing, biological sample collection, sample processing, data tracking, and quality control. - Training and supervising Master’s students, research assistants, or junior lab members involved in recruitment, participant testing, biological sample handling, and data entry. - Overseeing saliva collection, processing, labeling, storage, and coordination of endocrine assays, particularly cortisol. - Contributing to the possible extension of the project toward blood-based hormonal, metabolic, inflammatory, or mitochondrial-related biomarkers. - Ensuring high-quality participant-facing implementation.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Mission

Projet financé par la Fondation nationale suisse des sciences (SNSF) sur la motivation humaine, la physiologie du stress, les tests comportementaux immersifs et le phénotypage biologique.

Le Laboratoire de génétique comportementale de l'EPFL, dirigé par le Prof. Carmen Sandi, cherche une chercheuse postdoctorale exceptionnelle avec un profil technique et quantitatif solide pour rejoindre un projet financé par la SNSF qui étudie la motivation humaine et la réactivité au stress.

Le projet développera et validera des tâches comportementales étalonnées individuellement dans la réalité virtuelle immersive (VR) afin de quantifier la motivation, la vigueur, la persistance et le contrôle habituel par rapport aux objectifs. Il testera ensuite comment le stress aigu modifie ces processus, combinant performance comportementale, surveillance physiologique, phénotypage basé sur le mouvement, et analyses statistiques et computationnelles avancées.

Ce poste fait partie d'un recrutement à deux postes plus large lié au même projet financé par la SNSF. Le présent appel porte sur la mise en oeuvre expérimentale humaine, le recrutement des participants, l'évaluation psychobiologique, l'échantillonnage biologique et l'intégration des biomarqueurs translationnels. Une position complémentaire portera plus particulièrement sur la détection multimodale, les systèmes expérimentaux, les données physiologiques et de mouvement et l'analyse avancée des données comportementales.

Le poste est financé pendant trois ans. Conformément aux procédures standard de l'EPFL, le contrat est délivré sur une base d'un an et renouvelable annuellement, sous réserve de progrès satisfaisants et de réglementations institutionnelles.

Contexte du projet

Comprendre comment le stress influence le comportement motivé nécessite des approches expérimentales qui combinent des tests de comportement rigoureux avec une évaluation minutieuse des différences individuelles et des réponses au stress biologique. Dans le cadre de ce projet, les participants accompliront des tâches comportementales immersives conçues pour mesurer comment ils choisissent, initier l'action, soutenir l'effort, s'adapter aux imprévus changeants et réagir au stress aigu.

L'étude combinera une manipulation du stress aigu normalisée et des évaluations comportementales dans la RV, la surveillance physiologique et l'échantillonnage biologique. En plus des mesures endocriniennes, nous sommes finalement intéressés - dans la deuxième partie de la mise en oeuvre du projet - à intégrer des biomarqueurs hormonaux, métaboliques, inflammatoires et mitochondriaux plus larges pour mieux caractériser les profils biologiques individuels liés à la réactivité au stress et au comportement motivé.

Un objectif central est de développer et de valider de nouvelles tâches motivationnelles pour les VR et de comprendre comment les traits liés à l'anxiété, la physiologie du stress et les profils de réponse biologique façonnent le comportement motivé. Le candidat retenu jouera un rôle clé en s'assurant que le pipeline expérimental humain est scientifiquement rigoureux, éthiquement sain, bien organisé et adapté aux futures applications de traduction.

Principales responsabilités

Le chercheur postdoctoral dirigera le volet humain expérimental et translationnel du projet. Les responsabilités seront les suivantes :

• Coordonner le recrutement, la présélection, la planification, le consentement, les tests et le maintien en poste des participants.

• Mettre en œuvre le protocole expérimental humain avec une grande fidélité, y compris le stress aigu et les séances de contrôle neutres, les tâches comportementales basées sur la RV, les questionnaires, les enregistrements physiologiques et l'échantillonnage biologique.

• Élaborer et maintenir des procédures opérationnelles normalisées pour le débit des participants, les tests de résistance, la collecte d'échantillons biologiques, le traitement des échantillons, le suivi des données et le contrôle de la qualité.

• Formation et supervision d'étudiants de maîtrise, d'assistants de recherche ou de membres de laboratoires subalternes participant au recrutement, aux tests des participants, à la manipulation des échantillons biologiques et à la saisie des données.

• Superviser la collecte, le traitement, l'étiquetage, l'entreposage et la coordination des essais endocriniens, en particulier le cortisol.

• Contribuer à l'extension possible du projet vers les biomarqueurs hormonaux, métaboliques, inflammatoires ou mitochondriaux à base de sang.

• Assurer une mise en œuvre de qualité face aux participants

jobs.description:
Mission

We are offering a challenging position as a full-time (100%) PhD Student at School of Engineering - STI at EPFL. At the Laboratory for fundamental BioPhotonics - LBP we are developing nonlinear imaging techniques to study, characterize and image water in different configuration.

Introduction

Electrolyte solutions in water are an essential ingredient of many aspects of life and technology: the bodily fluids (blood and cellular fluid are prime examples), but also are the key contents of batteries. The electrolyte in batteries determines the power output, life span and efficient energy storage. Electrolyte solutions are commonly described as homogeneous mixtures in which ions are statistically distributed. However, it is well known from theoretical considerations in the 1930’s that this simple description is incomplete for the relevant concentration range and that the structure of electrolyte solutions is far more complex. Experiments to understand this need to cover time scales ranging from femto- to milliseconds, and length scales from atomistic dimensions to microns, a huge challenge.

The Project at EPFL

We will use various novel home-built technologies based on nonlinear optical scattering and imaging methods to achieve this: second harmonic imaging, angle-resolved-second harmonic scattering, and correlated vibrational spectroscopy, all ultrafast optical methods, supplemented by standard linear spectroscopy and light scattering methods. These methods will be applied to simple 3D electrolytes in water, and 2D electrolyte regions at aqueous interfaces. Linking all datasets will allow to map both short – and long-range interactions and collective effects pertaining to all molecular actors. This allows to solve the puzzle surrounding concentrated electrolyte solutions and how they work, for example in their charge transmitting/storing functions and lead to a better understanding, and ultimately new technology.

Main duties and responsibilities

As a PhD Student, you will be expected to:

• Have full responsibility for your own dissertation

• Research in close collaboration with industry partners

• Experiment design and execution

• Analyze and interpret experimental results

• Write scientific articles for publication in peer-reviewed journals

• Present at international conferences

• Participate in education and supervise student project

This research has many interdisciplinary aspects that demand a highly motivated candidate with strong analytical abilities that can think out of the box. The successful candidate has a background in photonics, physics, chemistry/material science, or electrical engineering, ideally supplemented by hands-on experience in free space optics / microscopy, nonlinear optics or ultrafast spectroscopy. We offer excellent working conditions and a state-of-the-art infrastructure in a highly dynamic and international environment at the forefront of research.

Profile

• A MSc degree

• Good communication skills and willingness to work as part of a team

• Enthusiasm, scientific curiosity, eager to learn, good organizational skills, rigor in experimental work

• High level of motivation for academic research work

• Fluency in English is essential, French / German / Italian would be an asset

We offer

• 4 years to complete your PhD with a competitive remuneration

• An opportunity to develop a scientific career

• A world-class research and training environment with access to state-of-the-art research facilities

• A multi-cultural and stimulating work environment

• A 1-year fixed-term contract (CDD), renewable for 4 years

Informations

The selection process involves multiple stages, and short-listed candidates will be requested to apply to a specific EPFL Doctoral Program to qualify for a PhD at EPFL, photonics, materials science, or electrical engineering.

Missione Stiamo offrendo una posizione impegnativa come uno studente di dottorato a tempo pieno (100%) a Scuola di Ingegneria - STI a EPFL. Al Laboratorio per BioPhotonics fondamentali - LBP stiamo sviluppando tecniche di imaging non lineare per studiare, caratterizzare e immagine acqua in diversa configurazione. Introduzione Le soluzioni elettrolitiche in acqua sono un ingrediente essenziale di molti aspetti della vita e della tecnologia: i fluidi corporei (il sangue e il liquido cellulare sono esempi primi), ma sono anche il contenuto chiave delle batterie. L'elettrolita nelle batterie determina l'uscita di potenza, la durata di vita e l'accumulo di energia efficiente. Le soluzioni elettrolitiche sono comunemente descritte come miscele omogenee in cui gli ioni sono statisticamente distribuiti. Tuttavia, è ben noto da considerazioni teoriche negli anni '30 che questa semplice descrizione è incompleta per la relativa gamma di concentrazione e che la struttura delle soluzioni elettrolitiche è molto più complessa. Esperimenti per capire questa necessità di coprire scale di tempo che vanno da femto a millisecondi, e scale di lunghezza da dimensioni atomiste a micron, una sfida enorme. Il progetto in EPFL Useremo varie nuove tecnologie home-built basate su metodi di spargimento ottico non lineare e di imaging per raggiungere questo obiettivo: seconda imaging armonico, angolo-risolto-secondo spargimento armonico, e spettroscopia vibrazionale correlata, tutti i metodi ottici ultraveloci, integrati da spettroscopia lineare standard e metodi di spargimento della luce. Questi metodi saranno applicati a semplici elettroliti 3D in acqua, e regioni elettrolitiche 2D a interfacce acquose. Collegare tutti i dataset permetterà di mappare sia le interazioni brevi, sia quelle a lungo raggio e gli effetti collettivi relativi a tutti gli attori molecolari. Questo permette di risolvere il puzzle che circonda soluzioni elettrolitiche concentrate e come funzionano, ad esempio nelle loro funzioni di trasmissione / memorizzazione di carica e portare a una migliore comprensione, e in ultima analisi, nuova tecnologia. Principali doveri e responsabilità Come studente di dottorato, ci si aspetta di:
• Avere piena responsabilità per la propria dissertazione
• Ricerca in stretta collaborazione con partner industriali
• Progettazione sperimentale ed esecuzione
• Analizzare e interpretare i risultati sperimentali
• Scrivere articoli scientifici per la pubblicazione in riviste peer-reviewed
• Presente alle conferenze internazionali
• Partecipare all'istruzione e supervisionare il progetto degli studenti Questa ricerca ha molti aspetti interdisciplinari che richiedono un candidato altamente motivato con forti capacità analitiche che possono pensare fuori dalla scatola. Il candidato di successo ha uno sfondo in fotonici, fisica, chimica / scienza materiale, o ingegneria elettrica, idealmente integrato da esperienza hands-on in ottica spazio libero / microscopia, ottica non lineare o spettroscopia ultraveloce. Offriamo eccellenti condizioni di lavoro e un'infrastruttura all'avanguardia in un ambiente altamente dinamico e internazionale all'avanguardia della ricerca. Profilo
• Un grado MSc
• Buona capacità di comunicazione e disponibilità a lavorare come parte di un team
• Enthusiasm, curiosità scientifica, desideroso di imparare, buone capacità organizzative, rigore nel lavoro sperimentale
• Alto livello di motivazione per il lavoro di ricerca accademica
• La fluenza in inglese è essenziale, francese / tedesco / italiano sarebbe un bene Offriamo
• 4 anni per completare il dottorato con una remunerazione competitiva
• Un'opportunità per sviluppare una carriera scientifica
• Un ambiente di ricerca e formazione di livello mondiale con accesso a strutture di ricerca all'avanguardia
• Un ambiente di lavoro multiculturale e stimolante
• Un contratto a tempo determinato di 1 anno (CDD), rinnovabile per 4 anni Informazioni Il processo di selezione coinvolge più fasi, e candidati a lista corta sarà richiesto di applicare a un programma specifico di dottorato EPFL per qualificarsi per un dottorato in EPFL, fotonici, scienza dei materiali o ingegneria elettrica. Si prega di controllare questa pagina per ulteriori informazioni sull'ammissione. Si prega di notare che questo è un processo di applicazione separato ne

Mission Wir bieten eine herausfordernde Position als Vollzeit (100%) Doktorand an der School of Engineering - STI an der EPFL. Im Labor für grundlegende Biophotoniks - LBP entwickeln wir nichtlineare Bildgebungstechniken, um Wasser in unterschiedlicher Konfiguration zu studieren, zu charakterisieren und zu bilden. Einleitung Elektrolytlösungen in Wasser sind ein wesentlicher Bestandteil vieler Aspekte des Lebens und der Technologie: Die Körperflüssigkeiten (Blut und Zellflüssigkeit sind Grundbeispiele), sind aber auch der Schlüsselinhalt von Batterien. Der Elektrolyt in Batterien bestimmt die Leistung, Lebensdauer und effiziente Energiespeicher. Elektrolytlösungen werden allgemein als homogene Mischungen beschrieben, in denen Ionen statistisch verteilt sind. Aus theoretischen Überlegungen in den 1930er Jahren ist jedoch bekannt, dass diese einfache Beschreibung für den jeweiligen Konzentrationsbereich unvollständig ist und die Struktur von Elektrolytlösungen viel komplexer ist. Versuche, dies zu verstehen, müssen Zeitskala von Femto- bis Millisekunden und Längenskala von atomistischen Dimensionen bis hin zu Mikron, eine große Herausforderung. Das Projekt bei der EPFL Um dies zu erreichen, verwenden wir verschiedene neuartige, auf nichtlinearen optischen Streu- und Abbildungsmethoden basierende home-built Technologien: zweite harmonische Abbildung, winkelaufgelöste zweite harmonische Streuung und korrelierte Schwingungsspektroskopie, alle ultraschnellen optischen Methoden, ergänzt durch Standard-Linearspektroskopie und Lichtstreuverfahren. Diese Verfahren werden auf einfache 3D-Elektrolyten in Wasser und 2D-Elektrolytenbereiche an wässrigen Grenzflächen angewendet. Durch die Verknüpfung aller Datensätze können sowohl kurz- als auch langwierige Interaktionen und kollektive Effekte auf alle molekularen Akteure abgebildet werden. Dies ermöglicht es, das Puzzle um konzentrierte Elektrolytlösungen zu lösen und wie sie funktionieren, zum Beispiel in ihren Ladungsübertragungs-/Speicherfunktionen und zu einem besseren Verständnis und letztlich neuer Technologie. • volle Verantwortung für Ihre eigene Dissertation

Mission Nous offrons un poste difficile comme doctorant à temps plein (100%) à l'École d'ingénierie - STI à l'EPFL. Au Laboratoire de BioPhotonique fondamentale - LBP, nous développons des techniques d'imagerie non linéaire pour étudier, caractériser et imager l'eau dans différentes configurations. Présentation Les solutions électrolytiques dans l'eau sont un ingrédient essentiel de nombreux aspects de la vie et de la technologie : les fluides corporels (le sang et le liquide cellulaire en sont des exemples essentiels), mais aussi le contenu clé des batteries. L'électrolyte dans les batteries détermine la puissance, la durée de vie et le stockage efficace de l'énergie. Les solutions électrolytiques sont généralement décrites comme des mélanges homogènes dans lesquels les ions sont répartis statistiquement. Cependant, il est bien connu, d'après les considérations théoriques des années 1930, que cette description simple est incomplète pour la gamme de concentration pertinente et que la structure des solutions d'électrolytes est beaucoup plus complexe. Des expériences pour comprendre ce besoin de couvrir des échelles de temps allant de fem à millisecondes, et des échelles de longueur des dimensions atomistes aux microns, un défi énorme. Le projet à l'EPFL Pour ce faire, nous utiliserons diverses nouvelles technologies maison basées sur des méthodes de diffusion et d'imagerie optiques non linéaires : deuxième imagerie harmonique, diffusion harmonique résolue par angle et seconde, et spectroscopie vibrationnelle corrélée, toutes les méthodes optiques ultrarapides, complétées par des méthodes standard de spectroscopie linéaire et de diffusion de la lumière. Ces méthodes seront appliquées aux électrolytes 3D simples dans l'eau et aux régions électrolytes 2D aux interfaces aqueuses. Lier tous les ensembles de données permettra de cartographier à la fois les interactions à courte et à longue distance et les effets collectifs relatifs à tous les acteurs moléculaires. Cela permet de résoudre le puzzle entourant les solutions d'électrolytes concentrés et comment ils fonctionnent, par exemple dans leurs fonctions de transmission/stockage de charge et de conduire à une meilleure compréhension, et finalement de nouvelles technologies. jobs.description:
Mission

EPFL is one of the most dynamic university campuses in Europe, ranks among the top 20 universities worldwide and offers an exceptional working environment with very competitive salaries. The LTS2 Lab https://lts2.epfl.ch offers a highly motivating, interdisciplinary scientific environment with many opportunities to interact between different projects and researchers, and has an excellent network of collaborative research projects with applications ranging from biology to neuroscience. The objective of this project is to develop groundbreaking generative AI methodologies for the design of novel materials. This is part of a large ERC Synergy project involving de novo simulations, automated experimental platforms driven by AI models. It offers extraordinary opportunites to collaborate with materials scientists on a quest to set-up a new blueprint for materials discovery, from computational approaches to actual synthesis and characterization.

Profile

We are looking for 2 PhD students who will contribute novel multimodal generative AI architectures, latent diffusion processes, and reinforcement learning approaches. Interestingly, the proposed model will interface with an automated platform performing experimental materials synthesis and incorporate data from experimental characterization and simulations.

We are looking for PhD candidates with a strong analytical background, and an outstanding MSc degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Applied Mathematics, or a related field. You should be proficient in or willing to learn generative deep learning – in particular based on latent diffusion, multimodal approaches, statistics and learning theory. We expect the candidate to be self-driven with strong problem-solving abilities and out-of-the-box thinking. You are willing to contribute and understand new AI architectures, implement and test them. More importantly, you are willing to partake in a collective international research endeavour involving researchers from different disciplines. Professional command of English (both written and spoken) is mandatory. To be eligible for these positions you must also apply and be accepted to the doctoral program in Electrical Engineering. Please check https://www.epfl.ch/education/phd/ for additional information. Please note that this is a separate application process.

Main duties and responsibilities

As a PhD Student, you will be expected to:

Have full responsibility for your own dissertation

Research in close collaboration with academic partners;

Experiment design and execution ;

Analyze and interpret experimental results;

Write scientific articles for publication in peer-reviewed journals;

Present at international conferences.

Supervise student projects

We offer

4 years to complete your PhD with a competitive remuneration

A world-class research and training environment with access to state-of-the-art research facilities;

A multi-cultural and stimulating work environment;

International collaboration and research internships at other institutions in Belgium and France;

Term of employment: 1-year fixed-term contract (CDD), renewable for 4 years.

Informations

Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered.

Your application should contain:

• Motivation Letter

• Detailed CV

• Contact information

• At least 2 references willing to write a recommendation letter.

For more information, please contact: pierre.vandergheynst@epfl.ch

Activity Rate : 100.00

Contract Type : PhD Student

Reference : 2048

jobs.description:
Mission

We are offering a challenging position as a full-time (100%) PhD Student at School of Engineering - STI at EPFL. At the Laboratory for fundamental BioPhotonics - LBP we are developing nonlinear imaging techniques to study, characterize and image water in different configuration.

Introduction

Water is the liquid of life. It is intimately linked to our well-being. Without water, cell membranes cannot function. Charges and charged groups cannot be dissolved, self-assembly cannot occur, and proteins cannot fold. That water is intimately linked with life, we experience time and again when we quench our thirst, but how does this link work?

Osmosis is the flow of water across a (cell) membrane that separates two aqueous solutions with different concentrations of a solutes. Regulating osmotic pressure is a key survival strategy of cells and plays an important role in the functioning of every organism. How osmotic pressure and cell membrane tension are regulated on the molecular level is not known. It is the aim of the ERC Synergy Grant R2-Tension, a collaboration between EPFL (Prof. S. Roke) and the University of Geneva (Prof. A. Roux) to work this out. To do so, we will develop new technology and perform experiments in vitro and vivo.

The Project at EPFL – focused on technology development & in vitro studies

Nonlinear optical imaging and new ultrafast spectroscopic techniques have recently been developed in the Roke lab and used to image in real time interfacial water and electrostatic potentials on membrane interfaces of model membranes and in living cells.

We will use second harmonic water imaging to (1) image interfacial water in real time as well as the electrostatic field lines on lipid membrane interface model systems, and (2) image in real time membrane fusion and osmosis. The imaging data will be used to link molecular level information to electrostatics and mechanics of membranes.

Main duties and responsibilities

As a PhD Student, you will be expected to:

• Have full responsibility for your own dissertation

• Research in close collaboration with industry partners

• Experiment design and execution

• Analyze and interpret experimental results

• Write scientific articles for publication in peer-reviewed journals

• Present at international conferences

• Participate in education and supervise student project

This research has many interdisciplinary aspects that demand a highly motivated candidate with strong analytical abilities that is able to think out of the box. The diverse aspects of the project allow a wide range of backgrounds that should include photonics, physics, chemistry/material science, electrical or bioengineering. Experience in nonlinear optics / microscopy, or ultrafast spectroscopy is a bonus. We offer excellent working conditions and a state-of-the-art infrastructure in a highly dynamic and international environment at the forefront of research.

Profile

• A MSc degree

• Good communication skills and willingness to work as part of a team

• Enthusiasm, scientific curiosity, eager to learn, good organizational skills, rigor in experimental work

• High level of motivation for academic research work

• Fluency in English is essential, French / German / Italian would be an asset

We offer

• 4 years to complete your PhD with a competitive remuneration

• An opportunity to develop a scientific career

• A world-class research and training environment with access to state-of-the-art research facilities

• A multi-cultural and stimulating work environment

• A 1-year fixed-term contract (CDD), renewable for 4 years
